definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[T_TILL_QryCardPay] 
	@p_TillID varchar(15),
	@p_TuNgay varchar(10),
	@p_DenNgay varchar(10),
	@p_RutGon varchar(1)
AS
BEGIN
select * 
into #TillTXN
from
(	select a.*
	from T_TILL_TXN a
	inner join TRN_RT_BUYSELL b on a.TrnRefID = b.TrnID
	inner join T_TILL_CARDPAY c on a.TillTxnID = c.TillTxnID
	where (@p_RutGon = '0' or MaHDDienTu <> '')
	union all
	select a.*
	from T_TILL_TXN a
	inner join TRN_RT_CHANGE b on a.TrnRefID = b.TrnID
	inner join T_TILL_CARDPAY c on a.TillTxnID = c.TillTxnID
	where (@p_RutGon = '0' or MaHDDienTu <> '')
	union all
	select a.*
	from T_TILL_TXN a
	inner join T_TILL_CARDPAY c on a.TillTxnID = c.TillTxnID
	where TrnCode = 'FX'
) TD

	declare @Tam table (TrnID varchar(15), BillCode varchar(100), NgayThanhToan datetime,IDCard varchar(100), 
	HoTen nvarchar(max), BankName nvarchar(max), BankBranch nvarchar(max),
	Amount numeric(18,3), LoaiGD nvarchar(100), HinhThuc nvarchar(100))

	insert into @Tam (TrnID, BillCode, NgayThanhToan, IDCard,HoTen, BankName, BankBranch, Amount,LoaiGD, HinhThuc)
		select txn.TrnRefID TrnID, txn.BillCode ,IssuedOn NgayThanhToan, IDCard,HoTen,TC.BankName,'' BankBranch, TC.Amount,
		case when txn.TrnCode = 'SRT' then N'Mua Bán' when txn.TrnCode = 'CRT' then N'Đổi bù' when txn.TrnCode = 'FX' then N'Ngoại tệ' end as LoaiGD, '' HinhThuc
		from T_TILL_CARDPAY TC
		inner join #TillTXN txn on tc.TillTxnID = txn.TillTxnID
		where TC.TillID = @p_TillID
			AND CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),IssuedOn,103),103) >= CONVERT(DATETIME,@p_TuNgay,103)
			AND CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),IssuedOn,103),103) <= CONVERT(DATETIME,@p_DenNgay,103)
		
		union all

		select BCP.TrnID,BS.BillCode,PayDate as NgayThanhToan,IDCard,IBC.AccName HoTen,IBC.BankName,IBC.BankBranch,Amount,
		N'Mua Bán' as LoaiGD,
		case when BCP.PayType='QT' then N'Quẹt thẻ' else case when BCP.PayType='CK' then N'Chuyển khoản' else BCP.PayType end end HinhThuc
		from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_CardPay BCP
		inner join I_BankCard IBC on BCP.IDCard = IBC.NumberBank
		inner join TRN_RT_BUYSELL BS on BCP.TrnID = BS.TrnID
		WHERE BCP.TillID = @p_TillID
			AND CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),PayDate,103),103) >= CONVERT(DATETIME,@p_TuNgay,103)
			AND CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),PayDate,103),103) <= CONVERT(DATETIME,@p_DenNgay,103)
		and (@p_RutGon = '0' or (BS.Status = 'W' or MaHDDienTu <> ''))

		Union all

		select CCP.TrnID,C.BillCode,PayDate as NgayThanhToan,IDCard,IBC.AccName HoTen,IBC.BankName,IBC.BankBranch,Amount ,
		N'Đổi bù' as LoaiGD,
		case when CCP.PayType='QT' then N'Quẹt thẻ' else case when CCP.PayType='CK' then N'Chuyển khoản' else CCP.PayType end end HinhThuc
		from TRN_RT_CHANGE_CardPay CCP
		inner join I_BankCard IBC on CCP.IDCard = IBC.NumberBank
		inner join TRN_RT_CHANGE C on CCP.TrnID = C.TrnID
		WHERE CCP.TillID = @p_TillID
			AND CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),PayDate,103),103) >= CONVERT(DATETIME,@p_TuNgay,103)
			AND CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),PayDate,103),103) <= CONVERT(DATETIME,@p_DenNgay,103)
		and (@p_RutGon = '0' or (C.Status = 'W' or MaHDDienTu <> ''))

		Union all

		select FCP.TrnID,FX.BillCode,PayDate as NgayThanhToan,IDCard,IBC.AccName HoTen,IBC.BankName,IBC.BankBranch,Amount ,
		N'Ngoại tệ' as LoaiGD,
		case when FCP.PayType='QT' then N'Quẹt thẻ' else case when FCP.PayType='CK' then N'Chuyển khoản' else FCP.PayType end end HinhThuc
		from TRN_FX_CardPay FCP
		inner join I_BankCard IBC on FCP.IDCard = IBC.NumberBank
		inner join TRN_FX FX on FCP.TrnID = FX.TrnID
		WHERE FCP.TillID = @p_TillID
			AND CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),PayDate,103),103) >= CONVERT(DATETIME,@p_TuNgay,103)
			AND CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),PayDate,103),103) <= CONVERT(DATETIME,@p_DenNgay,103)

		Union all

		select DCP.TrnID,DC.BillCode,PayDate as NgayThanhToan,IDCard,IBC.AccName HoTen,IBC.BankName,IBC.BankBranch,Amount ,
		N'Đặt cọc' as LoaiGD,
		case when DCP.PayType='QT' then N'Quẹt thẻ' else case when DCP.PayType='CK' then N'Chuyển khoản' else DCP.PayType end end HinhThuc
		from TRN_DATCOC_CardPay DCP
		inner join I_BankCard IBC on DCP.IDCard = IBC.NumberBank
		inner join TRN_DATCOC DC on DCP.TrnID = DC.TrnID
		WHERE DCP.TillID = @p_TillID
			AND CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),PayDate,103),103) >= CONVERT(DATETIME,@p_TuNgay,103)
			AND CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),PayDate,103),103) <= CONVERT(DATETIME,@p_DenNgay,103)

		Union all

		select GCP.TrnID, BG.BillCode, PayDate as NgayThanhToan, IDCard, IBC.AccName HoTen, IBC.BankName, IBC.BankBranch, Amount ,
		N'Mua dẻ' as LoaiGD,
		case when GCP.PayType='QT' then N'Quẹt thẻ' else case when GCP.PayType='CK' then N'Chuyển khoản' else GCP.PayType end end HinhThuc
		from TRN_RT_BUYGOLD_CardPay GCP
		inner join I_BankCard IBC on GCP.IDCard = IBC.NumberBank
		inner join TRN_RT_BUYGOLD BG on GCP.TrnID = BG.TrnID
		WHERE GCP.TillID = @p_TillID
			AND CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),PayDate,103),103) >= CONVERT(DATETIME,@p_TuNgay,103)
			AND CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),PayDate,103),103) <= CONVERT(DATETIME,@p_DenNgay,103)
select * from @Tam
order by NgayThanhToan
SELECT [Image] FROM I_IMAGE 
END

name: TRN_RT_BUYSELL_Complete
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TRN_RT_BUYSELL_Complete]
	@p_TrnID VARCHAR(15),
	@p_UserID VARCHAR(15),
	@p_ThuHo VARCHAR(1)
AS
	DECLARE @sErr nvarchar(100), @sErrCode varchar(100), @p_ErrorCode1 nvarchar(MAX)
	DECLARE @sTillTxnID varchar(15), @sQtyP varchar(20), @sQtyR varchar(20)
	DECLARE @sProductID varchar(20), @SL numeric(10,0), @sTotalWeight_Sell numeric(19,8), @sDiamondWeight_Sell numeric(18,3)
	DECLARE @sProductTypeCode varchar(15), @sProductCode varchar(20), @sSectionIDBan varchar(20), @sTaskPrice numeric(18,3)
	DECLARE @sBillCode nvarchar(20)
SET XACT_ABORT ON;
BEGIN TRANSACTION
BEGIN TRY
    DECLARE @MaTienTeHeThong Varchar(10)    
    SELECT @MaTienTeHeThong = ParaValue From SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'MaTienTeHeThong'
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID )
	BEGIN
		SET @sErr = (SELECT ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR WHERE ErrorCode = 'B-001')
		SET @p_ErrorCode1 = 'B-001'
		GOTO ABORT
	END
	
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID and [Status]='W')
	BEGIN
		SET @sErr = (SELECT ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR WHERE ErrorCode = 'B-002')
		SET @p_ErrorCode1 = 'B-002'
		GOTO ABORT
	END
	------ UPDATE Status --------
	-- Cập nhật lại billcode nếu para TaoMaHDParam = true
	  	
	DECLARE @sShopCode varchar(max)
	DECLARE @ShopID varchar(15)
	select @sShopCode = ISNULL(TS.ShopCode,'') , @ShopID = TS.ShopID 
	From T_Shop TS INNER JOIN TRN_RT_BUYSELL PM ON TS.ShopID = PM.ShopID 
	Where PM.TrnID = @p_TrnID
    
	DECLARE @TaoMaHDParam int
	SET @TaoMaHDParam = (SELECT ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'TaoSoHDKhiThanhToan')
	IF (@TaoMaHDParam = 1)
		BEGIN
			EXEC SYS_BILL_COUNTER_Gen 'SRT', @sShopCode, @sBillCode OUTPUT
			UPDATE TRN_RT_BUYSELL SET BillCode = @sBillCode, Status='C', ThuHo = @p_ThuHo WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
		END
	ELSE
		UPDATE TRN_RT_BUYSELL SET Status='C', ThuHo = @p_ThuHo WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
		
	SET @sBillCode = (SELECT BillCode FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID)
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	if(isnull(@sBillCode,'') = '')
	begin
		SET @sErr = N'Không phát sinh được mã hóa đơn'
			GOTO ABORT
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_DATCOC DT join TRN_RT_BUYSELL_DatCoc BDC on DT.TrnID=BDC.DatCocID
	WHERE BDC.TrnID=@p_TrnID and DT.[Status]<>'P')
	BEGIN
		SET @sErr = N'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại phiếu đặt cọc'
			GOTO ABORT
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL_DatCoc where TrnID=@p_TrnID)
	BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_DATCOC DT join TRN_RT_BUYSELL_DatCoc BDC on DT.TrnID=BDC.DatCocID WHERE BDC.TrnID=@p_TrnID)
		BEGIN
			SET @sErr = N'Phiếu đặt cọc không tồn tại. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại'
			GOTO ABORT
		END
	END
		
	DECLARE @sCustID VARCHAR(20)
	DECLARE @sDebit NUMERIC(18,3)
	DECLARE @sOldDebit NUMERIC(18,3)
	DECLARE @CongNoBanLe nvarchar(500)
	SELECT @sDebit = s.DebitAmount,@sOldDebit=s.OldDebitAmount, @sCustID = s.CustID
	FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL s WHERE s.TrnID = @p_TrnID

	------------------Kiểm tra hàng mua lại có hợp lệ------------------------------
	SELECT TrnCode,CRDR,TrnID, ProductCode, ProductID, MaHangGoc
		into #Tracking
		FROM T_PRODUCT_TRACKING t
		WHERE STT = (select MAX(STT) from T_PRODUCT_TRACKING t1 where t.ProductCode = t1.ProductCode)
		and ProductCode in (select ProductCode from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_BUYGOLD where TrnID = @p_TrnID and ProductCode is not null and ProductCode <> '')

		if exists (select top 1 1 from #Tracking where TrnCode not in ('SRT', 'PRODOUT', 'CRT') and CRDR <> '-')
		begin
			SET @sErr = N'Mã hàng thu mua không ở tình trạng xuất bán'
			GOTO ABORT
		END

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	DECLARE @CachTichDiem nvarchar(100)
	SELECT  @CachTichDiem = FnValue FROM SYS_FUNCTION WHERE FnCode = '29'

	
	SELECT @CongNoBanLe = ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'CongNoBanLe'
	-- Hoạch toán công nợ thợ
	IF( @sDebit IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		declare @update table(TrnDate datetime,DebtAmount numeric(19,8))

		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM T_CUSTOMER_DEBT a
		          WHERE a.CustID = @sCustID AND a.GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong)
		BEGIN
			IF @CongNoBanLe = '1'
			BEGIN
				UPDATE T_CUSTOMER_DEBT
				SET Debt_Bal = CASE WHEN @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN Debt_Bal	+ (@sDebit-@sOldDebit)/1000
								ELSE Debt_Bal	+ (@sDebit-@sOldDebit) END,LastModify = GETDATE()
				output getdate() as TrnDate, inserted.Debt_Bal - deleted.Debt_Bal as DebtAmount
				into @update
				WHERE CustID = @sCustID AND GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			END
			ELSE IF @CongNoBanLe = '0'
			BEGIN
				UPDATE T_CUSTOMER_DEBT
				SET Debt_Bal = CASE WHEN @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN Debt_Bal + @sDebit/1000
								ELSE Debt_Bal + @sDebit END,LastModify = GETDATE()
				
				output getdate() as TrnDate, inserted.Debt_Bal - deleted.Debt_Bal as DebtAmount
				into @update
				WHERE CustID = @sCustID AND GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			END
		END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO T_CUSTOMER_DEBT(CustID,GoldCcy,Debt_Bal,LastModify)
				output getdate() as TrnDate, inserted.Debt_Bal as DebtAmount
				into @update
				VALUES(@sCustID, @MaTienTeHeThong, @sDebit/1000,GETDATE())
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			END

		INSERT INTO I_LichSuCongNo (TrnDate,TrnType,TrnID,IDLog,CustID,GoldCcy,DebtAmount, ShopID)
		select TrnDate,'SRT',@p_TrnID,null,@sCustID, @MaTienTeHeThong,DebtAmount, @ShopID
		from @update
		where DebtAmount <> 0
		IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	END
	    -- Update tình trạng xuất bán
		DECLARE pCurP CURSOR FOR
			SELECT ProductID, SL, TotalWeight,DiamondWeight,SectionID, ProductCode, TaskPrice
			FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL
			WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID

			OPEN pCurP
			FETCH NEXT FROM pCurP INTO @sProductID, @SL, @sTotalWeight_Sell,@sDiamondWeight_Sell, @sSectionIDBan, @sProductCode, @sTaskPrice

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @sQtyP = tp.SL,@sQtyR = tp.Real_SL, @sProductTypeCode = ProductTypeCode FROM T_PRODUCT tp
			WHERE ProductID = @sProductID
			IF(@sProductTypeCode = 'TTM' or @sProductTypeCode = 'DMN')
			BEGIN
				UPDATE T_PRODUCT
				SET	[Status]	= 'S',
					SellTrnID	= @p_TrnID,
					SellTrnType = 'SRT',
					SellOutDate = getdate()
				WHERE ProductID = @sProductID
					IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			END
			ELSE IF(@sProductTypeCode = 'KLT')
				BEGIN
					UPDATE SECTION_PRODUCT
      				SET [SL] = [SL] - isnull(@SL,1)
      				WHERE SectionID = @sSectionIDBan AND ProductCode = @sProductCode
					IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
				END
			ELSE IF(@sProductTypeCode = 'STN')
				BEGIN
					UPDATE T_PRODUCT
					SET	[Status]	= 'S',
						SellTrnID	= @p_TrnID,
						SellTrnType = 'SRT',
						SellOutDate = getdate()
					WHERE ProductID = @sProductID
					IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
				END
			ELSE IF(@sProductTypeCode = 'CTL')
				BEGIN
					UPDATE SECTION_PRODUCT
      				SET [SL] = [SL] - isnull(@SL,1),
      					TotalWeight = TotalWeight - @sTotalWeight_Sell,
      					DiamondWeight = DiamondWeight - @sDiamondWeight_Sell	
      				WHERE SectionID = @sSectionIDBan AND ProductCode = @sProductCode
					IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
				END
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM T_PRODUCT WHERE ProductCode = @sProductCode AND TaskPrice <> @sTaskPrice)
			BEGIN
			INSERT INTO ChangeTaskPrice_Log ([TrnID]
			,[ChangeType]
			,[ChangeDate]
			,[UserID]
			,[Productcode]
			,[OldTaskPrice]
			,[NewTaskPrice])
			select
			@p_TrnID
			,'SRT'
			,GETDATE()
			,@p_UserID
			,[ProductCode]
			,[TaskPrice]
			,@sTaskPrice
			from T_PRODUCT WHERE ProductCode = @sProductCode
		--GOTO ABORT
			END
			FETCH NEXT FROM pCurP INTO @sProductID, @SL, @sTotalWeight_Sell,@sDiamondWeight_Sell, @sSectionIDBan, @sProductCode, @sTaskPrice
		END
		CLOSE pCurP
		DEALLOCATE pCurP
		
	---- Insert Daily log ------------
	DECLARE @sSectionID varchar(15)
	DECLARE @sGoldCcy varchar(20), @sPriceUnit varchar(3)
	DECLARE @sQty INT
	DECLARE @sTotalWeight numeric(19,8), @sGoldWeight numeric(19,8), @sStampWeight numeric(19,8)
	DECLARE @sTrnDesc nvarchar(500), @sTrnDate varchar(10), @sTrnTime varchar(20), @sCRDR varchar(1),@sGiaBanMon NUMERIC(18,3)
	DECLARE @TrnRefCode VARCHAR(30)	
	DECLARE @RefCRDR VARCHAR(1)
	DECLARE @TrnRefID VARCHAR(15)
	SET @sTrnDate = convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 103)
	SET @sTrnTime = convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 108)
	SET @sTrnDesc = N'XUẤT BÁN HÀNG NGÀY ' + @sTrnDate
	SET @sCRDR = '-'

	DECLARE pCur CURSOR FOR
		SELECT SectionID, GoldCode, SUM(ISNULL(SL,1)) Qty, SUM(ISNULL(TotalWeight,0)) TotalWeight,
			SUM(ISNULL(TotalWeight,0) - ISNULL(DiamondWeight, 0)) GoldWeight,
			SUM(ISNULL(StampWeight,0)) StampWeight ,SUM(ISNULL(SellRate,0)) SellRate
		FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL
		WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
		GROUP BY SectionID, GoldCode

	OPEN pCur
	FETCH NEXT FROM pCur INTO @sSectionID, @sGoldCcy, @sQty, @sTotalWeight, @sGoldWeight, @sStampWeight, @sGiaBanMon

	-- Hoạch toán tồn kho
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT @sPriceUnit = PriceUnit FROM I_GOLD WHERE GoldCode = @sGoldCcy
		IF @sPriceUnit IN ('L','G','M')
		BEGIN
			-- Hoạch toán khối lượng tổng
			EXEC TRN_DAILY_LOG_Ins
				@p_RelatedID = @sSectionID,		@p_TrnRefID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnCode 	 = 'SRT',			@p_TrnType 	= 'RT',
				@p_TrnDate 	 = @sTrnDate,		@p_TrnTime 	= @sTrnTime,
				@p_GoldCcy	 = @sGoldCcy,		@p_CRDR 	= @sCRDR,
				@p_Amount 	 = @sTotalWeight,	@p_TrnDesc 	= @sTrnDesc,
				@p_AmountTag = 'PROD_WEI',		@p_Status 	= 'C',
				@p_UserID 	 = @p_UserID,		@p_IsDel 	= 'N'
			IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			-- Hoạch toán khối lượng vàng
			EXEC TRN_DAILY_LOG_Ins
				@p_RelatedID = @sSectionID,		@p_TrnRefID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnCode 	 = 'SRT',			@p_TrnType 	= 'RT',
				@p_TrnDate 	 = @sTrnDate,		@p_TrnTime 	= @sTrnTime,
				@p_GoldCcy	 = @sGoldCcy,		@p_CRDR 	= @sCRDR,
				@p_Amount 	 = @sGoldWeight,	@p_TrnDesc 	= @sTrnDesc,
				@p_AmountTag = 'PROD_GOLDWEI',	@p_Status 	= 'C',
				@p_UserID 	 = @p_UserID,		@p_IsDel 	= 'N'
			IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			-- Hoạch toán số lượng
			EXEC TRN_DAILY_LOG_Ins
				@p_RelatedID = @sSectionID,		@p_TrnRefID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnCode 	 = 'SRT',			@p_TrnType 	= 'RT',
				@p_TrnDate 	 = @sTrnDate,		@p_TrnTime 	= @sTrnTime,
				@p_GoldCcy	 = @sGoldCcy,		@p_CRDR 	= @sCRDR,
				@p_Amount 	 = @sQty,			@p_TrnDesc 	= @sTrnDesc,
				@p_AmountTag = 'PROD_QTY',		@p_Status 	= 'C',
				@p_UserID 	 = @p_UserID,		@p_IsDel 	= 'N'
			IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			-- Hoạch toán khối lượng tem
			EXEC TRN_DAILY_LOG_Ins
				@p_RelatedID = @sSectionID,		@p_TrnRefID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnCode 	 = 'SRT',			@p_TrnType 	= 'RT',
				@p_TrnDate 	 = @sTrnDate,		@p_TrnTime 	= @sTrnTime,
				@p_GoldCcy	 = @sGoldCcy,		@p_CRDR 	= @sCRDR,
				@p_Amount 	 = @sStampWeight,	@p_TrnDesc 	= @sTrnDesc,
				@p_AmountTag = 'PROD_STAMPWEI',	@p_Status 	= 'C',
				@p_UserID 	 = @p_UserID,		@p_IsDel 	= 'N'
			IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
						
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM pCur INTO @sSectionID, @sGoldCcy, @sQty, @sTotalWeight, @sGoldWeight, @sStampWeight,@sGiaBanMon
	END
	CLOSE pCur
	DEALLOCATE pCur

	--------------insert T_PRODUCT_TRACKING hàng bán ----------------------------------
	INSERT INTO T_PRODUCT_TRACKING (ProductID, ProductCode, TrnCode, CRDR, TrnID, TrnRefCode, RefCRDR, TrnRefID, MaHangGoc)
	select t.ProductID, t.ProductCode, 'SRT', '-', @p_TrnID, t.TrnCode, t.CRDR,t.TrnID , t.MaHangGoc
	from T_PRODUCT_TRACKING t
	inner join T_PRODUCT p on t.ProductCode = p.ProductCode
	where p.ProductTypeCode not in ('KLT','CTL') 
	and t.ProductCode in (select ProductCode from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL where TrnID = @p_TrnID)
	and STT = (select MAX(STT) from T_PRODUCT_TRACKING t1 where t.ProductCode = t1.ProductCode)
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	--------------insert T_PRODUCT_TRACKING hàng mua lại ----------------------------------
	INSERT INTO T_PRODUCT_TRACKING (ProductID, ProductCode, TrnCode, CRDR, TrnID, TrnRefCode, RefCRDR, TrnRefID, MaHangGoc)
	select t.ProductID, t.ProductCode, 'SRT', '+', @p_TrnID, t.TrnCode, t.CRDR,t.TrnID, t.MaHangGoc 
	from #Tracking t
	inner join T_PRODUCT p on t.ProductCode = p.ProductCode
	where p.ProductTypeCode not in ('KLT','CTL')
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	------ Insert TILL TXN -------------
	EXEC TRN_TILL_TXN_Ins
		@p_TrnID = @p_TrnID,
		@p_TrnType = 'RT',
		@p_TrnCode = 'SRT',
		@p_ErrCOde = @sErrCode OUT
		SET @sErr = (SELECT se.ErrorDesc
		               FROM SYS_ERROR se WHERE se.ErrorCode = @sErrCode)
	IF @sErrCode <> '0' GOTO ABORT

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rptSRT_PrintBill_HD3]
	@p_TrnID VARCHAR(15),
	@xemtruoc varchar(1)
AS
	DECLARE @sUP VARCHAR(3)
	SELECT @sUP=sp.ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS sp WHERE sp.ParaKey='UnitWeight'	
	DECLARE @sHeso NUMERIC(19,8) 
	SET @sHeso=dbo.fun_GetHS()
    DECLARE @MaTienTeHeThong Varchar(10)    
    SELECT @MaTienTeHeThong = ParaValue From SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'MaTienTeHeThong'

	select * 
	into #Buysell
	from TRN_RT_BUYSELL
	where TrnID = @p_TrnID
	and ((@xemtruoc = '0' and Status = 'C' and isnull(BillCode ,'') <> '') OR (@xemtruoc = '1' and Status = 'W'))

	declare @BillEnCode varchar(6000)

	select @BillEnCode = dbo.base64_encode(DB_NAME() + '@' + @@SERVERNAME + '@' + a.TrnID + '@' + REPLACE(a.BillCode,'-','') + '@' + a.[Status] + '@' + b.ProductCode)
	from #Buysell a
	left join TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL b on a.TrnID = b.TrnID
	where b.OrderBy = (select Min(OrderBy) from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL c where c.TrnID = a.TrnID)

	declare @DiemTL numeric(19,8)
	select @DiemTL = sum(DiemTichLuy) from I_LICHSUTICHLUYDIEM where TrnRefID = @p_TrnID
	
	declare @TongDiemTL numeric(19,8)
	select @TongDiemTL = sum(a.DiemTichLuy) 
	from I_LICHSUTICHLUYDIEM a
	where a.MaLichSuTichLuy < (select Min(MaLichSuTichLuy) from I_LICHSUTICHLUYDIEM b where a.CustID = b.CustID and b.TrnRefID = @p_TrnID)

	declare @GhiChu nvarchar(max)
	set @GhiChu = ''
	select @GhiChu = @GhiChu + Coalesce(isnull(Notes,''),'/')
	from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL
	where TrnID = @p_TrnID
	and Notes is not null and Notes <> ''

	declare @TongTienBot numeric(18,3)
	declare @TongCongBan numeric(18,3)
	declare @TongCongThem numeric(18,3)
	declare @SumGoldWeightSell NUMERIC(19,8), @SumDiamondWeightSell NUMERIC(19,8)
	select @TongTienBot = sum(isnull(Discounts,0)* XRate),
		   @TongCongBan = sum(isnull(TaskPrice,0)* XRateTaskPrice),
		   @TongCongThem = sum(isnull(TienCongThemMonHang,0)* XRateTaskPrice),
		   @SumGoldWeightSell = Sum(TotalWeight-ISNULL(DiamondWeight,0)), 
		   @SumDiamondWeightSell = Sum(DiamondWeight)
	from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL 
	where TrnID = @p_TrnID

	DECLARE @tbl TABLE

	select TP.ProductCodeDiamond

	from #Buysell BS
		join Trn_rt_buysell_Sell BSS on BSS.trnId=BS.TrnID
		join t_product TP on TP.ProductID = BSS.ProductID
		LEFT join (select MaKieu, MaDa, sum(SL) AS SL FROM KieuHang_Da GROUP BY MaKieu, MaDa) khd On khd.MaKieu = tp.MaKieu
		left join DanhMucDa dmd on khd.MaDa = dmd.MaDa 
	WHERE BS.TrnID = @p_TrnID and ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> ''
	group by TP.ProductCodeDiamond

select BSS.ProductID
	, CASE WHEN ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> '' THEN '' ELSE  BSS.ProductCode END AS ProductCode
	, CASE WHEN ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> '' THEN '' ELSE BSS.ProductDesc END AS ProductDesc
	, khd.SL ,dmd.TenDa, dmd.KichThuoc, dmd.GiaBan
	, ISNULL((SELECT TienDa FROM @tbl T1 WHERE T1.ProductCodeDiamond = BSS.ProductCode) * CASE WHEN BSS.PriceCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong AND @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN 1000 ELSE BSS.XRate END ,
	(khd.SL * dmd.GiaBan) * CASE WHEN BSS.PriceCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong AND @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN 1000 ELSE BSS.XRate END) AS TienDa
	, CASE WHEN ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> '' THEN 0 ELSE BSS.TotalWeight END AS TotalWeight
	, CASE WHEN ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> '' THEN 0 ELSE (BSS.TotalWeight - BSS.DiamondWeight) END AS GoldWeight
	, (BSS.TaskPrice * CASE WHEN BSS.PriceCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong AND @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN 1000 ELSE BSS.XRate END)  AS TaskPrice
	, CASE WHEN ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> '' THEN 0 ELSE (BSS.SellAmount - (BSS.TaskPrice * CASE WHEN BSS.PriceCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong AND @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN 1000 ELSE BSS.XRate END)) END AS SellAmount
	,(ISNULL((SELECT TienDa FROM @tbl T1 WHERE T1.ProductCodeDiamond = BSS.ProductCode) * CASE WHEN BSS.PriceCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong AND @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN 1000 ELSE BSS.XRate END, 0)
		+ CASE WHEN ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> '' THEN 0 ELSE BSS.SellAmount END) AS PayAmount --SellAmount da co cong TaskPrice
	, TP.ProductCodeDiamond 
	, CASE WHEN ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> '' THEN '' ELSE  tpi.Image END AS [Image], tp.RingSize

	LEFT JOIN TRN_PRODUCT_IN tpi ON tpi.TrnID = Tp.InTrnID
	LEFT join (select MaKieu, MaDa, sum(SL) AS SL FROM KieuHang_Da GROUP BY MaKieu, MaDa) khd On khd.MaKieu = tp.MaKieu
	left join DanhMucDa dmd on khd.MaDa = dmd.MaDa 
WHERE BS.TrnID = @p_TrnID
ORDER BY BSS.ProductCode

-- 17_ShowPic --
	SELECT tpi.PriceUnit, tpi.[Image] 
		FROM #Buysell RT	
	LEFT JOIN TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL SRT ON SRT.TrnID = RT.TrnID
	LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT tp ON tp.ProductID=SRT.ProductID
	LEFT JOIN TRN_PRODUCT_IN tpi ON tpi.TrnID=tp.InTrnID
	LEFT JOIN I_PRODUCT_GROUP PG ON PG.GroupID = SRT.GroupID
	LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER C ON C.CustID = RT.CustID
	LEFT JOIN I_GOLD IG ON IG.GoldCode = SRT.GoldCode
	WHERE SRT.TrnID = @p_TrnID

--18_DATCOC--
	SELECT BSC.TrnID, DC.BillCode, DC.TrnDate, DC.TrnTime, CustName, DC.TienCoc, DC.Description, DC.CashPay, DC.CardPay,
	DCD.ProductDesc, IG.GoldDesc, DCD.TotalWeight, DCD.DiamondWeight, DCD.GoldWeight, DCD.TaskPrice, DCD.Size, DCD.SL, DCD.Notes
	FROM #Buysell BS
	JOIN TRN_RT_BUYSELL_DATCOC BSC on BS.TrnID=BSC.TrnID
	LEFT JOIN TRN_DATCOC DC on BSC.DatCocID=DC.TrnID
	LEFT JOIN TRN_DATCOC_DT DCD on DC.TrnID=DCD.TrnID
	LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER IC on DC.CustID=IC.CustID
	LEFT JOIN I_GOLD IG on DCD.GoldCode=IG.GoldCode
	WHERE BS.TrnID=@p_TrnID
	--=================================================
	DECLARE @SELL TABLE(ProductCode VARCHAR(15))
	INSERT INTO @SELL
	SELECT ProductCode FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL_BUYGOLD WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID 

	DECLARE @SELL_SELL TABLE(ProductCode VARCHAR(15), SellAmount NUMERIC(18,3), TaskPrice NUMERIC(18,3), Discounts NUMERIC(18,3), SellRate NUMERIC(18,3))
	INSERT INTO @SELL_SELL(ProductCode, SellAmount,TaskPrice,Discounts, SellRate)
	SELECT ProductCode, SellAmount,TaskPrice,Discounts, SellRate FROM dbo.TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL WHERE ProductCode IN (select ProductCode from @SELL)

	DECLARE @Tracking TABLE(TrnID VARCHAR(15),ProductCode VARCHAR(15), TotalWeight NUMERIC(19,8), DiamondWeight NUMERIC(19,8), GoldWeight NUMERIC(19,8)
	,BuyRate NUMERIC(18,3),GoldCode VARCHAR(15), BuyAmount NUMERIC(18,3),
	DiamondClarity varchar(50),DiamondColor varchar(50),DiamondFacet varchar(50),DiamondNumber varchar(50),DiamondSize varchar(50), Image IMAGE,
	SellAmount NUMERIC(18,3), TaskPrice NUMERIC(18,3), Discounts NUMERIC(18,3), SellRate NUMERIC(18,3), ProductDesc NVARCHAR(MAX), GoldDesc NVARCHAR(MAX))
	
	INSERT INTO @Tracking(TrnID,ProductCode,TotalWeight
	,DiamondWeight,GoldWeight,BuyRate,GoldCode,BuyAmount,DiamondClarity, DiamondColor, DiamondFacet,DiamondNumber, DiamondSize,	
	Image, SellAmount,TaskPrice,Discounts, SellRate,ProductDesc,GoldDesc)
	
	SELECT TRBB.TrnID,p.ProductCode, case when p.WeightUnit = 'L' then p.TotalWeight/@sHeso else p.TotalWeight end TotalWeight, 
	case when p.WeightUnit = 'L' then p.DiamondWeight/@sHeso else p.DiamondWeight end DiamondWeight, 
	case when p.WeightUnit = 'L' then (p.TotalWeight-p.DiamondWeight)/@sHeso else (p.TotalWeight-p.DiamondWeight) end GoldWeight,
	TRBB.BuyRate,p.GoldCode,TRBB.BuyAmount BuyAmount,
	p.DiamondClarity, p.DiamondColor, p.DiamondFacet,p.DiamondNumber,p.DiamondSize
	, TPI.Image, ss.SellAmount, ss.TaskPrice, ss.Discounts,ss.SellRate,p.ProductDesc,IG.GoldDesc
	FROM T_PRODUCT p
	LEFT JOIN dbo.I_GOLD IG ON IG.GoldCode = p.GoldCode
	LEFT JOIN dbo.TRN_PRODUCT_IN TPI ON  TPI.TrnID= p.InTrnID
	LEFT JOIN TRN_RT_BUYSELL_BUYGOLD TRBB ON TRBB.ProductCode = p.ProductCode AND TRBB.TrnID = @p_TrnID
	LEFT JOIN @SELL_SELL SS ON p.ProductCode = SS.ProductCode
	WHERE p.ProductCode in (select ProductCode from @SELL)

	--19_VDSP--
	SELECT * FROM @Tracking

	--20_VDSP--
	SELECT * FROM @Tracking

	--Thanh toán thẻ--    LUÔN LUÔN NẰM CUỐI --- không đánh số cố định
	DECLARE @QRCode VARBINARY(MAX)
	SET @QRCode = NULL

	DECLARE @MoTaTTThe NVARCHAR(200)
	SELECT @MoTaTTThe = TRB.BillCode + TE.EmpName FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL TRB 
	LEFT JOIN dbo.T_EMPLOYEE TE ON TE.EmpID = TRB.EmpID 
	WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID

	IF	EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL_CardPay WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID)
	BEGIN
		--Có thanh toán thẻ
		SELECT TRBC.Amount, ib.AccName, ib.NumberBank, tb.Bin , @MoTaTTThe MoTaTTThe, tb.ShortName BankName, ib.BankBranch, @QRCode QRCode
		FROM dbo.TRN_RT_BUYSELL_CardPay TRBC
		INNER JOIN dbo.I_BankCard ib ON TRBC.IDCard = ib.NumberBank
		LEFT JOIN dbo.T_BANK tb ON ib.BankKey = tb.Id
		WHERE TRBC.TrnID = @p_TrnID
	END
	ELSE	
	BEGIN
		--Không có thanh toán thẻ. Lấy từ tài khoản mặc định cho cửa hàng
		DECLARE @Amount NUMERIC(18,3)
		DECLARE @ShopID NVARCHAR(200)
		SELECT @Amount = TotalAmount, @ShopID = ShopID FROM dbo.TRN_RT_BUYSELL WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID	
		SELECT @Amount Amount, ib.AccName, ib.NumberBank, tb.Bin , @MoTaTTThe MoTaTTThe, tb.ShortName BankName, ib.BankBranch, @QRCode QRCode
		FROM dbo.I_BankCard ib
		LEFT JOIN dbo.T_BANK tb ON ib.BankKey = tb.Id
		WHERE ib.TaiKhoanMacDinh = 1 AND ib.ShopID = @ShopID
	END

IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME='RetailLog')
BEGIN
/* BEGIN: Ghi lại log thực thi */
if exists (select top 1 1 from TRN_RT_BUYSELL where TrnID = @p_TrnID)
begin
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
	select getdate() DateLog, 'rptSRT_PrintBill_HD3' StoreName, TrnID, BillCode, @xemtruoc + ' - TinhTrang' + [Status] LogMsg,
	ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
	from TRN_RT_BUYSELL where TrnID = @p_TrnID
end
else
begin
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
	select getdate() DateLog, 'rptSRT_PrintBill_HD3' StoreName, @p_TrnID TrnID, '' BillCode, @xemtruoc + '- LostData' LogMsg,
	ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
end
/* END: Ghi lại log thực thi */
END

name: rptCRT_PrintBill
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rptCRT_PrintBill]
	@p_TrnID VARCHAR(15),
	@xemtruoc VARCHAR(1)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @sUP VARCHAR(3)
	SELECT @sUP=sp.ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS sp WHERE sp.ParaKey='UnitWeight'
	DECLARE @sHeso NUMERIC(19,8)
    SET @sHeso=dbo.fun_GetHS()
	DECLARE @MaTienTeHeThong Varchar(10)    
    SELECT @MaTienTeHeThong = ParaValue From SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'MaTienTeHeThong'
	
	select * 
	into #CHANGE
	from TRN_RT_CHANGE
	where TrnID = @p_TrnID
	and ((@xemtruoc = '0' and Status = 'C' and isnull(BillCode ,'') <> '') OR (@xemtruoc = '1' and Status = 'W'))
	
	declare @BillEnCode varchar(6000)

	select @BillEnCode = dbo.base64_encode(DB_NAME() + '@' + @@SERVERNAME + '@' + a.TrnID + '@' + REPLACE(a.BillCode,'-','') + '@' + a.[Status] + '@' + b.ProductCode)
	from #CHANGE a
	left join TRN_RT_CHANGE_SELL b on a.TrnID = b.TrnID
	where b.ProductCode = (select Min(ProductCode) from TRN_RT_CHANGE_SELL c where c.TrnID = a.TrnID)

	DECLARE @vQuyTuoiDeTrongDoiBu varchar(15)
	SELECT @vQuyTuoiDeTrongDoiBu = ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'QuyTuoiDeTrongDoiBu'

	declare @DiemTL numeric(19,8)
	select @DiemTL = sum(DiemTichLuy) from I_LICHSUTICHLUYDIEM where TrnRefID = @p_TrnID
	
	declare @TongDiemTL numeric(19,8)
	select @TongDiemTL = sum(a.DiemTichLuy) 
	from I_LICHSUTICHLUYDIEM a
	where a.MaLichSuTichLuy < (select Min(MaLichSuTichLuy) from I_LICHSUTICHLUYDIEM b where a.CustID = b.CustID and b.TrnRefID = @p_TrnID)

	declare @BankName nvarchar(max)
	set @BankName = ''
	select @BankName = @BankName + Coalesce(isnull(BC.BankName,''),'/')
	from TRN_RT_CHANGE_CardPay SCP
	inner join I_BankCard BC on SCP.IDCard = BC.NumberBank
	where TrnID = @p_TrnID

	declare @SumGoldWeightSell NUMERIC(19,8), @SumDiamondWeightSell NUMERIC(19,8)
	select @SumGoldWeightSell = Sum(TotalWeight-ISNULL(DiamondWeight,0)+ ISNULL(CatNi,0)), 
	@SumDiamondWeightSell = Sum(DiamondWeight)
	from TRN_RT_CHANGE_SELL
	where TrnID = @p_TrnID

	declare @SumGoldWeightBG NUMERIC(19,8), @SumDiamondWeightBG NUMERIC(19,8)
	select @SumGoldWeightBG = Sum(GoldWeight), 
	@SumDiamondWeightBG = Sum(DiamondWeight)
	from TRN_RT_CHANGE_BUYGOLD
	where TrnID = @p_TrnID

	declare @TienQT numeric(18,3)
	declare @TienCK numeric(18,3)

	Select @TienQT = Sum(Amount) -- Quẹt thẻ
	From TRN_RT_CHANGE_CardPay
	Where PayType='QT' and TrnID = @p_TrnID

	Select @TienCK = Sum(Amount) -- Chuyển khoản
	From TRN_RT_CHANGE_CardPay
	Where PayType='CK' and TrnID = @p_TrnID

	DECLARE @HinhAnh TABLE(ProductCode varchar(20), Image VARBINARY(MAX))

	DECLARE @ProductCode NVARCHAR(50)
	DECLARE @ImagePath NVARCHAR(1000)
	DECLARE @FileExists INT

	DECLARE @LuuAnhBangDuongDan int
	SELECT @LuuAnhBangDuongDan = ParaValue FROM dbo.SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'LuuAnhBangDuongDan'

	IF @LuuAnhBangDuongDan = 1
	BEGIN
		
		DECLARE cursorProduct CURSOR FOR 
		SELECT DISTINCT ss.ProductCode, tpi.ImagePath from TRN_RT_CHANGE_SELL ss
		INNER JOIN dbo.T_PRODUCT tp ON ss.ProductCode = tp.ProductCode
		LEFT JOIN TRN_PRODUCT_IN tpi ON tpi.TrnID=tp.InTrnID
		WHERE ss.TrnID = @p_TrnID

		OPEN cursorProduct       

		FETCH NEXT FROM cursorProduct   
			  INTO @ProductCode, @ImagePath

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0        
		BEGIN           
			-- Kiểm tra xem tệp tồn tại hay không
			IF @ImagePath <> '' AND @ImagePath IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @SqlQuery NVARCHAR(MAX);
				SET @SqlQuery = N'SELECT ''' + @ProductCode + ''' ProductCode, BulkColumn FROM OPENROWSET(BULK ''' + @ImagePath + ''', SINGLE_BLOB) AS ImageData;';
				INSERT INTO @HinhAnh(ProductCode,Image)
				EXEC sp_executesql @SqlQuery 
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @HinhAnh(ProductCode,Image)
				SELECT @ProductCode,NULL
			END

			FETCH NEXT FROM cursorProduct 
				  INTO @ProductCode,@ImagePath
		END

		CLOSE cursorProduct              
		DEALLOCATE cursorProduct 
		SET @FileExists = 1
    END
	ELSE
    BEGIN
		SET @FileExists = 0
    END

	DECLARE @TotalAmountHDDT NUMERIC(19,8)
	select @TotalAmountHDDT = SUM(AmountHDDT) from TRN_RT_CHANGE_SELL where TrnID = @p_TrnID
	--if @TotalAmountHDDT is null
	--BEGIN
	--	select @TotalAmountHDDT = SUM(dbo.fn_LamTronVND(Round(CASE WHEN IG.WeightUnit='L' THEN ((ISNULL(SRT.TotalWeight, 0) - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)+ ISNULL(SRT.CatNi,0))*ISNULL(SRT.DSellRate,0)/100 + SRT.TaskPrice) * ISNULL(SRT.CcyRate,0) else ((ISNULL(SRT.TotalWeight, 0) - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)+ ISNULL(SRT.CatNi,0))*ISNULL(SRT.DSellRate,0)+ SRT.TaskPrice) *ISNULL(SRT.CcyRate,0) end,0)))
	--	from TRN_RT_CHANGE_SELL SRT
	--	LEFT JOIN I_GOLD IG ON IG.GoldCode = SRT.GoldCode
	--	where TrnID = @p_TrnID
	--	SELECT @TotalAmountHDDT = @TotalAmountHDDT - Discount + AddMoney + TaskPriceAdd 
	--	from TRN_RT_CHANGE 
	--	where TrnID = @p_TrnID
	--END

  SELECT CRT.TrnDate, CRT.TrnTime, CRT.BillCode, CustCode, CustName, c.Address CustAddress,c. Phone, TS.SectionName,TM.MainSectionName,
    CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' THEN  TotalGoldWeight/@sHeso ELSE TotalGoldWeight END TotalGoldWeight ,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar(TotalGoldWeight,tp.WeightUnit) TotalGoldWeightChar,dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(TotalGoldWeight,tp.WeightUnit) TotalGoldWeightChar_Bill,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar(SellGOldWeight,tp.WeightUnit) TotalSellGoldWeightChar, dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(SellGOldWeight,tp.WeightUnit) TotalSellGoldWeightChar_Bill,
    CRT.SellRate, TotalAmount, TotalTaskPrice, ChangeAmount, TotalDiamondPrice,
    TotalAllAmount, Discount, PayAmount,PG.GroupName,
    ISNULL(CRT.TaskPriceAdd,0) TaskPriceAdd,SupplierName,
    SRT.ProductCode, SRT.ProductDesc, GoldDesc,
    CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' then (SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) + ISNULL(CatNi,0))/@sHeso ELSE (SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) + ISNULL(CatNi,0)) END RealGoldWeight,
    CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' then (SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0))/@sHeso ELSE (SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)) END GoldWeight,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar((SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) + ISNULL(CatNi,0)),tp.WeightUnit) RealGoldWeightChar,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill((SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) + ISNULL(CatNi,0)),tp.WeightUnit) RealGoldWeightChar_Bill,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar((SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)),tp.WeightUnit) GoldWeightChar, dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill((SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)),tp.WeightUnit) GoldWeightChar_Bill,
    CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' THEN  ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)/@sHeso ELSE ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) END DiamondWeight,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar(ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0),tp.WeightUnit) DiamondWeightChar,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0),tp.WeightUnit) DiamondWeightChar_Bill,
    isnull(SRT.DiamondPrice,0) DiamondPrice,
    SRT.TaskPrice, emp.EmpName, 
    CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' THEN SRT.CatNi/@sHeso ELSE SRT.CatNi END CatNi,
	dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(ISNULL(CatNi,0),tp.WeightUnit) CatNiChar,
    CRT.AddMoney, CRT.TaskPriceAdd, tp.RingSize,
    CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' then (SRT.TotalWeight + ISNULL(CatNi,0))/@sHeso ELSE (SRT.TotalWeight + ISNULL(CatNi,0)) END RealTotalWeight,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar((SRT.TotalWeight + ISNULL(CatNi,0)),tp.WeightUnit) RealTotalWeightChar, ISNULL(SRT.SL,1) SL, SRT.DSellRate,
    CRT.CreatedBy MaNguoiLap, SU.UserName TenNguoiLap, tpi.Description, tpi.Description2, tpi.Description3, tpi.Description4, tpi.Description5,SRT.GoldCode,IG.GoldAge, tpi.TuoiPho,
	CASE WHEN HA.Image IS NOT NULL THEN HA.Image ELSE tpi.Image END Image,
	--tpi.Image,
	ID.DiemDoiQua, tp.PriceUnit, tp.WeightUnit, CRT.TienDoiQua, SP.SupplierCode, SRT.InPrice AS CongVon, CRT.NoCu, CRT.KhachTra, CRT.NoMoi,
	case when txnd.CRDR = '-' then -Isnull(txnd.Amount,0) else Isnull(txnd.Amount,0) end CashPay, CardPay,
	ID.DiemTichLuy as DiemTLHienTai, isnull(@DiemTL,0) as DiemTLHoaDon, ISNULL(@TongDiemTL,0) DiemTLTruocHD,
		CRT.DiemConLai +  isnull((idq.DiemDoiQua * idq.SoLuong),0) - isnull(@DiemTL,0) as TongDiemTruocDoi, 
		isnull((idq.DiemDoiQua * idq.SoLuong),0) DiemDoiQuaHD, CRT.DiemConLai TongDiemSauDoi,
	(SELECT [value] FROM [ThanhTienSJC](CRT.TrnID) WHERE [name] = 'TienVangMoi') TienVangMoiSJC,
	(SELECT [value] FROM [ThanhTienSJC](CRT.TrnID) WHERE [name] = 'TienVangCu') TienVangCuSJC,
	CRT.Description GhiChu, C.Masothue MaSoThue,c.Company_Address DiaChiCongTy, C.Company TenCongTy, isnull(CP.BankName, @BankName) BankName, CRT.PhanTramBuLo, CRT.TienLo,
	CRT.ThuHo, CRT.TienCoc, SRT.TienCongThemMonHang, dbo.GoldWeightToChar(@SumGoldWeightSell,tp.WeightUnit) SumGoldWeightSellChar,
	dbo.GoldWeightToChar(@SumDiamondWeightSell,tp.WeightUnit) SumDiamondWeightSellChar, ISNULL(@TienQT,0) TienQT, ISNULL(@TienCK,0) TienCK, @BillEnCode BillEnCode,SRT.Discounts,
	C.CMND, C.BirthDate,C.Email,C.NgayCap,C.NoiCap,C.GhiChu2,C.GhiChu3, C.Notes NotesCust, CRT.SoHDTuNhap, till.TillName, @TotalAmountHDDT SellAmount
  FROM #CHANGE CRT
  LEFT JOIN TRN_RT_CHANGE_SELL SRT ON SRT.TrnID=CRT.TrnID
  LEFT JOIN I_PRODUCT_GROUP PG ON PG.GroupID = SRT.GroupID -----nhom Hang
  LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER C ON C.CustID = CRT.CustID
  LEFT JOIN I_GOLD IG ON IG.GoldCode = SRT.GoldCode
  LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT tp ON tp.ProductCode =SRT.ProductCode
  LEFT JOIN T_SECTION TS ON TP.SectionID = TS.SectionID
  LEFT JOIN T_MAINSECTION TM ON TM.MainSectionID = TS.MainSectionID
  LEFT JOIN TRN_PRODUCT_IN tpi ON tpi.TrnID = tp.InTrnID
  LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE emp ON CRT.EmpID = emp.EmpID
  LEFT JOIN T_SUPPLIER SP ON SP.SupplierID= TP.SupplierID
  LEFT JOIN SYS_USERS SU ON SU.UserID = CRT.CreatedBy
  LEFT JOIN I_DIEMTICHLUY ID ON ID.CustID = CRT.CustID
  left join T_TILL_TXN txn on CRT.TrnID = txn.TrnRefID
  left join T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL txnd on txn.TillTxnID = txnd.TillTxnID and txnd.GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong
  left join T_TILL till on txnd.TillID = till.TillID
  left join T_TILL_CARDPAY CP on CP.TillTxnID = txn.TillTxnID
  left join I_DOIQUA idq on idq.MaDoiQua = CRT.MaDoiQua
  LEFT JOIN @HinhAnh HA ON HA.ProductCode = SRT.ProductCode AND HA.ProductCode = tp.ProductCode
  WHERE CRT.TrnID = @p_TrnID
  order by SRT.OrderBy, SRT.ProductCode

  -- 0_ShowPic --
  SELECT  CASE WHEN tpi.ImagePath IS NOT NULL AND tpi.ImagePath <> '' THEN HA.Image ELSE tpi.Image END Image
    FROM #CHANGE CRT
  LEFT JOIN TRN_RT_CHANGE_SELL SRT ON SRT.TrnID=CRT.TrnID
  LEFT JOIN I_PRODUCT_GROUP PG ON PG.GroupID = SRT.GroupID -----nhom Hang
  LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER C ON C.CustID = CRT.CustID
  LEFT JOIN I_GOLD IG ON IG.GoldCode = SRT.GoldCode
  LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT tp ON tp.ProductCode =SRT.ProductCode
  LEFT JOIN TRN_PRODUCT_IN tpi ON tpi.TrnID = tp.InTrnID
  LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE emp ON CRT.EmpID = emp.EmpID
  LEFT JOIN @HinhAnh HA ON HA.ProductCode = SRT.ProductCode AND HA.ProductCode = tp.ProductCode
  WHERE CRT.TrnID = @p_TrnID

DECLARE @OldGold TABLE (GoldDesc NVARCHAR(100), GoldWeight NUMERIC(19,8), DiamondWeight NUMERIC(19,8), DiamondWeightChar varchar(1000),
DiamondWeightChar_Bill varchar(1000), GoldWeightChar varchar(1000), GoldWeightChar_Bill varchar(1000),TotalGoldWeight NUMERIC(19,8),
GoldWeightChange NUMERIC(19,8), ChangeRate NUMERIC(18,3), TLVangConLai NUMERIC(19,8), TLVangBu NUMERIC(19,8), 
TLVangBuChar varchar(1000),TLVangBuChar_Bill varchar(1000), TLVangConLaiChar varchar(1000), TLVangConLaiChar_Bill varchar(1000),
TotalGoldWeightChar varchar(1000), TotalGoldWeightChar_Bill varchar(1000), XRate NUMERIC(18,3), PriceUnit VARCHAR(3),
WeightUnit VARCHAR(10), PercentValue NUMERIC(18,3), Dirty NUMERIC(19,8), PhanTramBuLo numeric(18, 2), SumGoldWeightBGChar VarChar(1000), SumDiamondWeightBGChar VarChar(1000))

DECLARE @NewGold TABLE (TrnDate DATETIME, BillCode NVARCHAR(100), CustCode NVARCHAR(100), CustName NVARCHAR(500), CustAddress NVARCHAR(500), 
SectionName NVARCHAR(500), MainSectionName  NVARCHAR(200),TotalGoldWeight NUMERIC(19,8), TotalGoldWeightChar varchar(1000), 
TotalGoldWeightChar_Bill varchar(1000), TotalSellGoldWeightChar varchar(1000),TotalSellGoldWeightChar_Bill varchar(1000), SellRate NUMERIC(18,3), 
TotalAmount NUMERIC(18,3), TotalTaskPrice NUMERIC(18,3), ChangeAmount NUMERIC(18,3), TaskPriceAdd NUMERIC(18,3),
TotalAllAmount NUMERIC(18,3), Discount NUMERIC(18,3), PayAmount NUMERIC(18,3), GroupName NVARCHAR(300),SupplierName NVARCHAR(200),TotalDiamondPrice NUMERIC(18,3),
ProductCode NVARCHAR(100), ProductDesc NVARCHAR(500), GoldDesc NVARCHAR(100), RealGoldWeight NUMERIC(19,8), GoldWeight NUMERIC(19,8), RealGoldWeightChar varchar(1000),
RealGoldWeightChar_Bill varchar(1000), GoldWeightChar varchar(1000), GoldWeightChar_Bill varchar(1000), DiamondWeight NUMERIC(19,8),
DiamondWeightChar varchar(1000), DiamondWeightChar_Bill varchar(1000), DiamondPrice NUMERIC(18,3), TaskPrice NUMERIC(18,3), 
[Image] Image, RealTotalWeight NUMERIC(19,8), RealTotalWeightChar varchar(1000), 
SL INT, XRate NUMERIC(18,3), DSellRate NUMERIC(18,3), CatNi NUMERIC(19,8), CatNiChar VARCHAR(50),Description NVARCHAR(MAX), Description2 NVARCHAR(MAX), 
Description3 NVARCHAR(MAX), Description4 NVARCHAR(MAX), Description5 NVARCHAR(MAX),RingSize NUMERIC(10,2),GoldCode VARCHAR(10), 
GoldAge NUMERIC(18,2), TuoiPho NVARCHAR(100), PriceUnit VARCHAR(3),WeightUnit VARCHAR(10), SupplierCode NVARCHAR(50), CongVon NUMERIC(18,3),
GhiChu nvarchar(max), TienCongThemMonHang NUMERIC(18,3), SumGoldWeightSellChar varchar(1000), SumDiamondWeightSellChar varchar(1000),Discounts NUMERIC(18,3),
SellAmount NUMERIC(18,2),SellAmountNoTaskPrice NUMERIC(18,2))

  -- 1_OldGold --
  INSERT INTO @OldGold
  SELECT GoldDesc,
      CASE WHEN IG.WeightUnit='L' THEN  GoldWeight/@sHeso ELSE GoldWeight END GoldWeight,
      CASE WHEN IG.WeightUnit='L' THEN  ISNULL(DiamondWeight,0)/@sHeso ELSE ISNULL(DiamondWeight,0) END  DiamondWeight,
      dbo.GoldWeightToChar(ISNULL(DiamondWeight,0),IG.WeightUnit) DiamondWeightChar,dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(ISNULL(DiamondWeight,0),IG.WeightUnit) DiamondWeightChar_Bill,
      dbo.GoldWeightToChar(GoldWeight,IG.WeightUnit) GoldWeightChar,dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(GoldWeight,IG.WeightUnit) GoldWeightChar_Bill,
      BRT.TotalGoldWeight,CASE WHEN IG.WeightUnit='L' THEN  GoldWeightChange/@sHeso ELSE GoldWeightChange END GoldWeightChange,
      ChangeRate,GoldWeightChange TLVangConLai,ChangeGoldWeight AS TLVangBu, 
	dbo.GoldWeightToChar(ChangeGoldWeight,IG.WeightUnit) TLVangBuChar,
	dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(ChangeGoldWeight,IG.WeightUnit) TLVangBuChar_Bill,  
	dbo.GoldWeightToChar(CASE WHEN @vQuyTuoiDeTrongDoiBu = 1 
							  THEN GoldWeightChange 
							  ELSE CASE WHEN IG.WeightUnit='L' 
										THEN  BRT.GoldWeight/@sHeso ELSE BRT.GoldWeight END END,
						IG.WeightUnit) TLVangConLaiChar,
	dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(GoldWeightChange,IG.WeightUnit) TLVangConLaiChar_Bill,
      dbo.GoldWeightToChar(BRT.TotalGoldWeight,IG.WeightUnit) TotalGoldWeightChar,
	dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(BRT.TotalGoldWeight,IG.WeightUnit) TotalGoldWeightChar_Bill,
	--ISNULL(dbo.fn_GetXRate(BRT.GoldCode,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),RTC.TrnDate,103),TrnTime,@ShopID),0) XRate,
	ISNULL(BRT.BuyRate,0) XRate,
	IG.PriceUnit,IG.WeightUnit, BRT.PercentValue,
	CASE WHEN IG.WeightUnit='L' THEN  BRT.Dirty/@sHeso ELSE BRT.Dirty END Dirty, BRT.PhanTramBuLo,
	dbo.GoldWeightToChar(@SumGoldWeightBG,IG.WeightUnit) SumGoldWeightBGChar,
	dbo.GoldWeightToChar(@SumDiamondWeightBG,IG.WeightUnit) SumDiamondWeightBGChar
  FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE_BUYGOLD BRT INNER JOIN #CHANGE RTC ON BRT.TrnID = RTC.TrnID
  LEFT JOIN I_GOLD IG ON IG.GoldCode = BRT.GoldCode
  WHERE BRT.TrnID = @p_TrnID
  
  SELECT * FROM @OldGold

  -- 2_NewGold --
  INSERT INTO @NewGold
    SELECT  CRT.TrnDate, CRT.BillCode, CustCode, CustName, c.Address CustAddress,TS.SectionName,TM.MainSectionName,
    CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' THEN  TotalGoldWeight/@sHeso ELSE TotalGoldWeight END TotalGoldWeight ,dbo.GoldWeightToChar(TotalGoldWeight,tp.WeightUnit) TotalGoldWeightChar,dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(TotalGoldWeight,tp.WeightUnit) TotalGoldWeightChar_Bill,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar(SellGOldWeight,IG.WeightUnit) TotalSellGoldWeightChar,dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(SellGOldWeight,tp.WeightUnit) TotalSellGoldWeightChar_Bill,
    CRT.SellRate, TotalAmount, TotalTaskPrice, ChangeAmount,ISNULL(CRT.TaskPriceAdd,0) TaskPriceAdd,
    TotalAllAmount, Discount, PayAmount,PG.GroupName,SupplierName,TotalDiamondPrice,
    SRT.ProductCode, SRT.ProductDesc, GoldDesc,
    CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' THEN (SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) + ISNULL(CatNi,0))/@sHeso ELSE (SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) + ISNULL(CatNi,0)) END RealGoldWeight,
    CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' THEN (SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0))/@sHeso ELSE (SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)) END GoldWeight,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar((SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) + ISNULL(CatNi,0)),tp.WeightUnit) RealGoldWeightChar,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill((SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) + ISNULL(CatNi,0)),tp.WeightUnit) RealGoldWeightChar_Bill,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar((SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)),tp.WeightUnit) GoldWeightChar,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill((SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)),tp.WeightUnit) GoldWeightChar_Bill,
    CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' THEN  ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)/@sHeso ELSE ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) END   DiamondWeight,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar(ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0),tp.WeightUnit) DiamondWeightChar,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0),tp.WeightUnit) DiamondWeightChar_Bill,
    ISNULL(SRT.DiamondPrice,0) DiamondPrice,
    SRT.TaskPrice, --tpi.[Image],
	CASE WHEN HA.Image IS NOT NULL THEN HA.Image ELSE tpi.Image END Image,
    CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' THEN (SRT.TotalWeight + ISNULL(CatNi,0))/@sHeso ELSE (SRT.TotalWeight + ISNULL(CatNi,0)) END RealTotalWeight,
    dbo.GoldWeightToChar((SRT.TotalWeight + ISNULL(CatNi,0)),tp.WeightUnit) RealTotalWeightChar, ISNULL(SRT.SL,1) SL,
	--ISNULL(dbo.fn_GetXRate(SRT.GoldCode,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),CRT.TrnDate,103),CRT.TrnTime,@ShopID),0) XRate, 
	ISNULL(SRT.DSellRate,0) XRate, 
	SRT.DSellRate,
    CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' THEN SRT.CatNi/@sHeso ELSE SRT.CatNi END CatNi,
	dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(ISNULL(CatNi,0),tp.WeightUnit) CatNiChar,
    tpi.Description, tpi.Description2, tpi.Description3, tpi.Description4, tpi.Description5, tp.RingSize,SRT.GoldCode,IG.GoldAge, tpi.TuoiPho,
	tp.PriceUnit,tp.WeightUnit, SP.SupplierCode, SRT.InPrice AS CongVon, CRT.Description GhiChu, SRT.TienCongThemMonHang,
	dbo.GoldWeightToChar(@SumGoldWeightSell,tp.WeightUnit) SumGoldWeightSellChar,
	dbo.GoldWeightToChar(@SumDiamondWeightSell,tp.WeightUnit) SumDiamondWeightSellChar,SRT.Discounts,
	Round(CASE WHEN IG.WeightUnit='L' THEN ((ISNULL(SRT.TotalWeight, 0) - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)+ ISNULL(SRT.CatNi,0))*ISNULL(SRT.DSellRate,0)/100 + SRT.TaskPrice) * ISNULL(SRT.CcyRate,0) else ((ISNULL(SRT.TotalWeight, 0) - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)+ ISNULL(SRT.CatNi,0))*ISNULL(SRT.DSellRate,0)+ SRT.TaskPrice) *ISNULL(SRT.CcyRate,0) end,0) as SellAmount, 
	ROUND(CASE WHEN IG.WeightUnit='L' THEN ((ISNULL(SRT.TotalWeight, 0) - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)+ ISNULL(SRT.CatNi,0))*ISNULL(SRT.DSellRate,0)/100) * ISNULL(CRT.CcyRate,0) else ((ISNULL(SRT.TotalWeight, 0) - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)+ ISNULL(SRT.CatNi,0))*ISNULL(SRT.DSellRate,0)) *ISNULL(CRT.CcyRate,0) end,0) as SellAmountNoTaskPrice
  FROM #CHANGE CRT
  LEFT JOIN TRN_RT_CHANGE_SELL SRT ON SRT.TrnID=CRT.TrnID
  LEFT JOIN I_PRODUCT_GROUP PG ON PG.GroupID = SRT.GroupID -----nhom Hang
  LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER C ON C.CustID = CRT.CustID
  LEFT JOIN I_GOLD IG ON IG.GoldCode = SRT.GoldCode
  LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT tp ON tp.ProductCode =SRT.ProductCode
  LEFT JOIN T_SECTION TS ON TP.SectionID = TS.SectionID
  LEFT JOIN T_MAINSECTION TM ON TM.MainSectionID = TS.MainSectionID
  LEFT JOIN TRN_PRODUCT_IN tpi ON tpi.TrnID = tp.InTrnID
  LEFT JOIN T_SUPPLIER SP ON SP.SupplierID= TP.SupplierID
  LEFT JOIN @HinhAnh HA ON HA.ProductCode = SRT.ProductCode AND HA.ProductCode = tp.ProductCode
  WHERE CRT.TrnID = @p_TrnID
  order by SRT.OrderBy, SRT.ProductCode

  Select * from @NewGold
  
  -- 3_NewGold --
  SELECT * FROM @NewGold

  -- 4_OldGold --
  SELECT * FROM @OldGold

  -- 5_NewGold --
  SELECT * FROM @NewGold

  -- 6_OldGold --
SELECT * FROM @OldGold

  --7_DocTrongLuong --
    SELECT dbo.GoldWeightToChar(SUM((S.TotalWeight - ISNULL(S.DiamondWeight,0) + ISNULL(S.CatNi,0))),IG.WeightUnit) RealGoldWeightChar,
dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(SUM((S.TotalWeight - ISNULL(S.DiamondWeight,0) + ISNULL(S.CatNi,0))),IG.WeightUnit) RealGoldWeightChar_Bill,
      dbo.GoldWeightToChar(SUM((S.TotalWeight - ISNULL(S.DiamondWeight,0))),IG.WeightUnit) GoldWeightChar,
dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(SUM((S.TotalWeight - ISNULL(S.DiamondWeight,0))),IG.WeightUnit) GoldWeightChar_Bill
  FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE_SELL S
  LEFT JOIN I_GOLD IG on IG.GoldCode = S.GoldCode
  Where TrnID = @p_TrnID
  GROUP BY TrnID,IG.WeightUnit

DECLARE @VangDu TABLE (GoldCode VARCHAR(10), GoldType VARCHAR(1), GoldWeight NUMERIC(19,8), XRate NUMERIC(18,3),
Amount NUMERIC(18,3), GoldDesc NVARCHAR(100), WeightUnit VARCHAR(10), IsDOI VARCHAR(1))
  --8_VangDu --

INSERT INTO @VangDu
SELECT DT.GoldCode,DT.GoldType,
CASE WHEN IG.WeightUnit='L' THEN DT.GoldWeight/@sHeso ELSE DT.GoldWeight END GoldWeight,
DT.XRate,DT.Amount, IG.GoldDesc,IG.WeightUnit, CASE WHEN DT.GoldWeight < ISNULL(BG.GoldWeight,0) THEN 'F' ELSE 'T' END IsDOI
FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE_DTL DT
LEFT JOIN TRN_RT_CHANGE_BUYGOLD BG ON DT.GoldCode = BG.GoldCode and BG.TrnID = DT.TrnID
LEFT JOIN I_GOLD IG on IG.GoldCode = DT.GoldCode
WHERE DT.TrnID = @p_TrnID

SELECT * FROM @VangDu

  --9_VangDu --

SELECT * FROM @VangDu

  -- 10_NewGold --
  SELECT * FROM @NewGold

  -- 11_NewGold --
  SELECT * FROM @NewGold

  -- 12_OldGold --
SELECT * FROM @OldGold

  -- 13_OldGold --
SELECT * FROM @OldGold

DECLARE @GiaBu TABLE (GoldCode_G VARCHAR(10), GoldDesc_G NVARCHAR(100), GoldCode_D VARCHAR(10), GoldDesc_D NVARCHAR(100), DonGiaBu NUMERIC(18,3), TienBu NUMERIC(18,3), 
GoldWeight NUMERIC(19,8), GoldWeightChar nvarchar(max))

--14 GiaBu --
INSERT INTO @GiaBu
  SELECT T1.GoldCode_G, ig.GoldDesc GoldDesc_G, T1.GoldCode_D, ig1.GoldDesc GoldDesc_D, T1.DonGiaBu, T1.TienBu, T1.CGoldWeight as GoldWeight,
dbo.GoldWeightToChar(T1.CGoldWeight,IG.WeightUnit) GoldWeightChar  
FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE_RATE T1
  LEFT JOIN I_GOLD ig ON ig.GoldCode = T1.GoldCode_G
  LEFT JOIN I_GOLD ig1 ON ig1.GoldCode = T1.GoldCode_D
  WHERE T1.TrnID = @p_TrnID
  
   SELECT * FROM @GiaBu
  
--15 GiaBu --

  SELECT * FROM @GiaBu

--16 GiaBu --
    SELECT * FROM @GiaBu

 -- 17_SUB_VÀNG DƯ --
SELECT * FROM @VangDu

 -- 18_ShowPic --
  SELECT  CASE WHEN tpi.ImagePath IS NOT NULL AND tpi.ImagePath <> '' THEN HA.Image ELSE tpi.Image END Image
    FROM #CHANGE CRT
  LEFT JOIN TRN_RT_CHANGE_SELL SRT ON SRT.TrnID=CRT.TrnID
  LEFT JOIN I_PRODUCT_GROUP PG ON PG.GroupID = SRT.GroupID
  LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER C ON C.CustID = CRT.CustID
  LEFT JOIN I_GOLD IG ON IG.GoldCode = SRT.GoldCode
  LEFT JOIN T_PRODUCT tp ON tp.ProductCode =SRT.ProductCode
  LEFT JOIN TRN_PRODUCT_IN tpi ON tpi.TrnID = tp.InTrnID
  LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE emp ON CRT.EmpID = emp.EmpID
  LEFT JOIN @HinhAnh HA ON HA.ProductCode = SRT.ProductCode AND HA.ProductCode = tp.ProductCode
  WHERE CRT.TrnID = @p_TrnID
  
   -- 19_SUB_VÀNG DƯ --
	SELECT * FROM @VangDu

	--20_DATCOC--
	SELECT BSC.TrnID, DC.BillCode, DC.TrnDate, DC.TrnTime, CustName, DC.TienCoc, DC.Description, DC.CashPay, DC.CardPay,
	DCD.ProductDesc, IG.GoldDesc, DCD.TotalWeight, DCD.DiamondWeight, DCD.GoldWeight, DCD.TaskPrice, DCD.Size, DCD.SL, DCD.Notes
	FROM #CHANGE BS
	JOIN TRN_RT_CHANGE_DATCOC BSC ON BS.TrnID=BSC.TrnID
	LEFT JOIN TRN_DATCOC DC ON BSC.DatCocID=DC.TrnID
	LEFT JOIN TRN_DATCOC_DT DCD ON DC.TrnID=DCD.TrnID
	LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER IC ON DC.CustID=IC.CustID
	LEFT JOIN I_GOLD IG ON DCD.GoldCode=IG.GoldCode
	WHERE BS.TrnID=@p_TrnID

	--Thanh toán thẻ--    LUÔN LUÔN NẰM CUỐI --- không đánh số cố định
	DECLARE @QRCode VARBINARY(MAX)
	SET @QRCode = NULL

	DECLARE @MoTaTTThe NVARCHAR(200)
	SELECT @MoTaTTThe = TRB.BillCode + TE.EmpName FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL TRB 
	LEFT JOIN dbo.T_EMPLOYEE TE ON TE.EmpID = TRB.EmpID 
	WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID

	IF	EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE_CardPay WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID)
	BEGIN
		SELECT TRBC.Amount, ib.AccName, ib.NumberBank, tb.Bin , @MoTaTTThe MoTaTTThe, tb.ShortName BankName, ib.BankBranch, @QRCode QRCode
		FROM dbo.TRN_RT_CHANGE_CardPay TRBC
		INNER JOIN dbo.I_BankCard ib ON TRBC.IDCard = ib.NumberBank
		LEFT JOIN dbo.T_BANK tb ON ib.BankKey = tb.Id
		WHERE TRBC.TrnID = @p_TrnID
	END
	ELSE	
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @Amount NUMERIC(18,3)
		DECLARE @ShopID NVARCHAR(200)
		SELECT @Amount = PayAmount, @ShopID = ShopID FROM dbo.TRN_RT_CHANGE WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID	
		SELECT @Amount Amount, ib.AccName, ib.NumberBank, tb.Bin , @MoTaTTThe MoTaTTThe, tb.ShortName BankName, ib.BankBranch, @QRCode QRCode
		FROM dbo.I_BankCard ib
		LEFT JOIN dbo.T_BANK tb ON ib.BankKey = tb.Id
		WHERE ib.TaiKhoanMacDinh = 1 AND ib.ShopID = @ShopID
	END
		
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME='RetailLog')
	BEGIN
	/* BEGIN: Ghi lại log thực thi */
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
		SELECT GETDATE() DateLog, 'rptCRT_PrintBill' StoreName, TrnID, BillCode, @xemtruoc + ' - TinhTrang' + [Status] LogMsg,
		ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
		FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
		SELECT GETDATE() DateLog, 'rptCRT_PrintBill' StoreName, @p_TrnID TrnID, '' BillCode, @xemtruoc + '- LostData' LogMsg,
		ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
	END
	/* END: Ghi lại log thực thi */
	END
END

name: TRN_TILL_TXN_Ins
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TRN_TILL_TXN_Ins]
      @p_TrnID    varchar(15),
      @p_TrnType  varchar(30),
      @p_TrnCode  varchar(30),
      @p_ErrCode  varchar(100)  OUT
AS
      DECLARE @sID varchar(15)
      DECLARE @sToday varchar(10)
      DECLARE @sBillCode NVARCHAR(100)
      DECLARE @sChoPhepChiTraNgoaiTe varchar(1)
	  DECLARE @sChoPhepChiTraNgoaiTe_MuaXoan varchar(1)
      DECLARE @sCcyXrate NUMERIC(18,3)
	  DECLARE @MuaNhieuLoaiDe INT

      SELECT @sChoPhepChiTraNgoaiTe = ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'ChoPhepChiTraNgoaiTe'
      SELECT @sChoPhepChiTraNgoaiTe_MuaXoan = ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'ChoPhepChiTraNgoaiTe_muaxoan'
    
	SELECT @MuaNhieuLoaiDe = ParaValue From SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'MuaNhieuLoaiDe'

	DECLARE @MaTienTeHeThong Varchar(10)
    
    SELECT @MaTienTeHeThong = ParaValue From SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'MaTienTeHeThong'
      --Bien danh cho giao dich mua ban ngoai te
      DECLARE @sSellBuy varchar(1)
      DECLARE @sCcy varchar(10)
      DECLARE @Fcy_Amount numeric(18,3)
      DECLARE @Lcy_Amount numeric(18,3)
      DECLARE @sCustID varchar(15)
      DECLARE @sTrnCode varchar(30)
      DECLARE @sGoldCcy varchar(10)
      DECLARE @sTrnAmount numeric(18,3)
      DECLARE @sTrnTotalAmount numeric(18,3)
      DECLARE @sXRate NUMERIC(18,3)
      DECLARE @sDirty NUMERIC(19,8)
      DECLARE @sTotal NUMERIC(19,8)

      --Bien danh cho giao dich ban le -  doi vang
      DECLARE @sPayAmount numeric(18,3)

      --Bien danh cho giao dich ban le - mua de
      DECLARE @sGoldCode varchar(20)
      DECLARE @sGoldWeight numeric(19,8)
      DECLARE @sDiamondWeight numeric(19,8)
      DECLARE @sTotalAmount numeric(19,8)
      DECLARE @sRTAmount numeric(18,3)

      --Bien danh cho giao dich ban le - mua XOÀN (ĐÁ)
      DECLARE @sMaDa varchar(20)
      DECLARE @sSL int
      DECLARE @sGiaMua numeric(18,0)
      DECLARE @sThanhTien numeric(18,0)

      --Bien danh cho giao dich ban si
      DECLARE @sTaskPriceAmount numeric(18,3)
      DECLARE @sBuySellAmount numeric(18,3)
      DECLARE @sTotalPayAmount numeric(18,3)

      --Ni
      DECLARE @sThemNi NUMERIC(19,8)
      DECLARE @sGoldCodeDe VARCHAR(50)

      --Giao dich tho
      DECLARE @sWorkerID varchar(15)
      DECLARE @sProcUserID varchar(15)
      DECLARE @sGoldWeightTraTho NUMERIC(19,8)
      DECLARE @sDiamondWeightTraTho NUMERIC(19,8)

      SET @sToday = convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 103)

      IF EXISTS(SELECT * FROM T_TILL_TXN WHERE TrnRefID = @p_TrnID)
      BEGIN
            SET @p_ErrCode = 'T-003'
            RETURN -1
      END

BEGIN TRANSACTION

	/********************************
	Giao dich mua bán ngoại tệ
	*********************************/
	IF (@p_TrnType = 'FX')
	BEGIN
		  DECLARE @GhiNoTrongNgoaiTe int
		  SET @GhiNoTrongNgoaiTe = (SELECT ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'GhiNoTrongNgoaiTe')
	
		  DECLARE @PayCus numeric(19,8)
	      SELECT	@sSellBuy = '', 
					@sCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong, 
					@sCustID = CustID, 
					@Fcy_Amount = 0, 
					@Lcy_Amount = 0, 
					@sTrnCode = 'FX', 
					@sGoldCcy = '', 
					@sTrnAmount = 0, 
					@sTrnTotalAmount = PayCus,
					@sXRate=0,
					@sBillCode = BillCode, 
					@PayCus = PayCus
	      FROM TRN_FX
	      WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	      IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	      EXEC SYS_CodeMasters_Gen 'T_TILL_TXN', @sID out
	      IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT
		
		---Cập nhật dữ liệu Bảng chính T_TILL_TXN
	      INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN(TillTxnID, TillID, 
								 TrnRefID, TrnDate, 
								 TrnTime, TrnType, 
								 TrnCode,CustID, 
								 GoldCcy, TrnAmount, 
								 TrnTotalAmount, [Status], 
								 ProcUserID, BillCode)
	      VALUES(	@sID, NULL, 
					@p_TrnID, convert(datetime, @sToday, 103),  
					convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 108), @p_TrnType, 
					@sTrnCode, @sCustID, 
					@sCcy, @sTrnAmount, 
					@sTrnTotalAmount, 'U', 
					NULL, @sBillCode)
	      IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
		
		--Cập nhật dữ liệu VND - Bảng chi tiết T_TILL_TXN_Detail
		INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_Detail (TillTxnID, TillID, 
									   GoldCcy, CrDr, 
									   Amount, Amount_Diamond, 
									   [Status], CcyXRate, 
									   Amount_Dirty, Amount_Total)
		VALUES (@sID, NULL, 
				@MaTienTeHeThong,CASE WHEN @sTrnTotalAmount > 0 THEN '+' ELSE '-' END, 
				 ABS(@PayCus), 0,
				'U', 1, 
				0, 0)
		
		--Cập nhật dữ liệu Ngoại tệ - Bảng chi tiết T_TILL_TXN_Detail
	    DECLARE pCursorFX CURSOR FOR SELECT CFD.SellBuy, CFD.Ccy, CFD.Fcy_Amount, CFD.XRate 
								   FROM TRN_FX_DT CFD WHERE CFD.TrnID = @p_TrnID
		OPEN pCursorFX
		FETCH NEXT FROM pCursorFX INTO @sSellBuy, @sCcy, @sTrnAmount, @sXRate
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN			
			INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_Detail (TillTxnID, TillID, 
										   GoldCcy,  CrDr, 
										   Amount, Amount_Diamond, 
										   [Status],  CcyXRate, 
										   Amount_Dirty, Amount_Total)
			VALUES (@sID, NULL, 
					@sCcy, CASE WHEN @sSellBuy = 'B' THEN '+' ELSE '-' END,
					@sTrnAmount, 0, 
					'U', @sXRate, 
					0, 0)
			FETCH NEXT FROM pCursorFX INTO @sSellBuy, @sCcy, @sTrnAmount, @sXRate
		END
		CLOSE pCursorFX
		DEALLOCATE pCursorFX
	END
	--#########################################################################################################################################################

	/********************************
	Giao dich ban le - Giao dich doi vang
	*********************************/
	IF (@p_TrnType = 'RT' AND @p_TrnCode = 'CRT')
	BEGIN
	      SELECT @sPayAmount = KhachTra, @sCustID = CustID, @sBillCode = BillCode
	      FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE
	      WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	      IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	      EXEC SYS_CodeMasters_Gen 'T_TILL_TXN', @sID out
	      IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT
	
	      INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN(TillTxnID, TillID, TrnRefID, BillCode, TrnDate, TrnTime, TrnType, TrnCode,
	                        CustID, GoldCcy, TrnAmount, TrnTotalAmount,  Status, ProcUserID)
	      VALUES(     @sID, NULL, @p_TrnID, @sBillCode, convert(datetime, @sToday, 103),  convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 108),
	            @p_TrnType, @p_TrnCode, @sCustID, @MaTienTeHeThong, NULL, @sPayAmount, 'U', NULL)
	      IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	      --Tang tien trong TILL
	      IF (@sPayAmount>=0)
	      BEGIN
	            --- Tang VND ------
	            INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL( TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status,CcyXRate,Amount_Dirty,Amount_Total)
	            VALUES(@sID, NULL, @MaTienTeHeThong, '+', ABS(@sPayAmount), NULL, 'U',1, 0,0)
	            IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	      END
	      ELSE
	      BEGIN
	            --- Giam VND ------
	            INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL( TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status,CcyXRate,Amount_Dirty,Amount_Total)
	            VALUES(@sID, NULL, @MaTienTeHeThong, '-', ABS(@sPayAmount), NULL,  'U',1, 0,0)
	            IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	      END
	
	      --Tang de trong till
	      INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL(TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status,Amount_Dirty,Amount_Total)
	      SELECT @sID, NULL, GoldCode, '+', GoldWeight, DiamondWeight, 'U', Dirty,(GoldWeight + DiamondWeight + Dirty)
	      FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE_BUYGOLD
	      WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	
	      --Tang de cua them/cat ni
	      DECLARE pCurM CURSOR FOR
