	      END
	      DECLARE CURR CURSOR FOR
	            SELECT GoldCode,SUM(Ni) FROM TRN_REPAIR_PRODUCT_DT WHERE Ni <> 0 AND DStatus = 'G' AND TrnID = @p_TrnID GROUP BY GoldCode
	      OPEN CURR
	      FETCH NEXT FROM CURR
	      INTO @GoldCode,@NI
	
	      WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	      BEGIN
	            INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL(TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status,Amount_Dirty,Amount_Total)
	            SELECT @sID, NULL, @GoldCode, CASE WHEN @NI > 0 THEN '-' ELSE '+' END, ABS(@NI), '0', 'U',0,ABS(@NI)
	            FETCH NEXT FROM CURR
	            INTO @GoldCode,@NI
	      END
	      CLOSE CURR
	      DEALLOCATE CURR
	END
	--#########################################################################################################################################################

	/*************************************************************
	Giao dich ban le - Giao dich nhận đặt hàng
	**************************************************************/
	IF (@p_TrnType = 'OD' AND @p_TrnCode = 'OD')
	BEGIN
	
	      DECLARE @BPayAmount_OD NUMERIC(18,3)
	      SELECT      @BPayAmount_OD = ISNULL(BPayAmount,0), @sCustID = CustID
	      FROM TRN_ORDER_PRODUCT
	      WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	      IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	      EXEC SYS_CodeMasters_Gen 'T_TILL_TXN', @sID out
	            IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT
	
	      IF(@BPayAmount_OD > 0)
	      BEGIN
	            INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN(TillTxnID, TillID, TrnRefID, BillCode, TrnDate, TrnTime, TrnType, TrnCode,
	                              CustID, GoldCcy, TrnAmount, TrnTotalAmount, Status, ProcUserID)
	            VALUES(     @sID, NULL, @p_TrnID, NULL, convert(datetime, @sToday, 103),  convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 108),
	                  @p_TrnType, @p_TrnCode, @sCustID, @MaTienTeHeThong, 0, @BPayAmount_OD, 'U', @sProcUserID)
	            IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	            INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL(TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status,CcyXRate,Amount_Dirty,Amount_Total)
	                  SELECT @sID, NULL, @MaTienTeHeThong, CASE WHEN @BPayAmount_OD > 0 THEN '+' ELSE '-' END, ABS(@BPayAmount_OD), '0', 'U',1,0,0
	      END
	END
	--#########################################################################################################################################################

	/*************************************************************
	Giao dich ban le - Giao dich nhận đặt dẻ
	**************************************************************/
	IF (@p_TrnType = 'OD' AND @p_TrnCode = 'TOG')
	BEGIN
		DECLARE @BPayAmount_ODOG NUMERIC(18,3)
		DECLARE @TypeTrn varchar(10)
		SELECT      @BPayAmount_ODOG = ISNULL(BPayAmount,0), @sCustID = CustID, @TypeTrn= TypeTrn
		FROM TRN_ORDER_OLDGOLD
		WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
		IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

		EXEC SYS_CodeMasters_Gen 'T_TILL_TXN', @sID out
		      IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT

		      INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN(TillTxnID, TillID, TrnRefID, BillCode, TrnDate, TrnTime, TrnType, TrnCode,
		                        CustID, GoldCcy, TrnAmount, TrnTotalAmount, Status, ProcUserID)
		      VALUES(     @sID, NULL, @p_TrnID, NULL, convert(datetime, @sToday, 103),  convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 108),
		            @p_TrnType, @p_TrnCode, @sCustID, @MaTienTeHeThong, 0, @BPayAmount_ODOG, 'U', @sProcUserID)
		      IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

		-- Tang tien trong Till
		IF(@BPayAmount_ODOG > 0)
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL(TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status,CcyXRate,Amount_Dirty,Amount_Total)
			SELECT @sID, NULL, @MaTienTeHeThong, CASE WHEN @BPayAmount_ODOG > 0 THEN '+' ELSE '-' END, ABS(@BPayAmount_ODOG), '0', 'U',1,0,0
		END

		-- Giam de trong Till
		DECLARE @TotalWeght_ODOG numeric(19,8),@DiamondWeight_ODOG numeric(19,8), @GoldWeight_ODOG numeric(19,8), @sGoldCode_ODOG VARCHAR(20)
		DECLARE CUR_ CURSOR FOR
		select  GoldCode, TotalWeight, DiamondWeight ,  (TotalWeight-DiamondWeight) GoldWeight
		from TRN_ORDER_OLDGOLD_DT
		WHERE TRnID=@p_TrnID and Status='C'
		OPEN CUR_
		FETCH NEXT FROM CUR_
		INTO @sGoldCode_ODOG,@TotalWeght_ODOG,@DiamondWeight_ODOG,@GoldWeight_ODOG

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		      IF(@TypeTrn ='B')
		      BEGIN
		            INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL( TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status,Amount_Dirty,Amount_Total)
		            VALUES(@sID, NULL, @sGoldCode_ODOG, '+', @GoldWeight_ODOG, @DiamondWeight_ODOG,'U',0,(@GoldWeight_ODOG + @DiamondWeight_ODOG))
		            IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
		            FETCH NEXT FROM CUR_
		            INTO @sGoldCode_ODOG,@TotalWeght_ODOG,@DiamondWeight_ODOG,@GoldWeight_ODOG
		      END
		      ELSE
		      BEGIN
		            INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL( TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status,Amount_Dirty,Amount_Total)
		            VALUES(@sID, NULL, @sGoldCode_ODOG, '-', @GoldWeight_ODOG, @DiamondWeight_ODOG,'U',0,(@GoldWeight_ODOG + @DiamondWeight_ODOG))
		            IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
		            FETCH NEXT FROM CUR_
		            INTO @sGoldCode_ODOG,@TotalWeght_ODOG,@DiamondWeight_ODOG,@GoldWeight_ODOG
		      END
		CLOSE CUR_
		DEALLOCATE CUR_
    END
	--#########################################################################################################################################################

	/*************************************************************
	Giao dich trả hàng mượn
	**************************************************************/
	IF (@p_TrnType = 'PP' AND @p_TrnCode = 'PP')
	BEGIN
	
	      DECLARE @TotalPayAmount NUMERIC(18,3), @ProcUserID varchar(15)
	      SELECT      @TotalPayAmount = ISNULL(TotalPayAmount,0), @sCustID = CustID, @ProcUserID=Createdby
	      FROM TRN_PAY_PRODUCT
	      WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	      IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	      EXEC SYS_CodeMasters_Gen 'T_TILL_TXN', @sID out
	            IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT
	
	      IF(@TotalPayAmount > 0)
	      BEGIN
	            INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN(TillTxnID, TillID, TrnRefID, BillCode, TrnDate, TrnTime, TrnType, TrnCode,
	                              CustID, GoldCcy, TrnAmount, TrnTotalAmount, Status, ProcUserID)
	            VALUES(     @sID, NULL, @p_TrnID, NULL, convert(datetime, @sToday, 103),  convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 108),
	                  @p_TrnType, @p_TrnCode, @sCustID, @MaTienTeHeThong, 0, @TotalPayAmount, 'U', @ProcUserID)
	            IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	            INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL(TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status,CcyXRate,Amount_Dirty,Amount_Total)
	                  SELECT @sID, NULL, @MaTienTeHeThong, CASE WHEN @TotalPayAmount > 0 THEN '+' ELSE '-' END, ABS(@TotalPayAmount), '0', 'U',1,0,0
	      END
	END
	--#########################################################################################################################################################

	/*************************************************************
	Toa sỉ thợ
	**************************************************************/
	IF (@p_TrnType = 'PO' AND @p_TrnCode = 'POW')
	BEGIN
	      SELECT @sTotalPayAmount = ISNULL(Pay_Amount,0)*1000, @sCustID = WorkerID , @sBillCode = BillCode
	      FROM TRN_PO_MASTER_WORKER 
	      WHERE WorkerPOID = @p_TrnID
	      IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	      EXEC SYS_CodeMasters_Gen 'T_TILL_TXN', @sID out
	      IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT
	
	      INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN(TillTxnID, TillID, TrnRefID, BillCode, TrnDate, TrnTime, TrnType, TrnCode,
								 CustID, GoldCcy, TrnAmount, TrnTotalAmount, Status, ProcUserID)
	      VALUES(@sID, NULL, @p_TrnID, @sBillCode, convert(datetime, @sToday, 103),  convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 108), @p_TrnType, @p_TrnCode, 
				@sCustID, @MaTienTeHeThong, 0, @sTotalPayAmount, 'U', @ProcUserID)
	      IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	      INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL(TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status,CcyXRate,Amount_Dirty,Amount_Total)
	      SELECT @sID, NULL, @MaTienTeHeThong, CASE WHEN @sTotalPayAmount > 0 THEN '+' ELSE '-' END, ABS(@sTotalPayAmount), '0', 'U',1,0,0
	            
	      INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL(TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status,Amount_Dirty,Amount_Total)
	      SELECT @sID, NULL, GDT.GoldCode, '-', SUM(GDT.TotalWeight - GDT.DiamondWeight) GoldWeight, SUM(GDT.DiamondWeight) DiamondWeight, 'U', 0 Dirty,
	      SUM(GDT.TotalWeight)
	      FROM TRN_PO_GOLD_WORKER_DT GDT
	      INNER JOIN TRN_PO_MASTER_WORKER_DT MDT ON MDT.GoldWorkerPOID = GDT.GoldWorkerPOID
	      WHERE MDT.WorkerPOID=@p_TrnID AND GDT.GoldCode <> 'DC'
	      GROUP BY GDT.GoldCode
	END
	--#########################################################################################################################################################

	/*************************************************************
	Giao dịch thợ
	**************************************************************/
	IF (@p_TrnType = 'WORKER' AND @p_TrnCode = 'WT')
	BEGIN
		SELECT @sWorkerID = WorkerID, @sProcUserID = UserID, @sTotalPayAmount = ISNULL(PayAmount, 0) * 1000
		FROM TRN_WORKER
		WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
		IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

		EXEC SYS_CodeMasters_Gen 'T_TILL_TXN', @sID OUT
		IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT
		
		INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN( TillTxnID, TillID, TrnRefID, BillCode, TrnDate, TrnTime, TrnType, TrnCode,
								CustID, GoldCcy, TrnAmount, TrnTotalAmount, [Status], ProcUserID)
		VALUES( @sID, NULL, @p_TrnID, NULL, CONVERT(datetime, @sToday, 103),  CONVERT(varchar(10), GETDATE(), 108), @p_TrnType, @p_TrnCode,
				@sWorkerID, @MaTienTeHeThong, 0, @sTotalPayAmount, 'U', @sProcUserID)
		IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
		
		-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		-- Giảm tiền trong quầy để trả tiền công thợ: PayAmount > 0 => Trả thợ | PayAmount < 0 = Thợ trả
		INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL(TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, [Status], CcyXRate, Amount_Dirty, Amount_Total)
		SELECT @sID, NULL, @MaTienTeHeThong, CASE WHEN @sTotalPayAmount > 0 THEN '-' ELSE '+' END, ABS(@sTotalPayAmount), 0, 'U', 1, 0, 0
		
		-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		-- Giảm dẻ trong quầy khi trả thợ
		DECLARE pCurM CURSOR FOR SELECT GoldCode, 
								    SUM(ISNULL(GoldWeight, 0)) AS GoldWeightTraTho, 
								    SUM(ISNULL(DiamondWeight, 0)) ASDiamondWeightTraTho
								 FROM TRN_WORKER_OUT
								 WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
								 GROUP BY GoldCode
		OPEN pCurM
		FETCH NEXT FROM pCurM INTO @sGoldCode, @sGoldWeightTraTho, @sDiamondWeightTraTho
		
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
		      -- Hoạch toán quầy thu ngân phần dẻ
		      INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL(TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, [Status], Amount_Dirty, Amount_Total)
		      SELECT @sID, NULL, @sGoldCode, CASE WHEN @sGoldWeightTraTho > 0 THEN '-' ELSE '+' END, ABS(@sGoldWeightTraTho), ABS(@sDiamondWeightTraTho), 'C', 0, (ABS(@sGoldWeightTraTho) + ABS(@sDiamondWeightTraTho))
		
		      FETCH NEXT FROM pCurM INTO @sGoldCode, @sGoldWeightTraTho, @sDiamondWeightTraTho
		END
		CLOSE pCurM
		DEALLOCATE pCurM
	END
	--#########################################################################################################################################################

	/*************************************************************
	Thanh toán/tạm ứng tiền công thợ
	**************************************************************/
	IF (@p_TrnType = 'WORKER' AND @p_TrnCode = 'WP')
	BEGIN
		SELECT @sWorkerID = WorkerID, @sProcUserID = UserID, @sTotalPayAmount = ISNULL(PayAmount, 0) * 1000
		FROM TRN_WORKER_PAYMENT
		WHERE WorkerPayID = @p_TrnID
		IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

		EXEC SYS_CodeMasters_Gen 'T_TILL_TXN', @sID OUT
		IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT
		
		INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN( TillTxnID, TillID, TrnRefID, BillCode, TrnDate, TrnTime, TrnType, TrnCode,
								CustID, GoldCcy, TrnAmount, TrnTotalAmount, [Status], ProcUserID)
		VALUES( @sID, NULL, @p_TrnID, NULL, CONVERT(datetime, @sToday, 103),  CONVERT(varchar(10), GETDATE(), 108), @p_TrnType, @p_TrnCode,
				@sWorkerID, @MaTienTeHeThong, 0, @sTotalPayAmount, 'U', @sProcUserID)
		IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
		
		-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
		-- Giảm tiền trong quầy để trả tiền công thợ: PayAmount > 0 => Trả thợ | PayAmount < 0 = Thợ trả
		INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL(TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, [Status], CcyXRate, Amount_Dirty, Amount_Total)
		SELECT @sID, NULL, @MaTienTeHeThong, CASE WHEN @sTotalPayAmount > 0 THEN '-' ELSE '+' END, ABS(@sTotalPayAmount), 0, 'U', 1, 0, 0
	END
	--#########################################################################################################################################################
	
	/*************************************************************
	Giao dich ban le - Giao dich dat coc
	**************************************************************/
	IF (@p_TrnType = 'TDC' AND @p_TrnCode = 'TDC')
	BEGIN
	
	      SELECT @sPayAmount = isnull(TienCoc,0), @sCustID = CustID, @sBillCode = BillCode
	      FROM TRN_DATCOC
	      WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	      IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	      EXEC SYS_CodeMasters_Gen 'T_TILL_TXN', @sID out
	      IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT
	
	      INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN(TillTxnID, TillID, TrnRefID, BillCode, TrnDate, TrnTime, TrnType, TrnCode,
	                        CustID, GoldCcy, TrnAmount, TrnTotalAmount, Status, ProcUserID)
	      VALUES(     @sID, NULL, @p_TrnID, @sBillCode, convert(datetime, @sToday, 103),  convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 108),
	            @p_TrnType, @p_TrnCode, @sCustID, @MaTienTeHeThong, NULL, @sPayAmount, 'U', NULL)
	      IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	      --Tang tien trong TILL
	      
	    INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL( TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status,CcyXRate,Amount_Dirty,Amount_Total)
	    VALUES(@sID, NULL, @MaTienTeHeThong, '+', ABS(@sPayAmount), NULL,'U',1,0,0)
	    IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	END
	--#########################################################################################################################################################
	/*************************************************************
	Trả hàng lỗi
	**************************************************************/
	IF (@p_TrnType = 'THL' AND @p_TrnCode = 'THL')
	BEGIN
	      EXEC SYS_CodeMasters_Gen 'T_TILL_TXN', @sID out
	      IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT
	
	      INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN(TillTxnID, TillID, TrnRefID, BillCode, TrnDate, TrnTime, TrnType, TrnCode,
	                        CustID, GoldCcy, TrnAmount, TrnTotalAmount, Status, ProcUserID)
	      VALUES(@sID, NULL, @p_TrnID, NULL, convert(datetime, @sToday, 103),  convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 108),
	            @p_TrnType, @p_TrnCode, NULL, @MaTienTeHeThong, 0, 0, 'U', NULL)
	      IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
		DECLARE pCursorBRT CURSOR FOR SELECT BG.OldGold, SUM(BG.GoldWeight) GoldWeight, SUM(BG.DiamondWeight) DiamondWeight
								   FROM TRN_TRAHANGLOI_DT BG WHERE BG.TraHangID = @p_TrnID
								   GROUP BY BG.OldGold
		OPEN pCursorBRT
		FETCH NEXT FROM pCursorBRT INTO @sGoldCode, @sGoldWeight, @sDiamondWeight
		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN			
			INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL(
					TillTxnID, 
					TillID, 
					GoldCcy, 
					CrDr, 
					Amount, 
					Amount_Diamond, 
					Status,
					Amount_Dirty,
					Amount_Total)
			VALUES(
					@sID, 
					NULL, 
					@sGoldCode, 
					'+', 
					@sGoldWeight, 
					@sDiamondWeight,
					'U', 
					0, 
					(@sGoldWeight + @sDiamondWeight))
			IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			FETCH NEXT FROM pCursorBRT INTO @sGoldCode, @sGoldWeight, @sDiamondWeight
		END
		CLOSE pCursorBRT
		DEALLOCATE pCursorBRT
	END
	--#########################################################################################################################################################
COMMIT TRANSACTION
SET @p_ErrCode = '0'
RETURN 0
ABORT:

BEGIN
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','pCurM')) >= -1
	 BEGIN
	 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','pCurM')) > -1
		BEGIN
			CLOSE pCurM
		END
	 DEALLOCATE pCurM
 END
 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','PCURR')) >= -1
	 BEGIN
	 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','PCURR')) > -1
		BEGIN
			CLOSE PCURR
		END
	 DEALLOCATE PCURR
 END
 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','CURR')) >= -1
	 BEGIN
	 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','CURR')) > -1
		BEGIN
			CLOSE CURR
		END
	 DEALLOCATE CURR
 END
 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','CUR_')) >= -1
	 BEGIN
	 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','CUR_')) > -1
		BEGIN
			CLOSE CUR_
		END
	 DEALLOCATE CUR_
 END
	IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','pCursorFX')) >= -1
	BEGIN
		IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','pCursorFX')) > -1
		BEGIN
			CLOSE pCursorFX
		END
		DEALLOCATE pCursorFX
	END
SET @p_ErrCode = '-1'
RETURN -1
END

name: TRN_TILL_TXN_Upd
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TRN_TILL_TXN_Upd]
	@p_TrnID 	varchar(15),
	@p_TrnType 	varchar(30),
	@p_TrnCode  	varchar(30),
	@p_ErrCode  	varchar(100)  OUT
AS
	DECLARE @sID varchar(15)
	DECLARE @sToday varchar(10)
	DECLARE @sBillCode nvarchar(100)

	--Bien danh cho giao dich mua ban ngoai te
	DECLARE @sSellBuy varchar(1)
	DECLARE @sCcy varchar(10)
	DECLARE @Fcy_Amount numeric(18,2)
	DECLARE @Lcy_Amount numeric(18,2)
	DECLARE @sCustID varchar(15)
	DECLARE @sTrnCode varchar(30)
	DECLARE @sGoldCcy varchar(10)
	DECLARE @sTrnAmount numeric(18,2)
	DECLARE @sXRate NUMERIC(18,3)

	--Bien danh cho giao dich ban le -  doi vang
	DECLARE @sPayAmount numeric(18,2)
	DECLARE @sPayCard NUMERIC(18,2)
	DECLARE @sTrnTotalAmount NUMERIC(18,2)
		
	--Bien danh cho giao dich ban le - mua de
	DECLARE @sGoldCode varchar(20)
	DECLARE @sGoldWeight numeric(19,8)
	DECLARE @sDiamondWeight numeric(19,8)
	DECLARE @sTotalAmount numeric(19,8)

	--Bien danh cho giao dich ban si
	DECLARE @sTaskPriceAmount numeric(18,2)	
	DECLARE @sBuySellAmount numeric(18,2)	
	DECLARE @sTotalPayAmount numeric(18,2)	

	SET @sToday = convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 103)

	IF NOT EXISTS(SELECT * FROM T_TILL_TXN WHERE TrnRefID = @p_TrnID)
	BEGIN
		SET @p_ErrCode = 'T-003'
		RETURN -1
	END
	ELSE
		BEGIN
			SELECT @sID=ttt.TillTxnID,@sBillCode=ttt.BillCode,@sCustID=ttt.CustID
			  FROM T_TILL_TXN ttt WHERE ttt.TrnRefID=@p_TrnID
		END

BEGIN TRANSACTION 
	
/********************************
Giao dich mua bán ngoại tệ
*********************************/
IF (@p_TrnType = 'FX' AND @p_TrnCode = 'FX')
BEGIN
	SELECT @sTrnTotalAmount=ttt.TrnTotalAmount
	FROM T_TILL_TXN ttt WHERE ttt.TillTxnID=@sID
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	SELECT @sPayCard = ttc.PayCard FROM TRN_FX ttc 
	WHERE ttc.TrnID=@p_TrnID
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	SET @sPayAmount=@sTrnTotalAmount-@sPayCard
	IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT

	UPDATE T_TILL_TXN
	SET TrnTotalAmount =@sPayAmount
	WHERE TillTxnID=@sID		
	
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	IF (@sPayAmount>=0)
	BEGIN
		--- Tang VND ------
		UPDATE T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL
		SET		
			Amount = ABS(@sPayAmount),
			CrDr = '+'
		WHERE TillTxnID=@sID AND GoldCcy = 'VND'	
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--- Giam VND ------
		UPDATE T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL
		SET		
			Amount = ABS(@sPayAmount),
			CrDr = '-'
		WHERE TillTxnID=@sID AND GoldCcy = 'VND'				
	END
END

/********************************
Giao dich ban le - Giao dich doi vang
*********************************/
IF (@p_TrnType = 'RT' AND @p_TrnCode = 'CRT') 
BEGIN	
	SELECT @sTrnTotalAmount=ttt.TrnTotalAmount
	  FROM T_TILL_TXN ttt WHERE ttt.TillTxnID=@sID
	  	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	SELECT @sPayCard = ttc.CardPay FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE ttc 
	WHERE ttc.TrnID=@p_TrnID
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	SET @sPayAmount=@sTrnTotalAmount-@sPayCard
	IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT

	UPDATE T_TILL_TXN
	SET TrnTotalAmount =@sPayAmount
	WHERE TillTxnID=@sID		
	
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	--Tang tien trong TILL
	IF (@sPayAmount>=0)
	BEGIN
		--- Tang VND ------
		UPDATE T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL
		SET		
			Amount = ABS(@sPayAmount),
			CrDr = '+'
		WHERE TillTxnID=@sID AND GoldCcy = 'VND'	
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--- Giam VND ------
		UPDATE T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL
		SET		
			Amount = ABS(@sPayAmount),
			CrDr = '-'
		WHERE TillTxnID=@sID AND GoldCcy = 'VND'
	END
	--Tang de trong till
	--Khong cap nhat lai de
	
END

/*************************************************************
Giao dich ban le - Giao dich mua ban
**************************************************************/
IF (@p_TrnType = 'RT' AND @p_TrnCode = 'SRT') 
BEGIN	
	SELECT @sTrnTotalAmount=ttt.TrnTotalAmount FROM T_TILL_TXN ttt WHERE ttt.TillTxnID=@sID
	  	
	SELECT @sPayCard = ttc.CardPay FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL ttc WHERE ttc.TrnID=@p_TrnID
	
	SET @sPayAmount=@sTrnTotalAmount-@sPayCard
	
	IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT
	UPDATE T_TILL_TXN
	SET TrnTotalAmount = @sPayAmount
	WHERE TillTxnID = @sID				
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	--Tang tien trong TILL
	IF (@sPayAmount>=0)
	BEGIN
		--- Tang VND ------
		UPDATE T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL
		SET		
			Amount = ABS(@sPayAmount),
			CrDr = '+'
		WHERE TillTxnID=@sID AND GoldCcy = 'VND'
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--- Giam VND ------
		UPDATE T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL
		SET	Amount = ABS(@sPayAmount),	CrDr = '-'
		WHERE TillTxnID=@sID AND GoldCcy = 'VND'
				
	END
	--Khong cap nhat lai dẻ	
END
/*************************************************************
Giao dich ban le - Giao dich mua de
**************************************************************/
IF (@p_TrnType = 'RT' AND @p_TrnCode = 'BRT') 
BEGIN	
	--SELECT 	@sGoldCode = GoldCode, @sGoldWeight = GoldWeight, @sDiamondWeight = DiamondWeight,
	--	@sTotalAmount = TotalAmount, @sCustID = CustID
	--FROM TRN_RT_BUYGOLD
	--WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	--IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	--EXEC SYS_CodeMasters_Gen 'T_TILL_TXN', @sID out	
	--IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT

	--INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN(TillTxnID, TillID, TrnRefID, BillCode, TrnDate, TrnTime, TrnType, TrnCode,
	--			CustID, GoldCcy, TrnAmount, TrnTotalAmount, Status, ProcUserID)
	--VALUES(	@sID, NULL, @p_TrnID, NULL, convert(datetime, @sToday, 103),  convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 108), 
	--	@p_TrnType, @p_TrnCode, @sCustID, @sGoldCode, @sGoldWeight, @sTotalAmount, 'U', NULL)
	--IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	----Tang de trong TILL
	--IF (@sGoldWeight>=0)
	--BEGIN
	--	--- Tang de ------
	--	INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL( TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status)
	--	VALUES(@sID, NULL, @sGoldCode, '+', @sGoldWeight, @sDiamondWeight,'U')
	--	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT	

	--	--- Giam VND ------
	--	INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL( TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status)
	--	VALUES(@sID, NULL, 'VND', '-', @sTotalAmount, NULL,'U')
	--	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT	
	--END
	--ELSE
	--BEGIN
	--	--- Giam de ------
	--	INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL( TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status)
	--	VALUES(@sID, NULL, @sGoldCode, '-', @sGoldWeight, @sDiamondWeight,'U')
	--	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT	

	--	--- Tang VND ------
	--	INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL( TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status)
	--	VALUES(@sID, NULL, 'VND', '+', @sTotalAmount, NULL,'U')
	--	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT	
	--END
	SELECT @sTrnTotalAmount=ttt.TrnTotalAmount FROM T_TILL_TXN ttt WHERE ttt.TillTxnID=@sID
	  	
	SELECT @sPayCard = ttc.CardPay, @sPayAmount=ttc.CashPay FROM TRN_RT_BUYGOLD ttc WHERE ttc.TrnID=@p_TrnID
	
	--SET @sPayAmount=@sTrnTotalAmount-@sPayCard
	
	IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT
	UPDATE T_TILL_TXN
	SET TrnTotalAmount = abs(@sPayAmount)
	WHERE TillTxnID = @sID				
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	--Tang tien trong TILL
	IF (@sPayAmount>=0)
	BEGIN
		--- Tang VND ------
		UPDATE T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL
		SET		
			Amount = ABS(@sPayAmount),
			CrDr = '+'
		WHERE TillTxnID=@sID AND GoldCcy = 'VND'
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--- Giam VND ------
		UPDATE T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL
		SET	Amount = ABS(@sPayAmount),	CrDr = '-'
		WHERE TillTxnID=@sID AND GoldCcy = 'VND'
				
	END
END
/*************************************************************
Giao dich ban si - ket toa thanh toan
**************************************************************/
IF (@p_TrnType = 'PO' AND @p_TrnCode = 'PO') 
BEGIN	
	DECLARE @vTillID varchar(15)
	SET @vTillID = NULL
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'HoachToanKetToaVeQuayThuDe' AND ParaValue = 1)
	BEGIN
		SELECT @vTillID = GLD.TillID 
		FROM TRN_PO_GOLD GLD
			 LEFT JOIN TRN_PO_MASTER_DT PMTDT ON PMTDT.GoldPOID = GLD.GoldPOID
			 LEFT JOIN TRN_PO_MASTER PMT ON PMT.POID = PMTDT.POID
		WHERE PMT.POID = @p_TrnID
	END
		
	--Lay tien cong thanh toan	
	SELECT @sTaskPriceAmount = ISNULL(Trn_PayAmount * 1000, 0),
		@sCustID = CustID
	FROM TRN_PO_MASTER
	WHERE POID = @p_TrnID
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	--Lay tien thanh toan mua ban vang	
	SELECT 	@sBuySellAmount = ISNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN Trn_SellBuy = 'B' THEN -round((Price * Quatity  * 10)/1000,0)*1000 ELSE round((Price * Quatity  * 10)/1000,0)*1000 END),0)
	FROM TRN_PO_MASTER_DT
	WHERE POID = @p_TrnID AND Trn_SellBuy<>'0'
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	SET @sTotalPayAmount = @sTaskPriceAmount + @sBuySellAmount

	EXEC SYS_CodeMasters_Gen 'T_TILL_TXN', @sID out	
	IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT

	INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN(TillTxnID, TillID, TrnRefID, BillCode, TrnDate, TrnTime, TrnType, TrnCode,
				CustID, GoldCcy, TrnAmount, TrnTotalAmount, Status, ProcUserID)
	VALUES(	@sID, NULL, @p_TrnID, NULL, convert(datetime, @sToday, 103),  convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 108), 
		@p_TrnType, @p_TrnCode, @sCustID, 'VND', NULL, @sTotalPayAmount, 'U', NULL)
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	--Tang/giam VND
	IF (@sTotalPayAmount<0)
	BEGIN
		--- Giam VND ------
		INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL( TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status)
		VALUES(@sID, NULL, 'VND', '-', ABS(@sTotalPayAmount), NULL,'U')
		IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT	
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--- Tang VND ------
		INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL( TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status)
		VALUES(@sID, NULL, 'VND', '+', ABS(@sTotalPayAmount), NULL,'U')
		IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT	
	END

	--Tang de trong till
	INSERT INTO T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL(TillTxnID, TillID, GoldCcy, CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond, Status)
	SELECT @sID, @vTillID, GDT.GoldCode, '+', SUM(GDT.GoldWeight) GoldWeight, SUM(GDT.DiamondWeight) DiamondWeight, 'U'
	FROM TRN_PO_GOLD_DT GDT
	INNER JOIN TRN_PO_MASTER_DT MDT ON MDT.GoldPOID = GDT.GoldPOID
	WHERE MDT.POID=@p_TrnID AND GDT.GoldCode<>'DC'
	GROUP BY GDT.GoldCode
END
/*************************************************************
Giao dich ban le - Giao dich dat coc
**************************************************************/
IF (@p_TrnType = 'TDC' AND @p_TrnCode = 'TDC') 
BEGIN	
	SELECT @sTrnTotalAmount=ttt.TrnTotalAmount FROM T_TILL_TXN ttt WHERE ttt.TillTxnID=@sID
	  	
	SELECT @sPayCard = ttc.CardPay FROM TRN_DATCOC ttc WHERE ttc.TrnID=@p_TrnID
	
	SET @sPayAmount=@sTrnTotalAmount-@sPayCard
	
	IF @sID IS NULL OR @sID ='' GOTO ABORT
	UPDATE T_TILL_TXN
	SET TrnTotalAmount = @sPayAmount
	WHERE TillTxnID = @sID				
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	--Tang tien trong TILL
	IF (@sPayAmount>=0)
	BEGIN
		--- Tang VND ------
		UPDATE T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL
		SET		
			Amount = ABS(@sPayAmount),
			CrDr = '+'
		WHERE TillTxnID=@sID AND GoldCcy = 'VND'
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		--- Giam VND ------
		UPDATE T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL
		SET	Amount = ABS(@sPayAmount),	CrDr = '-'
		WHERE TillTxnID=@sID AND GoldCcy = 'VND'
				
	END
	--Khong cap nhat lai dẻ	
END
COMMIT TRANSACTION
	SET @p_ErrCode = '0'
RETURN 0
ABORT:

BEGIN
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
	SET @p_ErrCode = '-1'
RETURN -1
END

definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[T_TILL_CARDPAY_Ins]
			@p_TillID VARCHAR(30) = NULL,
			@p_TillTxnID varchar(30)=NULL,
			@p_IDCard nvarchar(50)=NULL,			
			@p_Amount numeric(18,3)=NULL,
			@p_BankName NVARCHAR(500)=NULL,
			@p_HoTenChuThe NVARCHAR(500)=NULL,
			@p_NgayHetHan NVARCHAR(500)=NULL,
			@p_TrnID VARCHAR(3000) = NULL,
			@p_TypeTrade varchar(10) = NULL,
			@p_ProductIDs VARCHAR(3000) = NULL,	
			@p_CardAmounts VARCHAR(3000) = NULL,
			@p_CashAmount numeric(18,3) = NULL
AS

BEGIN TRANSACTION 	
	DECLARE @p_Message nvarchar(4000)
	SET @p_Message = ''
	DECLARE @sErrCode VARCHAR(100)
	DECLARE @sErr NVARCHAR(30)
	
	IF EXISTS (SELECT * FROM [T_TILL_CARDPAY] WHERE TillTxnID = @p_TillTxnID AND IDCard = @p_IDCard)
	BEGIN
		SET @sErr = N'Trùng lặp dữ liệu'
		GOTO ABORT
	END
	
	INSERT INTO T_TILL_CARDPAY (
		[TillID],
		[TillTxnID],
		[IDCard],
		[IssuedOn],
		[Amount],BankName,HoTen,NgayHetHan		
	) VALUES (
		@p_TillID,
		@p_TillTxnID,
		@p_IDCard,
		GETDATE(),
		@p_Amount,@p_BankName,@p_HoTenChuThe,@p_NgayHetHan		
	)
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	
	DECLARE @sChar char(1)
	SET @sChar = '@'	

	DECLARE @sDSProductID varchar(6000)
	DECLARE @sProductID varchar(15)
	DECLARE @iPosProductID INT
	
	DECLARE @sDSCardAmount varchar(6000)
	DECLARE @sCardAmount varchar(15)
	DECLARE @iPosCardAmount int
		
	SET @sDSProductID = @p_ProductIDs
	SET @sDSCardAmount = @p_CardAmounts
	IF(@p_ProductIDs IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
	WHILE len(@sDSProductID) > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @iPosProductID = CHARINDEX(@sChar,@sDSProductID)
		SET @iPosCardAmount = CHARINDEX(@sChar,@sDSCardAmount)
		IF @iPosProductID > 0
			BEGIN
				SET @sProductID 	= rtrim(ltrim(SUBSTRING(@sDSProductID,1,@iPosProductID-1)))
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
				SET @sDSProductID 	= SUBSTRING(@sDSProductID,@iPosProductID+1,LEN(@sDSProductID) - @iPosProductID)
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

				SET @sCardAmount 	= rtrim(ltrim(SUBSTRING(@sDSCardAmount,1,@iPosCardAmount-1)))
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
				SET @sDSCardAmount 	= SUBSTRING(@sDSCardAmount,@iPosCardAmount+1,LEN(@sDSCardAmount) - @iPosCardAmount)
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @sProductID = rtrim(ltrim(@sDSProductID))
				SET @sDSProductID = ''

				SET @sCardAmount = rtrim(ltrim(@sDSCardAmount))
				SET @sDSCardAmount = ''
			END 
			
			UPDATE TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL
			SET CardAmount = @sCardAmount
			WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID AND ProductID = @sProductID 
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	END
	
		IF(@p_TypeTrade = 'SRT')
		BEGIN
			UPDATE TRN_RT_BUYSELL
			SET
				CashPay=@p_CashAmount,
				CardPay=@p_Amount
			WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID
		END
		--Cap nhat tiền thanh toán trong T_TILL_TXN
		EXEC TRN_TILL_TXN_Upd	
			@p_TrnID = @p_TrnID,
			@p_TrnType = 'RT',
			@p_TrnCode = 'SRT',
			@p_ErrCOde = @sErrCode OUT
		SET @sErr = (SELECT se.ErrorDesc
		               FROM SYS_ERROR se WHERE se.ErrorCode = @sErrCode)
	IF @sErrCode <> '0' GOTO ABORT	
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		IF(@p_TypeTrade = 'CRT')
		BEGIN
			UPDATE TRN_RT_CHANGE
			SET
				CashPay=@p_CashAmount,
				PayCard=@p_Amount,
				CardPay=@p_Amount
			WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 GOTO ABORT

			EXEC TRN_TILL_TXN_Upd	
				@p_TrnID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnType = 'RT',
				@p_TrnCode = 'CRT',
				@p_ErrCOde = @sErrCode OUT

			SET @sErr = (SELECT se.ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR se WHERE se.ErrorCode = @sErrCode)
			IF @sErrCode <> '0' GOTO ABORT
		END
		ELSE IF(@p_TypeTrade = 'FX')
		BEGIN
			UPDATE TRN_FX SET
				PayCash=@p_CashAmount,
				PayCard=@p_Amount
			WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 GOTO ABORT

			EXEC TRN_TILL_TXN_Upd	
				@p_TrnID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnType = 'FX',
				@p_TrnCode = 'FX',
				@p_ErrCOde = @sErrCode OUT

			SET @sErr = (SELECT se.ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR se WHERE se.ErrorCode = @sErrCode)
			IF @sErrCode <> '0' GOTO ABORT
		END
	END
	IF(@p_TypeTrade = 'TDC')
	BEGIN
		UPDATE TRN_DATCOC
		SET
			CashPay=@p_CashAmount,
			CardPay=@p_Amount
		WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID
		IF @@ERROR <> 0 GOTO ABORT

		EXEC TRN_TILL_TXN_Upd	
			@p_TrnID = @p_TrnID,
			@p_TrnType = 'TDC',
			@p_TrnCode = 'TDC',
			@p_ErrCOde = @sErrCode OUT

		SET @sErr = (SELECT se.ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR se WHERE se.ErrorCode = @sErrCode)
		IF @sErrCode <> '0' GOTO ABORT
	END
	COMMIT TRANSACTION	
	SELECT 0 AS Result, '' ErrorDesc,@sErrCode ErrorCode
	RETURN 0
ABORT:
BEGIN
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
	SELECT -1 AS Result,  @sErr AS ErrorDesc,@sErrCode ErrorCode
	RETURN -1
END

definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rptSRT_PrintBill]
	@p_TrnID VARCHAR(15),
	@xemtruoc varchar(1)
AS
	DECLARE @sUP VARCHAR(3)
	SELECT @sUP=sp.ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS sp WHERE sp.ParaKey='UnitWeight'	
	DECLARE @sHeso NUMERIC(19,8) 
	SET @sHeso=dbo.fun_GetHS()
    DECLARE @MaTienTeHeThong Varchar(10)    
    SELECT @MaTienTeHeThong = ParaValue From SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'MaTienTeHeThong'

	select * 
	into #Buysell
	from TRN_RT_BUYSELL
	where TrnID = @p_TrnID
	and ((@xemtruoc = '0' and Status = 'C' and isnull(BillCode ,'') <> '') OR (@xemtruoc = '1' and Status = 'W'))

	declare @BillEnCode varchar(6000)

	select @BillEnCode = dbo.base64_encode(DB_NAME() + '@' + @@SERVERNAME + '@' + a.TrnID + '@' + REPLACE(a.BillCode,'-','') + '@' + a.[Status] + '@' + b.ProductCode)
	from #Buysell a
	left join TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL b on a.TrnID = b.TrnID
	where b.OrderBy = (select Min(OrderBy) from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL c where c.TrnID = a.TrnID)

	declare @DiemTL numeric(19,8)
	select @DiemTL = sum(DiemTichLuy) from I_LICHSUTICHLUYDIEM where TrnRefID = @p_TrnID
	
	declare @TongDiemTL numeric(19,8)
	select @TongDiemTL = sum(a.DiemTichLuy) 
	from I_LICHSUTICHLUYDIEM a
	where a.MaLichSuTichLuy < (select Min(MaLichSuTichLuy) from I_LICHSUTICHLUYDIEM b where a.CustID = b.CustID and b.TrnRefID = @p_TrnID)

	declare @GhiChu nvarchar(max)
	set @GhiChu = ''
	select @GhiChu = @GhiChu + Coalesce(isnull(Notes,''),'/')
	from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL
	where TrnID = @p_TrnID
	and Notes is not null and Notes <> ''

	declare @TongTienBot numeric(18,3)
	declare @TongCongBan numeric(18,3)
	declare @TongCongThem numeric(18,3)
	declare @SumGoldWeightSell NUMERIC(19,8), @SumDiamondWeightSell NUMERIC(19,8)
	select @TongTienBot = sum(isnull(Discounts,0)* XRate),
		   @TongCongBan = sum(isnull(TaskPrice,0)* XRateTaskPrice),
		   @TongCongThem = sum(isnull(TienCongThemMonHang,0)* XRateTaskPrice),
		   @SumGoldWeightSell = Sum(TotalWeight-ISNULL(DiamondWeight,0)), 
		   @SumDiamondWeightSell = Sum(DiamondWeight)
	from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL 
	where TrnID = @p_TrnID

	declare @SumGoldWeightBG NUMERIC(19,8), @SumDiamondWeightBG NUMERIC(19,8)
	select @SumGoldWeightBG = Sum(GoldWeight), 
	@SumDiamondWeightBG = Sum(DiamondWeight)
	from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_BUYGOLD
	where TrnID = @p_TrnID

	
	declare @BankName nvarchar(max)
	set @BankName = ''
	select @BankName = @BankName + Coalesce(isnull(BC.BankName,''),'/')
	from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_CardPay SCP
	inner join I_BankCard BC on SCP.IDCard = BC.NumberBank
	where TrnID = @p_TrnID

	declare @TienQT numeric(18,3)
	declare @TienCK numeric(18,3)

	Select @TienQT = Sum(Amount) -- Quẹt thẻ
	From TRN_RT_BUYSELL_CardPay
	Where PayType='QT' and TrnID = @p_TrnID

	Select @TienCK = Sum(Amount) -- Chuyển khoản
	From TRN_RT_BUYSELL_CardPay
	Where PayType='CK' and TrnID = @p_TrnID

	DECLARE @HinhAnh TABLE(ProductCode varchar(20), Image VARBINARY(MAX))

	DECLARE @ProductCode NVARCHAR(50)
	DECLARE @ImagePath NVARCHAR(1000)
	DECLARE @FileExists INT

	DECLARE @LuuAnhBangDuongDan int
	SELECT @LuuAnhBangDuongDan = ParaValue FROM dbo.SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'LuuAnhBangDuongDan'

	IF @LuuAnhBangDuongDan = 1
	BEGIN
		
		DECLARE cursorProduct CURSOR FOR 
		SELECT DISTINCT ss.ProductCode, tpi.ImagePath from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL ss
		INNER JOIN dbo.T_PRODUCT tp ON ss.ProductCode = tp.ProductCode
		LEFT JOIN TRN_PRODUCT_IN tpi ON tpi.TrnID=tp.InTrnID
		WHERE ss.TrnID = @p_TrnID

		OPEN cursorProduct       

		FETCH NEXT FROM cursorProduct   
			  INTO @ProductCode, @ImagePath

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0        
		BEGIN           
			-- Kiểm tra xem tệp tồn tại hay không
			IF @ImagePath <> '' AND @ImagePath IS NOT NULL
			BEGIN
				DECLARE @SqlQuery NVARCHAR(MAX);
				SET @SqlQuery = N'SELECT ''' + @ProductCode + ''' ProductCode, BulkColumn FROM OPENROWSET(BULK ''' + @ImagePath + ''', SINGLE_BLOB) AS ImageData;';
				INSERT INTO @HinhAnh(ProductCode,Image)
				EXEC sp_executesql @SqlQuery 
			END
			ELSE
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO @HinhAnh(ProductCode,Image)
				SELECT @ProductCode,NULL
			END

			FETCH NEXT FROM cursorProduct 
				  INTO @ProductCode,@ImagePath
		END

		CLOSE cursorProduct              
		DEALLOCATE cursorProduct 
		SET @FileExists = 1
    END
	ELSE
    BEGIN
		SET @FileExists = 0
    end

	SELECT 	RT.TrnDate, RT.TrnTime, RT.BillCode, CustCode, CustName, C.Address CustAddress,
		SellTotalAmount, BuyTotalAmount, TotalAmount,  
		case when @TongTienBot is not null and @TongTienBot <> 0 then @TongTienBot else Discount end Discount, PayAmount,
		SRT.ProductCode, SRT.ProductDesc, GoldDesc,SP.SupplierName,TS.SectionName,TM.MainSectionName,
		CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' THEN SRT.TotalWeight/@sHeso ELSE SRT.TotalWeight END TotalWeight,
		CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' THEN ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)/@sHeso  ELSE ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) END DiamondWeight ,
		dbo.GoldWeightToChar(ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0),IG.WeightUnit) DiamondWeightChar,
		dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Report(ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0),tp.WeightUnit) DiamondWeightChar_Bill,
		CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' THEN (SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) + ISNULL(CatNi,0))/@sHeso ELSE (SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) + ISNULL(CatNi,0)) END  RealGoldWeight,
		CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' THEN (SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0))/@sHeso ELSE (SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)) END  GoldWeight,
		dbo.GoldWeightToChar((SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) + ISNULL(CatNi,0)),tp.WeightUnit) RealGoldWeightChar, 
		dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Report((SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) + ISNULL(CatNi,0)),tp.WeightUnit) RealGoldWeightChar_Bill, 
		dbo.GoldWeightToChar((SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)),tp.WeightUnit) GoldWeightChar, 
		dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Report((SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)),tp.WeightUnit) GoldWeightChar_Bill, 
		SRT.TaskPrice, SellRate, SellAmount,
		PG.GroupName,
		CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' THEN  SRT.CatNi/@sHeso ELSE SRT.CatNi END CatNi,
		dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Bill(ISNULL(CatNi,0),tp.WeightUnit) CatNiChar,
		tpi.DiamondDlt,isnull(RT.AddMoney,0) TienBu, emp.EmpName, RT.AddMoney, RT.TaskPriceAdd, tp.RingSize, isnull(SRT.DiamondPrice,0) DiamondPrice,ISNULL(SRT.SL,1) SL,
		CASE WHEN tp.WeightUnit='L' THEN (SRT.TotalWeight + ISNULL(CatNi,0))/@sHeso ELSE (SRT.TotalWeight + ISNULL(CatNi,0)) END  RealTotalWeight,
		dbo.GoldWeightToChar((SRT.TotalWeight + ISNULL(CatNi,0)),tp.WeightUnit) RealTotalWeightChar,
		dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Report((SRT.TotalWeight + ISNULL(CatNi,0)),tp.WeightUnit) RealTotalWeightChar_Bill,

	DECLARE @tbl TABLE
(
	ProductCodeDiamond VARCHAR(50),
	TienDa NUMERIC(18,7)
)
INSERT INTO @tbl
	select TP.ProductCodeDiamond
		, SUM(khd.SL * dmd.GiaBan) AS  TienDa
	from #Buysell BS
		join Trn_rt_buysell_Sell BSS on BSS.trnId=BS.TrnID
		join t_product TP on TP.ProductID = BSS.ProductID
		LEFT join (select MaKieu, MaDa, sum(SL) AS SL FROM KieuHang_Da GROUP BY MaKieu, MaDa) khd On khd.MaKieu = tp.MaKieu
		left join DanhMucDa dmd on khd.MaDa = dmd.MaDa 
	WHERE BS.TrnID = @p_TrnID and ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> ''
	group by TP.ProductCodeDiamond

select BSS.ProductID
	, CASE WHEN ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> '' THEN '' ELSE  BSS.ProductCode END AS ProductCode
	, CASE WHEN ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> '' THEN '' ELSE BSS.ProductDesc END AS ProductDesc
	, khd.SL ,dmd.TenDa, dmd.KichThuoc, dmd.GiaBan
	, ISNULL((SELECT TienDa FROM @tbl T1 WHERE T1.ProductCodeDiamond = BSS.ProductCode) * CASE WHEN BSS.PriceCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong AND @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN 1000 ELSE BSS.XRate END ,
	(khd.SL * dmd.GiaBan) * CASE WHEN BSS.PriceCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong AND @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN 1000 ELSE BSS.XRate END) AS TienDa
	, CASE WHEN ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> '' THEN 0 ELSE BSS.TotalWeight END AS TotalWeight
	, CASE WHEN ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> '' THEN 0 ELSE (BSS.TotalWeight - BSS.DiamondWeight) END AS GoldWeight
	, (BSS.TaskPrice * CASE WHEN BSS.PriceCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong AND @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN 1000 ELSE BSS.XRate END)  AS TaskPrice
	, CASE WHEN ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> '' THEN 0 ELSE (BSS.SellAmount - (BSS.TaskPrice * CASE WHEN BSS.PriceCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong AND @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN 1000 ELSE BSS.XRate END)) END AS SellAmount
	,(ISNULL((SELECT TienDa FROM @tbl T1 WHERE T1.ProductCodeDiamond = BSS.ProductCode) * CASE WHEN BSS.PriceCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong AND @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN 1000 ELSE BSS.XRate END, 0)
		+ CASE WHEN ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> '' THEN 0 ELSE BSS.SellAmount END) AS PayAmount --SellAmount da co cong TaskPrice
	, TP.ProductCodeDiamond 
	, CASE WHEN ISNULL(TP.ProductCodeDiamond,'') <> '' THEN '' ELSE  tpi.Image END AS [Image], tp.RingSize
from #Buysell BS
	join Trn_rt_buysell_Sell BSS on BSS.trnId=BS.TrnID
	join t_product TP on TP.ProductID = BSS.ProductID
	LEFT JOIN TRN_PRODUCT_IN tpi ON tpi.TrnID = Tp.InTrnID
	LEFT join (select MaKieu, MaDa, sum(SL) AS SL FROM KieuHang_Da GROUP BY MaKieu, MaDa) khd On khd.MaKieu = tp.MaKieu
	left join DanhMucDa dmd on khd.MaDa = dmd.MaDa
WHERE BS.TrnID = @p_TrnID 
ORDER BY BSS.ProductCode

	LEFT JOIN TRN_DATCOC_DT DCD on DC.TrnID=DCD.TrnID
	LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER IC on DC.CustID=IC.CustID
	LEFT JOIN I_GOLD IG on DCD.GoldCode=IG.GoldCode
	WHERE BS.TrnID=@p_TrnID

	--Thanh toán thẻ--    LUÔN LUÔN NẰM CUỐI --- không đánh số cố định
	DECLARE @QRCode VARBINARY(MAX)
	SET @QRCode = NULL

	DECLARE @MoTaTTThe NVARCHAR(200)
	SELECT @MoTaTTThe = TRB.BillCode + TE.EmpName FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL TRB 
	LEFT JOIN dbo.T_EMPLOYEE TE ON TE.EmpID = TRB.EmpID 
	WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID

	IF	EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL_CardPay WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID)
	BEGIN
		--Có thanh toán thẻ
		SELECT TRBC.Amount, ib.AccName, ib.NumberBank, tb.Bin , @MoTaTTThe MoTaTTThe, tb.ShortName BankName, ib.BankBranch, @QRCode QRCode
		FROM dbo.TRN_RT_BUYSELL_CardPay TRBC
		INNER JOIN dbo.I_BankCard ib ON TRBC.IDCard = ib.NumberBank
		LEFT JOIN dbo.T_BANK tb ON ib.BankKey = tb.Id
		WHERE TRBC.TrnID = @p_TrnID
	END
	ELSE	
	BEGIN
		--Không có thanh toán thẻ. Lấy từ tài khoản mặc định cho cửa hàng
		DECLARE @Amount NUMERIC(18,3)
		DECLARE @ShopID NVARCHAR(200)
		SELECT @Amount = PayAmount, @ShopID = ShopID FROM dbo.TRN_RT_BUYSELL WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID	
		SELECT @Amount Amount, ib.AccName, ib.NumberBank, tb.Bin , @MoTaTTThe MoTaTTThe, tb.ShortName BankName, ib.BankBranch, @QRCode QRCode
		FROM dbo.I_BankCard ib
		LEFT JOIN dbo.T_BANK tb ON ib.BankKey = tb.Id
		WHERE ib.TaiKhoanMacDinh = 1 AND ib.ShopID = @ShopID
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME='RetailLog')
	BEGIN
	/* BEGIN: Ghi lại log thực thi */
	if exists (select top 1 1 from TRN_RT_BUYSELL where TrnID = @p_TrnID)
	begin
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
		select getdate() DateLog, 'rptSRT_PrintBill' StoreName, TrnID, BillCode, @xemtruoc + ' - TinhTrang' + [Status] LogMsg,
		ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
		from TRN_RT_BUYSELL where TrnID = @p_TrnID
	end
	else
	begin
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
		select getdate() DateLog, 'rptSRT_PrintBill' StoreName, @p_TrnID TrnID, '' BillCode, @xemtruoc + '- LostData' LogMsg,
		ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
	end
	/* END: Ghi lại log thực thi */
	END

name: TRN_RT_BUYSELL_Sync_Complete
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TRN_RT_BUYSELL_Sync_Complete]
	@p_TrnID VARCHAR(15),
	@p_UserID VARCHAR(15),
	@p_ThuHo VARCHAR(1)
AS
	DECLARE @sErr nvarchar(100), @sErrCode varchar(100), @p_ErrorCode1 nvarchar(MAX)
	DECLARE @sTillTxnID varchar(15), @sQtyP varchar(20), @sQtyR varchar(20)
	DECLARE @sProductID varchar(20), @SL numeric(10,0), @sTotalWeight_Sell numeric(19,8), @sDiamondWeight_Sell numeric(18,3)
	DECLARE @sProductTypeCode varchar(15), @sProductCode varchar(20), @sSectionIDBan varchar(20), @sTaskPrice numeric(18,3)
	DECLARE @sBillCode nvarchar(20)
SET XACT_ABORT ON;
BEGIN TRANSACTION
BEGIN TRY
    DECLARE @MaTienTeHeThong Varchar(10)    
    SELECT @MaTienTeHeThong = ParaValue From SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'MaTienTeHeThong'
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID )
	BEGIN
		SET @sErr = (SELECT ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR WHERE ErrorCode = 'B-001')
		SET @p_ErrorCode1 = 'B-001'
		GOTO ABORT
	END
	
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID and [Status]='W')
	BEGIN
		SET @sErr = (SELECT ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR WHERE ErrorCode = 'B-002')
		SET @p_ErrorCode1 = 'B-002'
		GOTO ABORT
	END
	------ UPDATE Status --------
	-- Cập nhật lại billcode nếu para TaoMaHDParam = true
	  	
	DECLARE @sShopCode varchar(max)
	DECLARE @ShopID varchar(15)
	select @sShopCode = ISNULL(TS.ShopCode,'') , @ShopID = TS.ShopID 
	From T_Shop TS INNER JOIN TRN_RT_BUYSELL PM ON TS.ShopID = PM.ShopID 
	Where PM.TrnID = @p_TrnID
    
	DECLARE @TaoMaHDParam int
	SET @TaoMaHDParam = (SELECT ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'TaoSoHDKhiThanhToan')
	IF (@TaoMaHDParam = 1)
		BEGIN
			EXEC SYS_BILL_COUNTER_Gen 'SRT', @sShopCode, @sBillCode OUTPUT
			UPDATE TRN_RT_BUYSELL SET BillCode = @sBillCode, Status='C', ThuHo = @p_ThuHo WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
		END
	ELSE
		UPDATE TRN_RT_BUYSELL SET Status='C', ThuHo = @p_ThuHo WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
		
	SET @sBillCode = (SELECT BillCode FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID)
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	if(isnull(@sBillCode,'') = '')
	begin
		SET @sErr = N'Không phát sinh được mã hóa đơn'
			GOTO ABORT
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_DATCOC DT join TRN_RT_BUYSELL_DatCoc BDC on DT.TrnID=BDC.DatCocID
	WHERE BDC.TrnID=@p_TrnID and DT.[Status]<>'P')
	BEGIN
		SET @sErr = N'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại phiếu đặt cọc'
			GOTO ABORT
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL_DatCoc where TrnID=@p_TrnID)
	BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_DATCOC DT join TRN_RT_BUYSELL_DatCoc BDC on DT.TrnID=BDC.DatCocID WHERE BDC.TrnID=@p_TrnID)
		BEGIN
			SET @sErr = N'Phiếu đặt cọc không tồn tại. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại'
			GOTO ABORT
		END
	END
	
	DECLARE @sTrnDate varchar(10), @sTrnTime varchar(20), @SellDate DATETIME, @sDate DATETIME
	SELECT @sTrnDate = CONVERT(varchar(10), TrnDate, 103), @sTrnTime = convert(varchar(10), TrnTime, 108) , @sDate = TrnDate	
	FROM dbo.TRN_RT_BUYSELL WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	
	SET @SellDate = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(DATETIME, @sDate, 101) + ' ' + @sTrnTime) 

	DECLARE @sCustID VARCHAR(20)
	DECLARE @sDebit NUMERIC(18,3)
	DECLARE @sOldDebit NUMERIC(18,3)
	DECLARE @CongNoBanLe nvarchar(500)
	SELECT @sDebit = s.DebitAmount,@sOldDebit=s.OldDebitAmount, @sCustID = s.CustID
	FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL s WHERE s.TrnID = @p_TrnID

	------------------Kiểm tra hàng mua lại có hợp lệ------------------------------
	SELECT TrnCode,CRDR,TrnID, ProductCode, ProductID, MaHangGoc
		into #Tracking
		FROM T_PRODUCT_TRACKING t
		WHERE STT = (select MAX(STT) from T_PRODUCT_TRACKING t1 where t.ProductCode = t1.ProductCode)
		and ProductCode in (select ProductCode from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_BUYGOLD where TrnID = @p_TrnID and ProductCode is not null and ProductCode <> '')

		if exists (select top 1 1 from #Tracking where TrnCode not in ('SRT', 'PRODOUT', 'CRT') and CRDR <> '-')
		begin
			SET @sErr = N'Mã hàng thu mua không ở tình trạng xuất bán'
			GOTO ABORT
		END

	-------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	DECLARE @CachTichDiem nvarchar(100)
	SELECT  @CachTichDiem = FnValue FROM SYS_FUNCTION WHERE FnCode = '29'

	
	SELECT @CongNoBanLe = ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'CongNoBanLe'
	-- Hoạch toán công nợ thợ
	IF( @sDebit IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
		declare @update table(TrnDate datetime,DebtAmount numeric(19,8))

		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM T_CUSTOMER_DEBT a
		          WHERE a.CustID = @sCustID AND a.GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong)
		BEGIN
			IF @CongNoBanLe = '1'
			BEGIN
				UPDATE T_CUSTOMER_DEBT
				SET Debt_Bal = CASE WHEN @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN Debt_Bal	+ (@sDebit-@sOldDebit)/1000
								ELSE Debt_Bal	+ (@sDebit-@sOldDebit) END,LastModify = GETDATE()
				output getdate() as TrnDate, inserted.Debt_Bal - deleted.Debt_Bal as DebtAmount
				into @update
				WHERE CustID = @sCustID AND GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			END
			ELSE IF @CongNoBanLe = '0'
			BEGIN
				UPDATE T_CUSTOMER_DEBT
				SET Debt_Bal = CASE WHEN @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN Debt_Bal + @sDebit/1000
								ELSE Debt_Bal + @sDebit END,LastModify = GETDATE()
				
				output getdate() as TrnDate, inserted.Debt_Bal - deleted.Debt_Bal as DebtAmount
				into @update
				WHERE CustID = @sCustID AND GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			END
		END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				INSERT INTO T_CUSTOMER_DEBT(CustID,GoldCcy,Debt_Bal,LastModify)
				output getdate() as TrnDate, inserted.Debt_Bal as DebtAmount
				into @update
				VALUES(@sCustID, @MaTienTeHeThong, @sDebit/1000,GETDATE())
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			END

		INSERT INTO I_LichSuCongNo (TrnDate,TrnType,TrnID,IDLog,CustID,GoldCcy,DebtAmount, ShopID)
		select TrnDate,'SRT',@p_TrnID,null,@sCustID, @MaTienTeHeThong,DebtAmount, @ShopID
		from @update
		where DebtAmount <> 0
		IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	END
	-- Update tình trạng xuất bán
	DECLARE pCurP CURSOR FOR
		SELECT ProductID, SL, TotalWeight,DiamondWeight,SectionID, ProductCode, TaskPrice
		FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL
		WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID

		OPEN pCurP
		FETCH NEXT FROM pCurP INTO @sProductID, @SL, @sTotalWeight_Sell,@sDiamondWeight_Sell, @sSectionIDBan, @sProductCode, @sTaskPrice

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT @sQtyP = tp.SL,@sQtyR = tp.Real_SL, @sProductTypeCode = ProductTypeCode FROM T_PRODUCT tp
		WHERE ProductID = @sProductID
		IF(@sProductTypeCode = 'TTM' or @sProductTypeCode = 'DMN')
		BEGIN
			UPDATE T_PRODUCT
			SET	[Status]	= 'S',
				SellTrnID	= @p_TrnID,
				SellTrnType = 'SRT',
				SellOutDate = @SellDate
			WHERE ProductID = @sProductID
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
		END
		ELSE IF(@sProductTypeCode = 'KLT')
			BEGIN
				UPDATE SECTION_PRODUCT
      			SET [SL] = [SL] - isnull(@SL,1)
      			WHERE SectionID = @sSectionIDBan AND ProductCode = @sProductCode
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			END
		ELSE IF(@sProductTypeCode = 'STN')
			BEGIN
				UPDATE T_PRODUCT
				SET	[Status]	= 'S',
					SellTrnID	= @p_TrnID,
					SellTrnType = 'SRT',
					SellOutDate = @SellDate
				WHERE ProductID = @sProductID
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			END
		ELSE IF(@sProductTypeCode = 'CTL')
			BEGIN
				UPDATE SECTION_PRODUCT
      			SET [SL] = [SL] - isnull(@SL,1),
      				TotalWeight = TotalWeight - @sTotalWeight_Sell,
      				DiamondWeight = DiamondWeight - @sDiamondWeight_Sell	
      			WHERE SectionID = @sSectionIDBan AND ProductCode = @sProductCode
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			END
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM T_PRODUCT WHERE ProductCode = @sProductCode AND TaskPrice <> @sTaskPrice)
		BEGIN
		INSERT INTO ChangeTaskPrice_Log ([TrnID]
		,[ChangeType]
		,[ChangeDate]
		,[UserID]
		,[Productcode]
		,[OldTaskPrice]
		,[NewTaskPrice])
		select
		@p_TrnID
		,'SRT'
		,GETDATE()
		,@p_UserID
		,[ProductCode]
		,[TaskPrice]
		,@sTaskPrice
		from T_PRODUCT WHERE ProductCode = @sProductCode
	--GOTO ABORT
		END
		FETCH NEXT FROM pCurP INTO @sProductID, @SL, @sTotalWeight_Sell,@sDiamondWeight_Sell, @sSectionIDBan, @sProductCode, @sTaskPrice
	END
	CLOSE pCurP
	DEALLOCATE pCurP
		
	---- Insert Daily log ------------
	DECLARE @sSectionID varchar(15)
	DECLARE @sGoldCcy varchar(20), @sPriceUnit varchar(3)
	DECLARE @sQty INT
	DECLARE @sTotalWeight numeric(19,8), @sGoldWeight numeric(19,8), @sStampWeight numeric(19,8)
	DECLARE @sTrnDesc nvarchar(500), @sCRDR varchar(1),@sGiaBanMon NUMERIC(18,3)
	DECLARE @TrnRefCode VARCHAR(30)	
	DECLARE @RefCRDR VARCHAR(1)
	DECLARE @TrnRefID VARCHAR(15)


	SET @sTrnDesc = N'XUẤT BÁN HÀNG NGÀY ' + @sTrnDate
	SET @sCRDR = '-'

	DECLARE pCur CURSOR FOR
		SELECT SectionID, GoldCode, SUM(ISNULL(SL,1)) Qty, SUM(ISNULL(TotalWeight,0)) TotalWeight,
			SUM(ISNULL(TotalWeight,0) - ISNULL(DiamondWeight, 0)) GoldWeight,
			SUM(ISNULL(StampWeight,0)) StampWeight ,SUM(ISNULL(SellRate,0)) SellRate
		FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL
		WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
		GROUP BY SectionID, GoldCode

	OPEN pCur
	FETCH NEXT FROM pCur INTO @sSectionID, @sGoldCcy, @sQty, @sTotalWeight, @sGoldWeight, @sStampWeight, @sGiaBanMon

	-- Hoạch toán tồn kho
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT @sPriceUnit = PriceUnit FROM I_GOLD WHERE GoldCode = @sGoldCcy
		IF @sPriceUnit IN ('L','G','M')
		BEGIN
			-- Hoạch toán khối lượng tổng
			EXEC TRN_DAILY_LOG_Ins
				@p_RelatedID = @sSectionID,		@p_TrnRefID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnCode 	 = 'SRT',			@p_TrnType 	= 'RT',
				@p_TrnDate 	 = @sTrnDate,		@p_TrnTime 	= @sTrnTime,
				@p_GoldCcy	 = @sGoldCcy,		@p_CRDR 	= @sCRDR,
				@p_Amount 	 = @sTotalWeight,	@p_TrnDesc 	= @sTrnDesc,
				@p_AmountTag = 'PROD_WEI',		@p_Status 	= 'C',
				@p_UserID 	 = @p_UserID,		@p_IsDel 	= 'N'
			IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			-- Hoạch toán khối lượng vàng
			EXEC TRN_DAILY_LOG_Ins
				@p_RelatedID = @sSectionID,		@p_TrnRefID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnCode 	 = 'SRT',			@p_TrnType 	= 'RT',
				@p_TrnDate 	 = @sTrnDate,		@p_TrnTime 	= @sTrnTime,
				@p_GoldCcy	 = @sGoldCcy,		@p_CRDR 	= @sCRDR,
				@p_Amount 	 = @sGoldWeight,	@p_TrnDesc 	= @sTrnDesc,
				@p_AmountTag = 'PROD_GOLDWEI',	@p_Status 	= 'C',
				@p_UserID 	 = @p_UserID,		@p_IsDel 	= 'N'
			IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			-- Hoạch toán số lượng
			EXEC TRN_DAILY_LOG_Ins
				@p_RelatedID = @sSectionID,		@p_TrnRefID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnCode 	 = 'SRT',			@p_TrnType 	= 'RT',
				@p_TrnDate 	 = @sTrnDate,		@p_TrnTime 	= @sTrnTime,
				@p_GoldCcy	 = @sGoldCcy,		@p_CRDR 	= @sCRDR,
				@p_Amount 	 = @sQty,			@p_TrnDesc 	= @sTrnDesc,
				@p_AmountTag = 'PROD_QTY',		@p_Status 	= 'C',
				@p_UserID 	 = @p_UserID,		@p_IsDel 	= 'N'
			IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			-- Hoạch toán khối lượng tem
			EXEC TRN_DAILY_LOG_Ins
				@p_RelatedID = @sSectionID,		@p_TrnRefID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnCode 	 = 'SRT',			@p_TrnType 	= 'RT',
				@p_TrnDate 	 = @sTrnDate,		@p_TrnTime 	= @sTrnTime,
				@p_GoldCcy	 = @sGoldCcy,		@p_CRDR 	= @sCRDR,
				@p_Amount 	 = @sStampWeight,	@p_TrnDesc 	= @sTrnDesc,
				@p_AmountTag = 'PROD_STAMPWEI',	@p_Status 	= 'C',
				@p_UserID 	 = @p_UserID,		@p_IsDel 	= 'N'
			IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
						
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM pCur INTO @sSectionID, @sGoldCcy, @sQty, @sTotalWeight, @sGoldWeight, @sStampWeight,@sGiaBanMon
	END
	CLOSE pCur
	DEALLOCATE pCur

	--------------insert T_PRODUCT_TRACKING hàng bán ----------------------------------
	INSERT INTO T_PRODUCT_TRACKING (ProductID, ProductCode, TrnCode, CRDR, TrnID, TrnRefCode, RefCRDR, TrnRefID, MaHangGoc)
	select t.ProductID, t.ProductCode, 'SRT', '-', @p_TrnID, t.TrnCode, t.CRDR,t.TrnID , t.MaHangGoc
	from T_PRODUCT_TRACKING t
	inner join T_PRODUCT p on t.ProductCode = p.ProductCode
	where p.ProductTypeCode not in ('KLT','CTL') 
	and t.ProductCode in (select ProductCode from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL where TrnID = @p_TrnID)
	and STT = (select MAX(STT) from T_PRODUCT_TRACKING t1 where t.ProductCode = t1.ProductCode)
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	--------------insert T_PRODUCT_TRACKING hàng mua lại ----------------------------------
	INSERT INTO T_PRODUCT_TRACKING (ProductID, ProductCode, TrnCode, CRDR, TrnID, TrnRefCode, RefCRDR, TrnRefID, MaHangGoc)
	select t.ProductID, t.ProductCode, 'SRT', '+', @p_TrnID, t.TrnCode, t.CRDR,t.TrnID, t.MaHangGoc 
	from #Tracking t
	inner join T_PRODUCT p on t.ProductCode = p.ProductCode
	where p.ProductTypeCode not in ('KLT','CTL')
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	------ Insert TILL TXN -------------
	EXEC TRN_TILL_TXN_Ins
		@p_TrnID = @p_TrnID,
		@p_TrnType = 'RT',
		@p_TrnCode = 'SRT',
		@p_ErrCOde = @sErrCode OUT
		SET @sErr = (SELECT se.ErrorDesc
		               FROM SYS_ERROR se WHERE se.ErrorCode = @sErrCode)
	IF @sErrCode <> '0' GOTO ABORT
	----- Sau khi insert vao giao dich till, Lay lai TillTxnID
	SELECT @sTillTxnID = TillTxnID
	FROM T_TILL_TXN
	WHERE TrnRefID = @p_TrnID
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME='RetailLog')
BEGIN
/* BEGIN: Ghi lại log thực thi */
if exists (select top 1 1 from TRN_RT_BUYSELL where TrnID = @p_TrnID)
begin
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
	select getdate() DateLog, 'TRN_RT_BUYSELL_Sync_Complete' StoreName, @p_TrnID TrnID, @sBillCode BillCode, 'Complete_success_TinhTrang' + [Status]  LogMsg,
	ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
	from TRN_RT_BUYSELL where TrnID = @p_TrnID
end
ELSE
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
	SELECT GETDATE() DateLog, 'TRN_RT_BUYSELL_Sync_Complete' StoreName, @p_TrnID TrnID, @sBillCode BillCode, 'Complete_success_LostData' LogMsg,
	ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
END
/* END: Ghi lại log thực thi */
END

SELECT 0 AS ErrCode, @p_TrnID TrnID, @sTillTxnID TillTxnID, @sBillCode BillCode, '' ErrorDesc, 
	0 DiemTichLuy,0 DiemDoiQua, 0 TongDiemTL, '' NangHang
RETURN 0
ABORT:

BEGIN
ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','pCurP')) >= -1
	 BEGIN
	 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','pCurP')) > -1
		BEGIN
			CLOSE pCurP
		END
	 DEALLOCATE pCurP
 END
 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','pCur')) >= -1
	 BEGIN
	 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','pCur')) > -1
		BEGIN
			CLOSE pCur
		END
	 DEALLOCATE pCur
 END
 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','CUR')) >= -1
	 BEGIN
	 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','CUR')) > -1
		BEGIN
			CLOSE CUR
		END
	 DEALLOCATE CUR
 END
 	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME='RetailLog')
	BEGIN
	/* BEGIN: Ghi lại log thực thi */
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
		SELECT GETDATE() DateLog, 'TRN_RT_BUYSELL_Sync_Complete' StoreName, @p_TrnID TrnID, @sBillCode BillCode, 'ABORT_TinhTrang' + [Status] + ' - ' + @sErr LogMsg,
		ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
		FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
		SELECT GETDATE() DateLog, 'TRN_RT_BUYSELL_Sync_Complete' StoreName, @p_TrnID TrnID, @sBillCode BillCode, 'ABORT - LostData - ' + @sErr LogMsg,
		ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
	END
	/* END: Ghi lại log thực thi */
	END
SELECT -1 AS ErrCode, @p_ErrorCode1 ErrorCode1, '' TrnID, '' TillTxnID, @sErr ErrorDesc, @sBillCode BillCode, 
0 AS DiemTichLuy,0 AS DiemDoiQua, 0 AS TongDiemTL, '' NangHang
RETURN -1
END
END TRY

	BEGIN

	BEGIN

		SELECT GETDATE() DateLog, 'TRN_RT_BUYSELL_Sync_Complete' StoreName, @p_TrnID TrnID, @sBillCode BillCode, 'TryCatch_TinhTrang' + [Status] LogMsg,

		SELECT GETDATE() DateLog, 'TRN_RT_BUYSELL_Sync_Complete' StoreName, @p_TrnID TrnID, @sBillCode BillCode, 'TryCatch Error_LostData' LogMsg,
		ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
