name: TRN_RT_CHANGE_Sync_Complete
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[TRN_RT_CHANGE_Sync_Complete]
	@p_TrnID VARCHAR(15),
	@p_UserID VARCHAR(15),
	@p_ThuHo VARCHAR(1)
AS
	DECLARE @sErr nvarchar(300), @sErrCode varchar(100), @p_ErrorCode1 nvarchar(MAX)
	DECLARE @sTillTxnID varchar(15), @SL numeric(10,0), @sQtyP varchar(20)
	DECLARE @sProductID varchar(20), @sTotalWeight_Change numeric(19,8), @sProductTypeCode varchar(15)
    DECLARE @sCustID varchar(20), @sProductCode varchar(20), @sSectionIDBan varchar(20)
	DECLARE @sBillCode nvarchar(20), @sDiamondWeight numeric(19,8), @sTaskPrice numeric(18,3)
	DECLARE @sTrnDate varchar(10), @sTrnTime varchar(20), @SellDate DATETIME, @sDate DATETIME
SET XACT_ABORT ON;
BEGIN TRANSACTION
BEGIN TRY
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID )
	BEGIN
		SET @sErr = (SELECT ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR WHERE ErrorCode = 'B-001')
		SET @p_ErrorCode1 = 'B-001'
		GOTO ABORT
	END
	
	IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID and [Status]='W')
	BEGIN
		SET @sErr = (SELECT ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR WHERE ErrorCode = 'B-002')
		SET @p_ErrorCode1 = 'B-002'
		GOTO ABORT
	END
	  	
	DECLARE @sShopCode varchar(max)
	DECLARE @ShopID varchar(max)
	select @sShopCode = ISNULL(TS.ShopCode,'') , @ShopID = TS.ShopID
	From T_Shop TS INNER JOIN TRN_RT_CHANGE PM ON TS.ShopID = PM.ShopID 
	Where PM.TrnID = @p_TrnID
    
	DECLARE @TaoSoHDKhiThanhToan int
	SET @TaoSoHDKhiThanhToan = (SELECT ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'TaoSoHDKhiThanhToan')
	IF (@TaoSoHDKhiThanhToan = 1)
		BEGIN
			EXEC SYS_BILL_COUNTER_Gen 'CRT', @sShopCode, @sBillCode OUTPUT
			UPDATE TRN_RT_CHANGE SET BillCode = @sBillCode, Status='C',ThuHo = @p_ThuHo WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
		END
	ELSE
		UPDATE TRN_RT_CHANGE SET Status='C',ThuHo = @p_ThuHo WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
		SET @sBillCode = (SELECT BillCode FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID)
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	
	if(isnull(@sBillCode,'') = '')
	begin
		SET @sErr = N'Không phát sinh được mã hóa đơn'
			GOTO ABORT
	END
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_DATCOC DT join TRN_RT_CHANGE_DATCOC BDC on DT.TrnID=BDC.DatCocID
	WHERE BDC.TrnID=@p_TrnID and DT.[Status]<>'P')
	BEGIN
		SET @sErr = N'Vui lòng kiểm tra lại phiếu đặt cọc'
			GOTO ABORT
	END

	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE_DATCOC where TrnID=@p_TrnID)
	BEGIN
		IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_DATCOC DT join TRN_RT_CHANGE_DATCOC BDC on DT.TrnID=BDC.DatCocID WHERE BDC.TrnID=@p_TrnID)
		BEGIN
			SET @sErr = N'Phiếu đặt cọc không tồn tại. Vui lòng kiểm tra lại'
			GOTO ABORT
		END
	END
	
	SELECT @sCustID = s.CustID, @sTrnDate = CONVERT(varchar(10), TrnDate, 103), @sTrnTime = convert(varchar(10), TrnTime, 108), @sDate = TrnDate
	FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE s WHERE s.TrnID = @p_TrnID

	SET @SellDate = CONVERT(DATETIME, CONVERT(DATETIME, @sDate, 101) + ' ' + @sTrnTime) 

	DECLARE @MaTienTeHeThong Varchar(10)    
    SELECT @MaTienTeHeThong = ParaValue From SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'MaTienTeHeThong'
	------ UPDATE Status --------
	
	DECLARE @CongNoBanLe nvarchar(500)
	SELECT @CongNoBanLe = ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'CongNoBanLe'

	DECLARE @CONGNO TABLE (TrnDate datetime, TrnID VARCHAR(15), OldDebt numeric(19,8), NewDebt  numeric(19,8))
	-- cập nhật công nợ khách
	IF @CongNoBanLe = '1'
	BEGIN
		IF EXISTS(SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM T_CUSTOMER_DEBT a
		          WHERE a.CustID = @sCustID AND a.GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong)
		BEGIN
			UPDATE A
			SET Debt_Bal = CASE WHEN @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN isnull(Debt_Bal,0) + (B.PayAmount - B.KhachTra)/1000
							ELSE isnull(Debt_Bal,0)	+ (B.PayAmount - B.KhachTra) END, A.LastModify = GETDATE()
				output getdate() as TrnDate, @p_TrnID TrnID, isnull(deleted.Debt_Bal,0) OldDebt, inserted.Debt_Bal NewDebt into @CONGNO
			FROM T_CUSTOMER_DEBT A INNER JOIN TRN_RT_CHANGE B ON A.CustID = B.CustID AND GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong
			WHERE B.TrnID = @p_TrnID 
			IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
		END
		ELSE
		BEGIN
			INSERT INTO T_CUSTOMER_DEBT(CustID,GoldCcy,Debt_Bal,LastModify)
			output getdate() as TrnDate, @p_TrnID TrnID, 0 as OldDebt, inserted.Debt_Bal NewDebt into @CONGNO
			SELECT @sCustID as CustID, @MaTienTeHeThong as GoldCcy,
			CASE WHEN @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN (B.PayAmount - B.KhachTra)/1000 ELSE (B.PayAmount - B.KhachTra) END as Debt_Bal,GETDATE()
			FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE B
			WHERE B.TrnID = @p_TrnID
			IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
		END
		
		INSERT INTO I_LichSuCongNo (TrnDate,TrnType,TrnID,IDLog,CustID,GoldCcy,DebtAmount,ShopID)
		select TrnDate,'CRT',TrnID,null,@sCustID, @MaTienTeHeThong,NewDebt - OldDebt, @ShopID
		from @CONGNO
		where OldDebt <> NewDebt
		IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

		UPDATE A
		SET A.NoCu = CASE WHEN @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN B.OldDebt*1000 ELSE B.OldDebt END , 
		A.NoMoi = CASE WHEN @MaTienTeHeThong = 'VND' THEN B.NewDebt*1000 ELSE B.NewDebt END
		FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE A INNER JOIN @CONGNO B ON A.TrnID = B.TrnID
		IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	END

	--- UPDATE TINH TRANG HANG DA XUAT BAN
		DECLARE pCurP CURSOR FOR
			SELECT ProductID, SL, TotalWeight,DiamondWeight,SectionID, ProductCode, TaskPrice
			FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE_SELL
			WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID

			OPEN pCurP
			FETCH NEXT FROM pCurP INTO @sProductID, @SL, @sTotalWeight_Change,@sDiamondWeight,@sSectionIDBan, @sProductCode, @sTaskPrice

		WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
		BEGIN
			SELECT @sQtyP = tp.SL, @sProductTypeCode = ProductTypeCode FROM T_PRODUCT tp
			WHERE ProductID = @sProductID
			IF(@sProductTypeCode = 'TTM')
			BEGIN
				UPDATE T_PRODUCT
				SET	Status		= 'S',
					SellTrnID	= @p_TrnID,
					SellTrnType = 'CRT',
					SellOutDate = @SellDate
				WHERE ProductID = @sProductID
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			END
			ELSE IF(@sProductTypeCode = 'KLT')
				BEGIN
					UPDATE SECTION_PRODUCT
      				SET [SL] = [SL] - isnull(@SL,1)
      				WHERE SectionID = @sSectionIDBan AND ProductCode = @sProductCode
					IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
				END
			ELSE IF(@sProductTypeCode = 'STN')
				BEGIN
					UPDATE T_PRODUCT
					SET	Status		= 'S',
						SellTrnID	= @p_TrnID,
						SellTrnType = 'CRT',
						SellOutDate = @SellDate
					WHERE ProductID = @sProductID
					IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
				END
			ELSE IF(@sProductTypeCode = 'CTL')
				BEGIN
					UPDATE SECTION_PRODUCT
      				SET [SL] = [SL] - isnull(@SL,1),
      				[TotalWeight] = [TotalWeight] - @sTotalWeight_Change,
      				[DiamondWeight] = [DiamondWeight] - @sDiamondWeight
      				WHERE SectionID = @sSectionIDBan AND ProductCode = @sProductCode
					IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
				END
			IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM T_PRODUCT WHERE ProductCode = @sProductCode AND TaskPrice <> @sTaskPrice)
			BEGIN
			INSERT INTO ChangeTaskPrice_Log ([TrnID]
			,[ChangeType]
			,[ChangeDate]
			,[UserID]
			,[Productcode]
			,[OldTaskPrice]
			,[NewTaskPrice])
			select
			@p_TrnID
			,'CRT'
			,@SellDate
			,@p_UserID
			,[ProductCode]
			,[TaskPrice]
			,@sTaskPrice
			from T_PRODUCT WHERE ProductCode = @sProductCode
		--GOTO ABORT
			END
			FETCH NEXT FROM pCurP INTO @sProductID, @SL, @sTotalWeight_Change,@sDiamondWeight, @sSectionIDBan, @sProductCode, @sTaskPrice
		END
		CLOSE pCurP
		DEALLOCATE pCurP

	---- Insert Daily log ------------
	DECLARE @sSectionID varchar(15)
	DECLARE @sGoldCcy varchar(20), @sPriceUnit varchar(3)
	DECLARE @sQty INT
	DECLARE @sTotalWeight numeric(19,8), @sGoldWeight numeric(19,8), @sStampWeight numeric(19,8)
	DECLARE @sTrnDesc nvarchar(500), @sCRDR varchar(1)

	--SET @sTrnDate = convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 103)
	--SET @sTrnTime = convert(varchar(10), getdate(), 108)
	SET @sTrnDesc = N'XUẤT BÁN HÀNG NGAY ' + @sTrnDate
	SET @sCRDR = '-'

	DECLARE pCur CURSOR FOR
		SELECT SectionID, GoldCode, SUM(ISNULL(SL,1)) Qty,SUM(ISNULL(TotalWeight,0)) TotalWeight,
			SUM(ISNULL(TotalWeight - DiamondWeight, 0)) GoldWeight, SUM(ISNULL(StampWeight,0)) StampWeight
		FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE_SELL
		WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
		GROUP BY SectionID, GoldCode

	OPEN pCur
	FETCH NEXT FROM pCur INTO @sSectionID, @sGoldCcy, @sQty, @sTotalWeight, @sGoldWeight, @sStampWeight

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN
		SELECT @sPriceUnit = PriceUnit FROM I_GOLD WHERE GoldCode = @sGoldCcy

		-- HACH TOAN GIAM TONG TL
		IF @sPriceUnit IN ('L','G','M')
		BEGIN
			EXEC TRN_DAILY_LOG_Ins
				@p_RelatedID = @sSectionID,		@p_TrnRefID 	= @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnCode	 = 'CRT',			@p_TrnType 	= 'RT',
				@p_TrnDate 	 = @sTrnDate,		@p_TrnTime 	= @sTrnTime,
				@p_GoldCcy	 = @sGoldCcy,		@p_CRDR 		= @sCRDR,
				@p_Amount 	 = @sTotalWeight,	@p_TrnDesc 	= @sTrnDesc,
				@p_AmountTag = 'PROD_WEI',		@p_Status 	= 'C',
				@p_UserID 	 = @p_UserID,		@p_IsDel		= 'N'
			IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

			EXEC TRN_DAILY_LOG_Ins
				@p_RelatedID = @sSectionID,		@p_TrnRefID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnCode 	 = 'CRT',			@p_TrnType 	= 'RT',
				@p_TrnDate 	 = @sTrnDate,		@p_TrnTime 	= @sTrnTime,
				@p_GoldCcy	 = @sGoldCcy,		@p_CRDR 	= @sCRDR,
				@p_Amount 	 = @sGoldWeight,	@p_TrnDesc 	= @sTrnDesc,
				@p_AmountTag = 'PROD_GOLDWEI',	@p_Status 	= 'C',
				@p_UserID 	 = @p_UserID,		@p_IsDel 	= 'N'
			IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

			EXEC TRN_DAILY_LOG_Ins
				@p_RelatedID = @sSectionID,		@p_TrnRefID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnCode 	 = 'CRT',			@p_TrnType 	= 'RT',
				@p_TrnDate 	 = @sTrnDate,		@p_TrnTime 	= @sTrnTime,
				@p_GoldCcy	 = @sGoldCcy,		@p_CRDR 	= @sCRDR,
				@p_Amount 	 = @sQty,			@p_TrnDesc 	= @sTrnDesc,
				@p_AmountTag = 'PROD_QTY',		@p_Status 	= 'C',
				@p_UserID 	 = @p_UserID,		@p_IsDel 	= 'N'
			IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

			EXEC TRN_DAILY_LOG_Ins
				@p_RelatedID = @sSectionID,		@p_TrnRefID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnCode 	 = 'CRT',			@p_TrnType 	= 'RT',
				@p_TrnDate 	 = @sTrnDate,		@p_TrnTime 	= @sTrnTime,
				@p_GoldCcy	 = @sGoldCcy,		@p_CRDR 	= @sCRDR,
				@p_Amount 	 = @sStampWeight,	@p_TrnDesc 	= @sTrnDesc,
				@p_AmountTag = 'PROD_STAMPWEI',	@p_Status 	= 'C',
				@p_UserID 	 = @p_UserID,		@p_IsDel 	= 'N'
			IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
		END

		FETCH NEXT FROM pCur INTO @sSectionID, @sGoldCcy, @sQty, @sTotalWeight, @sGoldWeight, @sStampWeight
	END
	CLOSE pCur
	DEALLOCATE pCur

	--------------insert T_PRODUCT_TRACKING hàng bán ----------------------------------
	INSERT INTO T_PRODUCT_TRACKING (ProductID, ProductCode, TrnCode, CRDR, TrnID, TrnRefCode, RefCRDR, TrnRefID, MaHangGoc)
	select t.ProductID, t.ProductCode, 'CRT', '-', @p_TrnID, t.TrnCode, t.CRDR,t.TrnID , t.MaHangGoc
	from T_PRODUCT_TRACKING t
	inner join T_PRODUCT p on t.ProductCode = p.ProductCode
	where p.ProductTypeCode not in ('KLT','CTL')
	and t.ProductCode in (select ProductCode from TRN_RT_CHANGE_SELL where TrnID = @p_TrnID)
	and t.STT = (select MAX(STT) from T_PRODUCT_TRACKING t1 where t.ProductCode = t1.ProductCode)
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

--------- Insert TILL TXN ---------
EXEC TRN_TILL_TXN_Ins
	@p_TrnID	= @p_TrnID,
	@p_TrnType	= 'RT',
	@p_TrnCode	= 'CRT',
	@p_ErrCode	= @sErrCode OUT
IF @sErrCode <> '0' GOTO ABORT

--------- Sau khi insert vào giao dịch Till, lấy lại TillTxnID ---------
SELECT @sTillTxnID = TillTxnID
FROM T_TILL_TXN
WHERE TrnRefID = @p_TrnID
IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT


UPDATE a 
SET a.Status= 'C'
FROM TRN_DATCOC a INNER JOIN TRN_RT_CHANGE_DATCOC b ON a.TrnID = b.DatCocID 
WHERE b.TrnID = @p_TrnID

COMMIT TRANSACTION

IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME='RetailLog')
BEGIN
/* BEGIN: Ghi lại log thực thi */
if exists (select top 1 1 from TRN_RT_CHANGE where TrnID = @p_TrnID)
begin
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
	select getdate() DateLog, 'TRN_RT_CHANGE_Complete' StoreName, @p_TrnID TrnID, @sBillCode BillCode, 'Complete_success_TinhTrang' + [Status]  LogMsg,
	ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
	from TRN_RT_CHANGE where TrnID = @p_TrnID
end
ELSE
BEGIN
	INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
	SELECT GETDATE() DateLog, 'TRN_RT_CHANGE_Complete' StoreName, @p_TrnID TrnID, @sBillCode BillCode, 'Complete_success_LostData' LogMsg,
	ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
END
/* END: Ghi lại log thực thi */
END

	SELECT 0 AS ErrCode, @p_TrnID TrnID, @sTillTxnID TillTxnID, @sBillCode BillCode, '' ErrorDesc, 
	0 DiemTichLuy,0 DiemDoiQua, 0 TongDiemTL, 0 NangHang
	RETURN 0
ABORT:
BEGIN
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
	IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','pCurP')) >= -1
	 BEGIN
	 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','pCurP')) > -1
		BEGIN
			CLOSE pCurP
		END
	 DEALLOCATE pCurP
	 END
	 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','pCur')) >= -1
		 BEGIN
		 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','pCur')) > -1
			BEGIN
				CLOSE pCur
			END
		 DEALLOCATE pCur
	 END
	 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','CUR')) >= -1
		 BEGIN
		 IF (SELECT CURSOR_STATUS('global','CUR')) > -1
			BEGIN
				CLOSE CUR
			END
		 DEALLOCATE CUR
	 END
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME='RetailLog')
	BEGIN
	/* BEGIN: Ghi lại log thực thi */
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
		SELECT GETDATE() DateLog, 'TRN_RT_CHANGE_Complete' StoreName, @p_TrnID TrnID, @sBillCode BillCode, 'ABORT_TinhTrang' + [Status] + ' - ' + @sErr LogMsg,
		ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
		FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
		SELECT GETDATE() DateLog, 'TRN_RT_CHANGE_Complete' StoreName, @p_TrnID TrnID, @sBillCode BillCode, 'ABORT - LostData - ' + @sErr LogMsg,
		ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
	END
	/* END: Ghi lại log thực thi */
	END
	
	SELECT -1 AS ErrCode, @p_ErrorCode1 ErrorCode1, '' TrnID, '' TillTxnID, @sErr ErrorDesc, @sBillCode BillCode, 
	0 AS DiemTichLuy,0 AS DiemDoiQua, 0 AS TongDiemTL, '' NangHang
	RETURN -1
END
END TRY
BEGIN CATCH
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME='RetailLog')
	BEGIN
	/* BEGIN: Ghi lại log thực thi */
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID)
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
		SELECT GETDATE() DateLog, 'TRN_RT_CHANGE_Complete' StoreName, @p_TrnID TrnID, @sBillCode BillCode, 'TryCatch_TinhTrang' + [Status] LogMsg,
		ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
		FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		INSERT INTO [dbo].[RetailLog] ([DateLog],[StoreName],[TrnID],[BillCode],[LogMsg],[ErrorNumber],[ErrorState],[ErrorProcedure],[ErrorLine],[ErrorMessage])
		SELECT GETDATE() DateLog, 'TRN_RT_CHANGE_Complete' StoreName, @p_TrnID TrnID, @sBillCode BillCode, 'TryCatch Error_LostData' LogMsg,
		ERROR_NUMBER() ErrorNumber, ERROR_STATE() ErrorState, ERROR_PROCEDURE() ErrorProcedure, ERROR_LINE() ErrorLine, ERROR_MESSAGE() AS ErrorMessage
	END
	/* END: Ghi lại log thực thi */
	END
 IF @@TRANCOUNT > 0 ROLLBACK  
END CATCH

name: T_TILL_TXN_Del
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[T_TILL_TXN_Del]
	@p_TrnRefID varchar(15),
	@pType AS nvarchar(200)=NULL,
	@pCongNoBanLe bit,
	@p_UserUpd varchar(15),
	@p_TrnDateTime_Upd DATETIME = null,
	@p_TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN DATETIME = null,
	@p_Type Varchar(1)
AS

IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES WHERE TABLE_NAME='ErrorLog')
BEGIN
/* BEGIN: Ghi lại log thực thi */
select HOST_NAME() as computer_name, SYSTEM_USER as user_login,
connect_time, net_transport, protocol_type, last_read, last_write,
client_net_address, client_tcp_port, local_net_address, local_tcp_port,
OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID) as proc_name
into #LogTracking from sys.dm_exec_connections WHERE Session_id = @@SPID;

declare @Log_XML xml
set @Log_XML = (select * from #LogTracking for xml path)

insert into ErrorLog (ErrorMsg, ErrorNumber, ErrorProc, ErrorLine)
values (cast(@Log_XML as varchar(max)),0,isnull(OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)+'_'+@p_TrnRefID,''),0)

drop table #LogTracking
/* END: Ghi lại log thực thi */
END

BEGIN TRANSACTION
	DECLARE @ProductID VARCHAR(50)
	DECLARE @p_Message nvarchar(4000)
	SET @p_Message = ''
	DECLARE @MaTienTeHeThong Varchar(10)    
    SELECT @MaTienTeHeThong = ParaValue From SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'MaTienTeHeThong'
	DECLARE @G_CustID VARCHAR(15)
--=========================================================================================================================================================
	--Kiểm tra dữ liệu:
	IF( @pType='PP') --Giao dịch mượn hàng
	BEGIN
		
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM trn_lEND_product_dt WHERE [status]='M' and  productid in(SELECT productid FROM trn_pay_product_dt WHERE trnID=@p_TrnRefID ))
		BEGIN
			SET @p_Message = (SELECT ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR WHERE ErrorCode = 'PAY-004')
			GOTO ABORT
		END
		IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	END
	IF( @pType='RP') --Giao dịch sửa hàng
	BEGIN		
		IF EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM TRN_REPAIR_PRODUCT WHERE [RStatus]='W' and trnID=@p_TrnRefID)
		BEGIN
			SET @p_Message = N'Đây là thanh toán tiền trả trước sửa hàng, không thể hủy!'
			GOTO ABORT
		END
		IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	END

	DECLARE @OldDebt numeric(18,3)
	DECLARE @NewDebt numeric(18,3)	
	IF( @pType='SRT') --Giao dịch mua/ bán vàng
	BEGIN			
		IF(@pCongNoBanLe = 1)
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @OldDebt = OldDebitAmount, @NewDebt = DebitAmount FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnRefID
			IF(@OldDebt <> @NewDebt)
			BEGIN
				SET @p_Message = N'Giao dịch mua/bán vàng không thể hủy khi có công nợ'
				GOTO ABORT
			END			
		END
		-- kiểm tra version
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnRefID AND TrnDateTime_Upd <> @p_TrnDateTime_Upd)
		BEGIN
			select @p_Message = N'Dữ liệu của bạn đã được chỉnh sửa bởi ' + su.UserName + N' vào lúc ' 
			+ convert(varchar,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,8) + N' ngày ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,103)
			from SYS_USERS su inner join TRN_RT_BUYSELL crt on su.UserID = crt.UserID_Upd
			where crt.TrnID = @p_TrnRefID
			goto ABORT
		END

		--kiểm tra tính hợp lệ vòng đời sản phẩm
		if exists (select top 1 1 from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_BUYGOLD where TrnID = @p_TrnRefID and ProductCode is not null)
		Begin
			SET @p_Message = N'Giao dịch mua/bán vàng đã mua lại sản phẩm cũ, không được hủy thanh toán'
			GOTO ABORT
		end

		SELECT TrnCode,CRDR,TrnID, ProductCode, ProductID
		into #Tracking
		FROM T_PRODUCT_TRACKING t
		WHERE STT = (select MAX(STT) from T_PRODUCT_TRACKING t1 where t.ProductCode = t1.ProductCode)
		and ProductCode in (select ProductCode from TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL where TrnID = @p_TrnRefID)

		if exists (select top 1 1 from #Tracking where TrnCode <> 'SRT' or CRDR <> '-' or TrnID <> @p_TrnRefID)
		begin
			SET @p_Message = N'Không thể hủy vì tồn tại mã hàng đã được sử dụng ở giao dịch khác'
			GOTO ABORT
		end

	END
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	IF( @pType='CRT') --Giao dịch đổi vàng
	BEGIN	
		IF(@pCongNoBanLe = 1)
		BEGIN
			SELECT TOP 1 @NewDebt = NoMoi, @OldDebt = NoCu FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnRefID
			IF(@OldDebt <> @NewDebt)
			BEGIN
				SET @p_Message = N'Giao dịch đổi bù vàng không thể hủy khi có công nợ'
				GOTO ABORT
			END			
		END
		-- kiểm tra version
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnRefID AND TrnDateTime_Upd <> @p_TrnDateTime_Upd)
		BEGIN
			select @p_Message = N'Dữ liệu của bạn đã được chỉnh sửa bởi ' + su.UserName + N' vào lúc ' 
			+ convert(varchar,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,8) + N' ngày ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,103)
			from SYS_USERS su inner join TRN_RT_CHANGE crt on su.UserID = crt.UserID_Upd
			where crt.TrnID = @p_TrnRefID
			goto ABORT
		END
	END
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	IF UPPER(@pType) = 'FX' --Giao dịch ngoại tệ
	BEGIN	
		SELECT TOP 1 @NewDebt = Rest, @OldDebt = OldDebt FROM TRN_FX WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnRefID

		DECLARE @GhiNoTrongNgoaiTe int
		SET @GhiNoTrongNgoaiTe = (SELECT ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'GhiNoTrongNgoaiTe')
		IF(@GhiNoTrongNgoaiTe = 1)
		BEGIN			
			IF(@OldDebt <> @NewDebt)
			BEGIN
				SET @p_Message = N'Giao dịch ngoại tệ không thể hủy khi có công nợ'
				GOTO ABORT
			END			
		END

		-- kiểm tra version
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_FX WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnRefID AND TrnDateTime_Upd <> @p_TrnDateTime_Upd)
		BEGIN
			select @p_Message = N'Dữ liệu của bạn đã được chỉnh sửa bởi ' + su.UserName + N' vào lúc ' 
			+ convert(varchar,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,8) + N' ngày ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,103)
			from SYS_USERS su inner join TRN_FX crt on su.UserID = crt.UserID_Upd
			where crt.TrnID = @p_TrnRefID
			goto ABORT
		END
	END
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	IF UPPER(@pType) = 'BRT' --Giao dịch mua dẻ
	BEGIN	
		SELECT TOP 1 @NewDebt = Debt_Bal_New, @OldDebt = Debt_Bal FROM TRN_RT_BUYGOLD WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnRefID

		DECLARE @GhiNoTrongMuaDe int
		SET @GhiNoTrongMuaDe = (SELECT ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'GhiNoTrongMuaDe')
		IF(@GhiNoTrongMuaDe = 1)
		BEGIN			
			IF(@OldDebt <> @NewDebt)
			BEGIN
				SET @p_Message = N'Giao dịch mua dẻ không thể hủy khi có công nợ'
				GOTO ABORT
			END
		END	
		
		-- kiểm tra version
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_RT_BUYGOLD WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnRefID AND TrnDateTime_Upd <> @p_TrnDateTime_Upd)
		BEGIN
			select @p_Message = N'Dữ liệu của bạn đã được chỉnh sửa bởi ' + su.UserName + N' vào lúc ' 
			+ convert(varchar,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,8) + N' ngày ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,103)
			from SYS_USERS su inner join TRN_RT_BUYGOLD crt on su.UserID = crt.UserID_Upd
			where crt.TrnID = @p_TrnRefID
			goto ABORT
		END
	END
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	IF UPPER(@pType) = 'IO' --Giao dịch mua dẻ
	BEGIN	
		--kiểm tra tính hợp lệ vòng đời sản phẩm
		if exists (select top 1 1 from TRN_TILL_INOUT where TrnID = @p_TrnRefID and ProductCode is not null)
		Begin
			SET @p_Message = N'Không được hủy giao dịch xuất hàng vòng đời sản phẩm'
			GOTO ABORT
		end
	END
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	IF UPPER(@pType) = 'TDC' --Giao dịch đặt cọc
	BEGIN	
		--kiểm tra giao dịch hoàn tất
		if exists (select top 1 1 from TRN_DATCOC where TrnID = @p_TrnRefID and Status='C')
		Begin
			SET @p_Message = N'Giao dịch đặt cọc đã hoàn tất không thể hủy'
			GOTO ABORT
		end
	END
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	IF( @pType='THL') --Giao dịch mua/ bán vàng
	BEGIN			
		-- kiểm tra version
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_TRAHANGLOI WHERE TraHangID = @p_TrnRefID AND TrnDateTime_Upd <> @p_TrnDateTime_Upd)
		BEGIN
			select @p_Message = N'Dữ liệu của bạn đã được chỉnh sửa bởi ' + su.UserName + N' vào lúc ' 
			+ convert(varchar,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,8) + N' ngày ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,103)
			from SYS_USERS su inner join TRN_TRAHANGLOI crt on su.UserID = crt.UserID_Upd
			where crt.TraHangID = @p_TrnRefID
			goto ABORT
		END
	END
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

	--kiểm tra version giao dịch nhanh
	DECLARE @GDN_ID VARCHAR(15)
	DECLARE @TotalBSAmount NUMERIC(18,3)
	set @TotalBSAmount = 0	
	declare @Datetime_Upd_GDN table(TrnDateTime_Upd datetime)
	declare @Datetime_Upd table(TrnDateTime_Upd datetime)

	if exists (select top 1 1 from TRN_GIAODICHNHANH_DT where TTrnID = @p_TrnRefID) 
	begin
		SELECT @GDN_ID = TrnID FROM TRN_GIAODICHNHANH_DT where TTrnID = @p_TrnRefID
		--check version giao dịch nhanh, nếu đúng => cập nhật version mới, nếu không đúng => không cho thao tác tiếp
		IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_GIAODICHNHANH WHERE TrnID = @GDN_ID AND TrnDateTime_Upd <> @p_TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN)
		BEGIN
			select @p_Message = N'Dữ liệu giao dịch nhanh của hóa đơn đã được chỉnh sửa bởi ' + su.UserName + N' vào lúc ' 
			+ convert(varchar,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,8) + N' ngày ' + CONVERT(VARCHAR,crt.TrnDateTime_Upd,103)
			from SYS_USERS su inner join TRN_GIAODICHNHANH crt on su.UserID = crt.UserID_Upd
			where crt.TrnID = @GDN_ID
			goto ABORT
		END
		ELSE
		begin
				DELETE FROM TRN_GIAODICHNHANH_DT where TTrnID = @p_TrnRefID
				--Sau khi xóa giao dịch mua bán ngoại tệ, xét giao dịch nhanh còn chứa giao dịch khác không, nếu không thì xóa luôn giao dịch nhanh
				IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM TRN_GIAODICHNHANH_DT WHERE TrnID = @GDN_ID)
				BEGIN
					DELETE FROM TRN_GIAODICHNHANH WHERE TrnID = @GDN_ID

					set @p_TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN = getdate()
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
						SELECT @TotalBSAmount = SUM(CASE WHEN BuyOrSell = 'B' THEN -ABS(ISNULL(BSAmount,0)) ELSE ABS(ISNULL(BSAmount,0)) END)
						FROM TRN_GIAODICHNHANH_DT WHERE TrnID = @GDN_ID
				
						update TRN_GIAODICHNHANH
						set TrnDateTime_Upd = getdate(), UserID_Upd = @p_UserUpd, [TotalBSAmount] = @TotalBSAmount
						output inserted.TrnDateTime_Upd
						into @Datetime_Upd_GDN
						where TrnID = @GDN_ID

						--lấy thông tin version mới nhất của giao dịch nhanh
						select @p_TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN = MAX(TrnDateTime_Upd) from @Datetime_Upd
				END
		end
	end

-- CẬP NHẬT I_GOLD_BAL
	DECLARE @RelatedID varchar(15)
	DECLARE @GoldCcy varchar(15)
	DECLARE @Amount numeric(19,8)
	DECLARE @AmountTag varchar(100)
	DECLARE @TrnType varchar(30)
	DECLARE @CrDr varchar(1)

	DECLARE CURR CURSOR FOR
	SELECT RelatedID, Amount, AmountTag, TrnType, GoldCcy, CRDR
	FROM TRN_DAILY_LOG 
	WHERE TrnRefID = @p_TrnRefID

	OPEN CURR
	FETCH NEXT FROM CURR
	INTO @RelatedID, @Amount, @AmountTag, @TrnType, @GoldCcy, @CRDR

	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	BEGIN	
	IF(@TrnType = 'PRODOUT' OR @TrnType = 'RT' OR @TrnType = 'PO')
		Begin
			IF(@AmountTag = 'PROD_QTY')	
				Begin
				IF (@CRDR = '+')
					BEGIN
						UPDATE I_GOLD_BAL
						SET Qty_Bal = Qty_Bal - @Amount
						WHERE SectionID=@RelatedID AND GoldCode = @GoldCcy
						IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						UPDATE I_GOLD_BAL
						SET Qty_Bal = Qty_Bal + @Amount
						WHERE SectionID=@RelatedID AND GoldCode = @GoldCcy
						IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
					END
				End
			Else IF(@AmountTag = 'PROD_GOLDWEI')
					Begin
					IF (@CRDR = '+')
						BEGIN
							UPDATE I_GOLD_BAL
							SET GoldWei_Bal = GoldWei_Bal - @Amount
							WHERE SectionID=@RelatedID AND GoldCode = @GoldCcy
							IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
						END
						ELSE
						BEGIN
							UPDATE I_GOLD_BAL
							SET GoldWei_Bal = GoldWei_Bal + @Amount
							WHERE SectionID=@RelatedID AND GoldCode = @GoldCcy
							IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
						END
					End 
			Else IF(@AmountTag = 'PROD_WEI')
				Begin
					IF (@CRDR = '+')
					BEGIN
						UPDATE I_GOLD_BAL
						SET TotalWei_Bal = TotalWei_Bal - @Amount
						WHERE SectionID=@RelatedID AND GoldCode = @GoldCcy
						IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						UPDATE I_GOLD_BAL
						SET TotalWei_Bal = TotalWei_Bal + @Amount
						WHERE SectionID=@RelatedID AND GoldCode = @GoldCcy
						IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
					END
				End
			Else IF(@AmountTag = 'PROD_STAMPWEI')
				Begin
					IF (@CRDR = '+')
					BEGIN
						UPDATE I_GOLD_BAL
						SET Stamp_Wei = Stamp_Wei - @Amount
						WHERE SectionID=@RelatedID AND GoldCode = @GoldCcy
						IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
					END
					ELSE
					BEGIN
						UPDATE I_GOLD_BAL
						SET Stamp_Wei = Stamp_Wei + @Amount
						WHERE SectionID=@RelatedID AND GoldCode = @GoldCcy
						IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
					END
				End
		End
	FETCH NEXT FROM CURR
	INTO @RelatedID, @Amount, @AmountTag, @TrnType, @GoldCcy, @CRDR	
	END
	CLOSE CURR
	DEALLOCATE CURR

DECLARE @TillID varchar(15)

DECLARE @Amount_Dirty numeric(19,8)
DECLARE @Amount_Total numeric(19,8)
DECLARE @Assigned VARCHAR(1)
DECLARE cur Cursor FOR
(
		Select tttd.TillID, tttd.GoldCcy,CrDr, Amount, Amount_Diamond,ttt.Assigned,tttd.Amount_Dirty,tttd.Amount_Total
		FROM T_TILL_TXN_Detail tttd LEFT JOIN T_TILL_TXN ttt ON ttt.TillTxnID = tttd.TillTxnID 		 
		WHERE  tttd.TillTxnID = @TillTxnID
)
Open Cur
FETCH NEXT FROM Cur INTO @TillID, @GoldCcy,@CrDr,@Amount,@Amount_Diamond,@Assigned,@Amount_Dirty,@Amount_Total
WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
BEGIN
	IF EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM T_TILL_BAL WHERE TillID = @TillID AND GoldCcy = @GoldCcy)
			BEGIN
				IF (@CrDr = '+')
				BEGIN
					UPDATE T_TILL_BAL
					SET 	InFlow = InFlow - @Amount, 
					    	TillBal = TillBal - @Amount, 
					    	AssigBal_Gold =CASE WHEN @Assigned='1' THEN isnull(AssigBal_Gold,0)-@Amount ELSE AssigBal_Gold END, 
					    	AssigBal_Diamond = CASE WHEN @Assigned='1' THEN ISNULL(AssigBal_Diamond,0)-@Amount_Diamond ELSE AssigBal_Diamond END, 					
						    InFlow_Diamond = InFlow_Diamond - ISNULL(@Amount_Diamond,0),
					    	TillBal_Diamond = TillBal_Diamond - ISNULL(@Amount_Diamond,0),
					    	TillBal_Dirty = TillBal_Dirty - ISNULL(@Amount_Dirty,0),
					    	TillBal_Total = TillBal_Total - ISNULL(@Amount_Total,0)
					WHERE 	TillID = @TillID
						AND GoldCcy = @GoldCcy
					IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					UPDATE T_TILL_BAL
					SET 	OutFlow = OutFlow - @Amount,
					    	TillBal = TillBal + @Amount,
						InFlow_Diamond = InFlow_Diamond + ISNULL(@Amount_Diamond,0),
					    	TillBal_Diamond = TillBal_Diamond + ISNULL(@Amount_Diamond,0),
					    	TillBal_Dirty = TillBal_Dirty + ISNULL(@Amount_Dirty,0),
					    	TillBal_Total = TillBal_Total + ISNULL(@Amount_Total,0)
					WHERE 	TillID = @TillID
						AND GoldCcy = @GoldCcy
					IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
				END
			END
			ELSE	
			BEGIN
				IF (@CrDr = '+')
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO T_TILL_BAL(TillID, GoldCcy, OpenBal, InFlow, OutFlow, TillBal, OpenBal_Diamond, InFlow_Diamond, OutFlow_Diamond, TillBal_Diamond,TillBal_Dirty,TillBal_Total)
					VALUES(@TillID, @GoldCcy, 0, @Amount, 0, -@Amount, 0, @Amount_Diamond, 0, -@Amount_Diamond, -@Amount_Dirty, -@Amount_Total)
					IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
				END
				ELSE
				BEGIN
					INSERT INTO T_TILL_BAL(TillID, GoldCcy, OpenBal, InFlow, OutFlow, TillBal, OpenBal_Diamond, InFlow_Diamond, OutFlow_Diamond, TillBal_Diamond,TillBal_Dirty,TillBal_Total)
					VALUES(@TillID, @GoldCcy, 0, 0, @Amount, @Amount, 0, 0, @Amount_Diamond, @Amount_Diamond,@Amount_Dirty,@Amount_Total)
					IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
				END			
			END
	FETCH NEXT FROM Cur INTO @TillID, @GoldCcy,@CrDr,@Amount,@Amount_Diamond,@Assigned,@Amount_Dirty,@Amount_Total
END

DECLARE curC Cursor FOR

)

END
CLOSE CurC
DEALLOCATE CurC

--Xóa till

IF UPPER(@pType) = 'RP'

definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[T_TILL_TXN_Lst]
	@p_TillTxnID varchar(15) = NULL,
	@p_TillID varchar(15) = NULL,
	@p_TrnRefID varchar(15) = NULL ,
	@p_TrnFromDate varchar(10) = NULL,
	@p_TrnToDate varchar(10) = NULL,
	@p_FromTime varchar(20) = NULL ,
	@p_ToTime varchar (20) = NULL,
	@p_TrnType varchar(30) = NULL,
	@p_TrnCode varchar(30) = NULL,
	@p_CustID varchar(15)  = NULL ,
	@p_GoldCcy varchar(10) = NULL,
	@p_TrnAmount varchar(30) = NULL,
	@p_Status varchar(3) = NULL ,
	@p_TillUserID varchar(15) = NULL,
	@p_Sort VARCHAR(100) = NULL,
	@p_ProcUserID VARCHAR(150) = NULL,
	@p_ShopID varchar(15) = NULL,
	@p_BillCode nvarchar(MAX) = NULL,
	@p_Description nvarchar(max) = NULL,
	@p_RutGon varchar(1)
AS
BEGIN
	DECLARE @p_IsAdmin varchar(1)
	DECLARE @p_MainSectionID varchar(15)
	SELECT @p_IsAdmin = IsAdmin, @p_MainSectionID = MainSectionID FROM SYS_USERS WHERE UserID = @p_ProcUserID
	
	DECLARE @vIsUseTotalAddMoney int
	SELECT @vIsUseTotalAddMoney = ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'SuDungTongTienBot_NgoaiTe'	
	
	DECLARE @sHeso NUMERIC(19,8) 
	SET @sHeso=dbo.fun_GetHS()

	DECLARE @Emptyvarchar VARCHAR(100)
	SET @Emptyvarchar = ''
	
	DECLARE @sGio nvarchar(max)
	SELECT @sGio=ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'LocBaoCaoTheoGio'
    DECLARE @MaTienTeHeThong Varchar(10)    
    SELECT @MaTienTeHeThong = ParaValue From SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'MaTienTeHeThong'
	DECLARE @sDK nvarchar(4000)
	SET @sDK = ' WHERE 1=1 '

	CREATE TABLE #dtBillCode (BillCode NVARCHAR(50));
	if @p_BillCode is not null and @p_BillCode <> ''
	begin
		insert into #dtBillCode (BillCode)
		select Item BillCode
		from dbo.SplitString(@p_BillCode, ',')
		where Item <> ''
	end

	
	--IF (@p_BillCode is not null AND @p_BillCode <> '')
		--SET @sDK = @sDK + " AND D.BillCode like N'" + replace(@p_BillCode, substring(@p_BillCode, len(@p_BillCode) - 5, 3), '%') + "' "	
	IF EXISTS (SELECT TOP 1 1 FROM #dtBillCode)
	BEGIN
		 SET @sDK = @sDK + N' AND D.BillCode IN (SELECT BillCode FROM #dtBillCode)';
	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN
		IF (@p_TrnFromDate is not null AND @p_TrnFromDate <> '')
		BEGIN
			IF (@sGio = '0')
				SET @sDK = @sDK + " AND TrnDate >= convert(datetime,'"+@p_TrnFromDate+"', 103)"
			ELSE
				SET @sDK = @sDK + " AND CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),TrnDate,103) + ' ' + TrnTime,103) >= CONVERT(DATETIME,'"+@p_TrnFromDate+"' + ' ' + '"+@p_FromTime+"',103) "
		END
		IF (@p_TrnToDate is not null AND @p_TrnToDate <> '')
		BEGIN
			IF (@sGio = '0')
				SET @sDK = @sDK + " AND TrnDate <= convert(datetime,'"+@p_TrnToDate+"', 103)"
			ELSE
				SET @sDK = @sDK + " AND CONVERT(DATETIME,CONVERT(VARCHAR(10),TrnDate,103) + ' ' + TrnTime,103) <= CONVERT(DATETIME,'"+@p_TrnToDate+"'+ ' ' + '"+@p_ToTime+"',103) "
		END
		IF (@p_TrnType is not null AND @p_TrnType <> '')
			SET @sDK = @sDK + " AND D.TrnType = N'" + @p_TrnType + "' "
		IF (@p_CustID is not null AND @p_CustID <> '')
			SET @sDK = @sDK + " AND D.CustID = N'" + @p_CustID + "' "
		IF (@p_Status is not null AND @p_Status <> '')
			SET @sDK = @sDK + " AND D.[Status] = N'" + @p_Status + "' "
		IF (@p_ShopID is not null AND @p_ShopID <> '')
			SET @sDK = @sDK + " AND D.ShopID = N'" + @p_ShopID + "' "
		IF (@p_ProcUserID is not null AND @p_ProcUserID <> '')
			SET @sDK = @sDK + " AND D.CreatedBy = N'" + @p_ProcUserID + "' "
		IF (@p_Description is not null AND @p_Description <> '')
			SET @sDK = @sDK + " AND D.Description LIKE N'%" + @p_Description + "%' "
	END

	IF (@p_Sort is not null AND @p_Sort <> '')
		SET @sDK = @sDK + " ORDER BY " + @p_Sort + " "
	
	DECLARE @BillCode varchar(10)
	SELECT @BillCode = ParaValue FROM SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'SuDungBillCodeTrongCacGiaoDich'
	DECLARE @fdate datetime,@tdate datetime,@gdate datetime
	set @fdate = convert(datetime,@p_TrnFromDate,103)
	set @tdate = convert(datetime,@p_TrnToDate,103)
	set @gdate = convert(datetime,convert(varchar(10),getdate(),103),103)

Select a.* 
into #TRN_RT_BUYSELL
from TRN_RT_BUYSELL a
inner join T_Till_TXN TXN on a.TrnID = TXN.TrnRefID
where a.Status='C' and (TXN.TrnDate between  @fdate and @tdate AND (ShopID = @p_ShopID OR @p_ShopID='') OR a.BillCode IN (SELECT BillCode FROM #dtBillCode))
and (@p_RutGon = '0' or (@p_RutGon = '1' and (MAHDDienTu <> ''  or (@tdate = @gdate and TXN.TrnDate = @tdate))))

Select a.* 
into #TRN_RT_CHANGE
from TRN_RT_CHANGE a
inner join T_Till_TXN TXN on a.TrnID = TXN.TrnRefID
where a.Status='C' and (TXN.TrnDate between  @fdate and @tdate AND (ShopID = @p_ShopID OR @p_ShopID='') OR a.BillCode IN (SELECT BillCode FROM #dtBillCode))
and (@p_RutGon = '0' or (@p_RutGon = '1' and (MAHDDienTu <> ''  or (@tdate = @gdate and TXN.TrnDate = @tdate))))

Select a.* 
into #TRN_PO_MASTER
from TRN_PO_MASTER a
inner join T_Till_TXN TXN on a.POID = TXN.TrnRefID
where a.Status='C' and TXN.TrnDate between  @fdate and @tdate
AND (ShopID = @p_ShopID OR @p_ShopID='')
and (@p_RutGon = '0' or (@p_RutGon = '1' and (MAHDDienTu <> ''  or (@tdate = @gdate and TXN.TrnDate = @tdate))))
 
	--#########################################################################################################################################################
	SELECT  CFD.TrnID,
			SUM(CFD.AddMoney) AS TotalAddMoneyComplete
	INTO #tmpFXComplete
	FROM TRN_FX_DT CFD
		 LEFT JOIN TRN_FX CFX ON CFX.TrnID = CFD.TrnID
	WHERE CFX.[Status] = 'C'
	GROUP BY CFD.TrnID

	SELECT tmpComplete.TrnID, tmpComplete.DisCount, tmpComplete.ShopID, tmpComplete.CreatedBy, tmpComplete.EmpName, tmpComplete.InOut, 
	tmpComplete.[Description],tmpComplete.TrnDateTime_Upd,tmpComplete.TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,tmpComplete.TrnGDN, PayCash, PayCard, BillCode
	INTO #tmpTrnComplete
	FROM
	(
			SELECT RTC.TrnID, DisCount, RTC.ShopID,	CreatedBy, EMP.EmpName, '' InOut, '' AS [Description] ,
			Convert(varchar,Isnull(RTC.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd,
			'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,
			'' TrnGDN, RTC.CashPay PayCash, RTC.CardPay PayCard,
			CASE WHEN RTC.SoHDTuNhap IS NULL OR RTC.SoHDTuNhap = '' THEN '' ELSE RTC.SoHDTuNhap END BillCode
			FROM #TRN_RT_CHANGE	 RTC  
			LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE EMP ON EMP.EmpID = RTC.EmpID  AND [Status] = 'C'
			LEFT JOIN TRN_GIAODICHNHANH_DT DT ON DT.TTrnID = RTC.TrnID
			LEFT JOIN TRN_GIAODICHNHANH GDN ON DT.TrnID = GDN.TrnID
			Inner join T_TILL_TXN txn on RTC.TrnID = txn.TrnRefID
			Where (@sGio = '0' and txn.TrnDate between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate,103))
				OR (@sGio = '1' and convert(datetime,txn.TrnDate + txn.TrnTime,103) between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate + ' ' + @p_FromTime ,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate + ' ' + @p_ToTime,103))
				OR RTC.BillCode IN (SELECT BillCode FROM #dtBillCode)
		UNION				   				         									     
			SELECT RTBS.TrnID, DisCount,RTBS.ShopID,	CreatedBy, EMP.EmpName,'' InOut, RTBS.[Description] AS [Description] ,
			Convert(varchar,Isnull(RTBS.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd,
			Convert(varchar,Isnull(GDN.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,
			GDN.TrnID TrnGDN, RTBS.CashPay PayCash, RTBS.CardPay PayCard, 
			CASE WHEN RTBS.SoHDTuNhap IS NULL OR RTBS.SoHDTuNhap = '' THEN '' ELSE RTBS.SoHDTuNhap END BillCode
			FROM #TRN_RT_BUYSELL RTBS 
			LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE EMP ON EMP.EmpID = RTBS.EmpID AND [Status] = 'C'
			LEFT JOIN TRN_GIAODICHNHANH_DT DT ON DT.TTrnID = RTBS.TrnID
			LEFT JOIN TRN_GIAODICHNHANH GDN ON DT.TrnID = GDN.TrnID
			Inner join T_TILL_TXN txn on RTBS.TrnID = txn.TrnRefID
			WHERE (@sGio = '0' and txn.TrnDate between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate,103))
			OR (@sGio = '1' and convert(datetime,txn.TrnDate + txn.TrnTime,103) between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate + ' ' + @p_FromTime ,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate + ' ' + @p_ToTime,103))
			OR RTBS.BillCode IN (SELECT BillCode FROM #dtBillCode)
		UNION				   				         									     
			SELECT	CFX.TrnID, 
				CASE WHEN @vIsUseTotalAddMoney = 1 THEN CFX.AddMoney ELSE #tmpFXComplete.TotalAddMoneyComplete END AS DisCount, 
				CFX.ShopID, CreatedBy, EMP.EmpName, '' InOut, ''  AS [Description] ,
				Convert(varchar,Isnull(CFX.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd,
				Convert(varchar,Isnull(GDN.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,
				GDN.TrnID TrnGDN, CFX.PayCash, CFX.PayCard, '' BillCode
			FROM TRN_FX	 CFX  
			 LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE EMP ON EMP.EmpID = CFX.EmpID  AND [Status] = 'C'
			 LEFT JOIN TRN_GIAODICHNHANH_DT DT ON DT.TTrnID = CFX.TrnID
			 LEFT JOIN TRN_GIAODICHNHANH GDN ON DT.TrnID = GDN.TrnID
			 LEFT JOIN #tmpFXComplete ON #tmpFXComplete.TrnID = CFX.TrnID
			INNER join T_TILL_TXN txn on CFX.TrnID = txn.TrnRefID
			WHERE (@sGio = '0' and txn.TrnDate between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate,103))
			OR (@sGio = '1' and convert(datetime,txn.TrnDate + txn.TrnTime,103) between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate + ' ' + @p_FromTime ,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate + ' ' + @p_ToTime,103))
		UNION				   	   		         									     
			SELECT RTB.TrnID, 0	AS DisCount, RTB.ShopID, CreatedBy, EMP.EmpName, '' InOut, '' AS [Description],
			Convert(varchar,Isnull(RTB.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd,
			Convert(varchar,Isnull(GDN.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,
			GDN.TrnID TrnGDN, RTB.CashPay  PayCash, RTB.CardPay PayCard, 
			CASE WHEN RTB.SoHDTuNhap IS NULL OR RTB.SoHDTuNhap = '' THEN '' ELSE RTB.SoHDTuNhap END BillCode 
			FROM TRN_RT_BUYGOLD	   RTB  
			LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE EMP ON EMP.EmpID = RTB.EmpID  AND [Status] = 'C'
			LEFT JOIN TRN_GIAODICHNHANH_DT DT ON DT.TTrnID = RTB.TrnID
			LEFT JOIN TRN_GIAODICHNHANH GDN ON DT.TrnID = GDN.TrnID
			Inner join T_TILL_TXN txn on RTB.TrnID = txn.TrnRefID
			where (@sGio = '0' and txn.TrnDate between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate,103))
			OR (@sGio = '1' and convert(datetime,txn.TrnDate + txn.TrnTime,103) between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate + ' ' + @p_FromTime ,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate + ' ' + @p_ToTime,103))
			OR RTB.BillCode IN (SELECT BillCode FROM #dtBillCode)
		UNION				   	   		         									     													    
			SELECT TrnID, 0 AS DisCount,TIO.ShopID, CreatedBy, isnull(te.EmpName,'') AS EmpName, InOut, ''  AS [Description] ,
			'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd,	'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,	'' TrnGDN, 0 as  PayCash, 0 as PayCard, '' BillCode
			FROM TRN_TILL_INOUT	   TIO 
			left join T_TILL_TXN txn on TIO.TrnID = txn.TrnRefID
			LEFT JOIN SYS_USERS U ON txn.ProcUserID = U.UserID
			LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE te ON te.EmpID = U.EmpID
			WHERE TIO.[Status] = 'C'
			and (@sGio = '0' and txn.TrnDate between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate,103))
			OR (@sGio = '1' and convert(datetime,txn.TrnDate + txn.TrnTime,103) between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate + ' ' + @p_FromTime ,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate + ' ' + @p_ToTime,103))
		UNION				   	   		         									   														    
			SELECT TrnID, 0	 AS DisCount, '' AS ShopID, CreateBy AS CreatedBy,   EMP.EmpName, '' InOut, '' AS [Description] ,
			'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,	'' TrnGDN, 0 as  PayCash, 0 as PayCard, '' BillCode
			FROM I_CUSTOMER_DEBT_DT   CPD  
			LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE EMP ON EMP.EmpID = CPD.EmpID  AND [Status] = 'C'
			Inner join T_TILL_TXN txn on CPD.TrnID = txn.TrnRefID
			where (@sGio = '0' and txn.TrnDate between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate,103))
			OR (@sGio = '1' and convert(datetime,txn.TrnDate + txn.TrnTime,103) between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate + ' ' + @p_FromTime ,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate + ' ' + @p_ToTime,103))
		UNION  				  	   		         									   														    
			SELECT TrnID, 0	 AS DisCount, WTR.ShopID, CreatedBy, '' AS EmpName, '' InOut, '' AS [Description] ,
			'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd, '01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,	'' TrnGDN, 0 as  PayCash, 0 as PayCard, '' BillCode
			FROM TRN_WORKER	 WTR  
			Inner join T_TILL_TXN txn on WTR.TrnID = txn.TrnRefID
			WHERE WTR.[Status] = 'C'
			and (@sGio = '0' and txn.TrnDate between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate,103))
			OR (@sGio = '1' and convert(datetime,txn.TrnDate + txn.TrnTime,103) between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate + ' ' + @p_FromTime ,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate + ' ' + @p_ToTime,103))
		UNION	   
			SELECT WorkerPayID AS TrnID, 0	AS DisCount, '' AS ShopID, UserID AS CreatedBy, '' AS EmpName, '' InOut, ''	AS [Description],
			'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd,	'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,	'' TrnGDN , 0 as  PayCash, 0 as PayCard, '' BillCode
			FROM TRN_WORKER_PAYMENT   WTRP
			Inner join T_TILL_TXN txn on WTRP.WorkerPayID = txn.TrnRefID
			where (@sGio = '0' and txn.TrnDate between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate,103))
			OR (@sGio = '1' and convert(datetime,txn.TrnDate + txn.TrnTime,103) between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate + ' ' + @p_FromTime ,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate + ' ' + @p_ToTime,103))
		UNION			   	   																											    
			SELECT POID	AS TrnID, Total_Discount_Money AS DisCount, PMT.ShopID, UserID AS CreatedBy, '' AS EmpName, '' InOut, PMT.GhiChu AS [Description] ,
			'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd,	'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,	'' TrnGDN, 0 as  PayCash, 0 as PayCard, '' BillCode
			FROM #TRN_PO_MASTER		   PMT  
			Inner join T_TILL_TXN txn on PMT.POID = txn.TrnRefID
			WHERE PMT.[Status] = 'C'
			and (@sGio = '0' and txn.TrnDate between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate,103))
			OR (@sGio = '1' and convert(datetime,txn.TrnDate + txn.TrnTime,103) between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate + ' ' + @p_FromTime ,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate + ' ' + @p_ToTime,103))
		UNION
		SELECT WorkerPOID  AS TrnID, 0 AS DisCount,  PMTW.ShopID, UserID   AS CreatedBy, '' AS EmpName, '' InOut, PMTW.GhiChu AS [Description],
		'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd,	'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,	'' TrnGDN , 0 as  PayCash, 0 as PayCard, '' BillCode
		FROM TRN_PO_MASTER_WORKER PMTW 
		Inner join T_TILL_TXN txn on PMTW.WorkerPOID = txn.TrnRefID
		WHERE PMTW.[Status] = 'C'
		and (@sGio = '0' and txn.TrnDate between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate,103))
		OR (@sGio = '1' and convert(datetime,txn.TrnDate + txn.TrnTime,103) between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate + ' ' + @p_FromTime ,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate + ' ' + @p_ToTime,103))
		UNION
		SELECT 
			Bd.TrnID, 0 DisCount, BD.ShopID, BD.CreatedBy, SU.FullName AS EmpName, '' InOut, BD.GhiChu AS [Description],
			CONVERT(DATETIME,'01/01/1900') TrnDateTime_Upd, CONVERT(DATETIME,'01/01/1900') TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN, '' as TrnGDN, 0 as  PayCash, 0 as PayCard, '' BillCode
		FROM TRN_RT_BUYDIAMOND BD 
		LEFT JOIN SYS_USERS SU ON BD.CreatedBy = SU.UserID	
		Inner join T_TILL_TXN txn on BD.TrnID = txn.TrnRefID		
		WHERE BD.[Status] = 'C'
		and (@sGio = '0' and txn.TrnDate between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate,103))
		OR (@sGio = '1' and convert(datetime,txn.TrnDate + txn.TrnTime,103) between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate + ' ' + @p_FromTime ,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate + ' ' + @p_ToTime,103))
		UNION				   	   		         									     													    
		SELECT TrnID, 0 AS DisCount,DC.ShopID, CreatedBy, isnull(te.EmpName,'') AS EmpName,'' InOut, ''  AS [Description] ,
		'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd,	'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,	'' TrnGDN, CashPay as  PayCash, CardPay as PayCard, '' BillCode
		FROM TRN_DATCOC	   DC 
		left join T_TILL_TXN txn on DC.TrnID = txn.TrnRefID
		LEFT JOIN SYS_USERS U ON txn.ProcUserID = U.UserID
		LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE te ON te.EmpID = U.EmpID
		WHERE DC.[Status] = 'P'
		and (@sGio = '0' and txn.TrnDate between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate,103))
		OR (@sGio = '1' and convert(datetime,txn.TrnDate + txn.TrnTime,103) between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate + ' ' + @p_FromTime ,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate + ' ' + @p_ToTime,103))
		UNION
		SELECT RTC.TraHangID TrnID, 0 as DisCount, RTC.ShopID, RTC.UserID CreatedBy, EMP.EmpName, '' InOut, '' AS [Description] ,
		Convert(varchar,Isnull(RTC.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd,
		'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,
		'' TrnGDN, 0 as PayCash, 0 as PayCard, '' BillCode
		FROM TRN_TRAHANGLOI	 RTC  
		LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE EMP ON EMP.EmpID = RTC.EmpID  AND TinhTrang = 'C'
		Inner join T_TILL_TXN txn on RTC.TraHangID = txn.TrnRefID
		Where (@sGio = '0' and txn.TrnDate between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate,103))
		OR (@sGio = '1' and convert(datetime,txn.TrnDate + txn.TrnTime,103) between convert(datetime, @p_TrnFromDate + ' ' + @p_FromTime ,103) and convert(datetime, @p_TrnToDate + ' ' + @p_ToTime,103))
	 ) tmpComplete


	 CREATE TABLE #tam (TillTxnID VARCHAR(15), TillID VARCHAR(15),
	TrnRefID VARCHAR(15), TrnDate DATETIME, TrnTime VARCHAR(8), TrnType VARCHAR(30), TrnTypeDesc NVARCHAR(200), TrnCode VARCHAR(30), TrnCodeDesc NVARCHAR(300),
	CustID VARCHAR(15), CustName NVARCHAR(500), GoldCcy VARCHAR(15), GoldCcyDesc NVARCHAR(100), TrnAmount NUMERIC(19,8), TrnTotalAmount NUMERIC(18,3), [Status] VARCHAR(3),
	StatusName NVARCHAR(100), ProcUserID VARCHAR(15), UserName VARCHAR(80), DisCount NUMERIC(18,3), colSelect VARCHAR(1), BillCode VARCHAR(100),
	PayCard NUMERIC(18,3), ShopID VARCHAR(15), CreatedBy VARCHAR(15), EmpName NVARCHAR(500), [Description] NVARCHAR(500), TrnDateTime_Upd VARCHAR(MAX),
	TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN VARCHAR(MAX), TrnGDN VARCHAR(15), SOHDTuNhap NVARCHAR(MAX))

	create table #PayCard (TrnID varchar(15), CardPay numeric(18,3), CashPay numeric(18,3))
	insert into #PayCard (TrnID, CardPay, CashPay)
	select bs.TrnID, bs.CardPay, bs.CashPay
	from TRN_RT_BUYSELL bs 
	inner join #tmpTrnComplete txn on bs.TrnID = txn.TrnID
	
	--=========================================================================================================================================================
	--GIAO DỊCH HOÀN TẤT
	INSERT INTO #tam
	SELECT 	TXN.TillTxnID, 
			TXN.TillID, 
			TXN.TrnRefID, 
			TXN.TrnDate, 
			TXN.TrnTime, 
			TXN.TrnType, 
			TT.TrnTypeDesc, 
			TXN.TrnCode, 
			TC.TrnCodeDesc,
			CASE WHEN TXN.CustID IS NULL THEN W.WorkerID ELSE TXN.CustID END AS CustID, 
			CASE WHEN C.CustName IS NULL THEN W.WorkerName ELSE C.CustName END AS CustName, 
			TXN.GoldCcy, 
			GC.GoldCcyDesc, 
			TXN.TrnAmount,
			CASE WHEN TXN.TrnCode not in ('B','BRT','WT','WP','IO') then TXN.TrnTotalAmount
			Else 
				case when TXN.TrnCode <> 'IO' then -TXN.TrnTotalAmount					
				else
					case when TXN.GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong then
						case when tmpComplete.InOut = 'O' then -TXN.TrnTotalAmount else TXN.TrnTotalAmount end
					else
						case when tmpComplete.InOut = 'O' then -TXN.TrnTotalAmount else TXN.TrnTotalAmount end/(case when ig.WeightUnit = 'L' then @sHeSo else 1 end)
					end
				end
			end TrnTotalAmount,
			TXN.[Status], 
			TS.StatusName, 
			TXN.ProcUserID, 
			US.UserName, 
			ISNULL(tmpComplete.DisCount, 0) AS DisCount,
			'0' AS colSelect, 
			case when TXN.BillCode is null and TXN.TrnCode = 'THL' THEN TXN.TrnRefID ELSE TXN.BillCode END BillCode, 
			ISNULL(TTC.Amount, tmpComplete.PayCard) AS PayCard,
			tmpComplete.ShopID, 
			tmpComplete.CreatedBy, 
			ISNULL(tmpComplete.EmpName, TE.EmpName) AS EmpName, 
			tmpComplete.[Description],
			Convert(varchar,Isnull(tmpComplete.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd,
			Convert(varchar,Isnull(tmpComplete.TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,
			tmpComplete.TrnGDN, tmpComplete.BillCode SoHDTuNhap
	FROM T_TILL_TXN TXN
		 LEFT JOIN T_TILL TTI ON TTI.TillID = TXN.TillID
		 LEFT JOIN T_TILL_CARDPAY TTC ON TTC.TillTxnID = TXN.TillTxnID
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNTYPE TT ON TXN.TrnType = TT.TrnType
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNCODE TC ON TXN.TrnCode = TC.TrnCode
		 LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER C ON C.CustID = TXN.CustID
		 LEFT JOIN T_WORKER W ON W.WorkerID = TXN.CustID 
		 LEFT JOIN T_STATUS TS ON TS.[Status] = TXN.[Status] AND TS.[Type] = 'TILLTRN'
		 LEFT JOIN AllGoldCcy GC ON GC.GoldCcy = TXN.GoldCcy
		 LEFT JOIN SYS_USERS US ON US.UserID = TXN.ProcUserID
		 LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE TE ON TE.EmpID = US.EmpID
		 INNER JOIN #tmpTrnComplete tmpComplete ON tmpComplete.TrnID = TXN.TrnRefID
		 LEFT JOIN I_GOLD ig ON ig.GoldCode = TXN.GoldCcy
		 
	--=========================================================================================================================================================
	SELECT  CFD.TrnID,
			SUM(CFD.AddMoney) AS TotalAddMoneyWait
	INTO #tmpFXWait
	FROM TRN_FX_DT CFD
		 LEFT JOIN TRN_FX CFX ON CFX.TrnID = CFD.TrnID
	WHERE CFX.[Status] = 'W'
	GROUP BY CFD.TrnID
		
	-- GIAO DỊCH NGOẠI TỆ LƯU TẠM
	INSERT INTO #tam
	SELECT	'' TillTxnID, 
			'' TillID, 
			CFX.TrnID TrnRefID, 
			CFX.TrnDate, 
			CFX.TrnTime, 
			CFX.TrnType, 
			TTY.TrnTypeDesc, 
			TCD.TrnCode, 
			TCD.TrnCodeDesc, 
			CUS.CustID,
			CUS.CustName, 
			@MaTienTeHeThong AS GoldCcy, 
			AGC.GoldCcyDesc, 
			NULL TrnAmount,						--Số lượng
			CFX.PayCus AS TrnTotalAmount,		--Thanh toán tiền mặt
			CFX.[Status], 
			STA.StatusName, 
			NULL AS ProcUserID, 
			NULL AS UserName, 
			CASE WHEN @vIsUseTotalAddMoney = 1 THEN CFX.AddMoney ELSE #tmpFXWait.TotalAddMoneyWait END AS DisCount,
			'0' AS colSelect, 
			CASE WHEN @BillCode = '1' THEN CFX.BillCode ELSE @Emptyvarchar END AS BillCode, 
			0 PayCard, 
			CFX.ShopID, 
			CFX.CreatedBy, 
			ISNULL(EMP1.EmpName, EMP.EmpName) AS EmpName,
			'' AS [Description],
			Convert(varchar,Isnull(CFX.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd,
			Convert(varchar,Isnull(GDN.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,
			GDN.TrnID TrnGDN, '' SOHDTuNhap
	FROM TRN_FX CFX
		 LEFT JOIN T_STATUS STA ON STA.[Status] = CFX.[Status] AND STA.Type = 'FX'
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNTYPE TTY ON CFX.TrnType = TTY.TrnType
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNCODE TCD ON CFX.TrnType = TCD.TrnCode
		 LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER CUS ON CUS.CustID = CFX.CustID
		 LEFT JOIN AllGoldCcy AGC ON AGC.GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong
		 LEFT JOIN SYS_USERS USR ON CFX.CreatedBy = USR.UserID
		 LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE EMP ON EMP.EmpID = USR.EmpID
		 LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE EMP1 ON EMP1.EmpID = CFX.EmpID
		 LEFT JOIN (select distinct TTrnID, TrnDateTime_Upd, GD.TrnID from TRN_GIAODICHNHANH_DT DT
								LEFT JOIN TRN_GIAODICHNHANH GD ON DT.TrnID = GD.TrnID) GDN on CFX.TrnID = GDN.TTrnID
		 LEFT JOIN #tmpFXWait ON #tmpFXWait.TrnID = CFX.TrnID
	WHERE CFX.[Status]='W'
	
	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- GIAO DỊCH MUA BÁN LƯU TẠM
	INSERT INTO #tam
	SELECT  '' TillTxnID, 
			'' TillID, 
			trb.TrnID TrnRefID, 
			trb.TrnDate, 
			trb.TrnTime, 
			it.TrnType, 
			it.TrnTypeDesc, 
			it2.TrnCode, 
			it2.TrnCodeDesc,
			ic.CustID, 
			ic.CustName, 
			@MaTienTeHeThong GoldCcy, 
			agc.GoldCcyDesc, 
			NULL TrnAmount,
			trb.PayAmount TrnTotalAmount,
			trb.[STATUS], 
			ts.StatusName, 
			NULL ProcUserID, 
			NULL UserName, 
			ISNULL(trb.DisCount, 0) DisCount,
			'0' colSelect, 
			trb.BillCode, 
			0 AS PayCard, 
			trb.ShopID, 
			trb.CreatedBy, 
			te.EmpName, 
			trb.[Description] AS [Description],
			Convert(varchar,Isnull(trb.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd,
			Convert(varchar,Isnull(GDN.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,
			GDN.TrnID TrnGDN,
			ISNULL(trb.SOHDTuNhap, '') SOHDTuNhap
	FROM TRN_RT_BUYSELL trb
		 LEFT JOIN T_STATUS ts ON ts.[Status] = trb.[STATUS] AND ts.Type = 'SRT'
		 LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER ic ON ic.CustID = trb.CustID
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNTYPE it ON it.TrnType = 'RT'
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNCODE it2 ON it2.TrnCode = 'SRT'
		 LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE te on te.EmpID = trb.EmpID
		 LEFT JOIN AllGoldCcy agc ON agc.GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong
		 LEFT JOIN (select distinct TTrnID, TrnDateTime_Upd, GD.TrnID from TRN_GIAODICHNHANH_DT DT
								LEFT JOIN TRN_GIAODICHNHANH GD ON DT.TrnID = GD.TrnID) GDN on trb.TrnID = GDN.TTrnID
	WHERE trb.[Status] = 'W'
	
	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- GIAO DỊCH ĐỔI BÙ LƯU TẠM
	INSERT INTO #tam
	SELECT	'' TillTxnID, 
			'' TillID, 
			trc.TrnID TrnRefID, 
			trc.TrnDate, 
			trc.TrnTime, 
			it.TrnType, 
			it.TrnTypeDesc, 
			it2.TrnCode, 
			it2.TrnCodeDesc,	
			ic.CustID,
			ic.CustName, 
			@MaTienTeHeThong GoldCcy, 
			agc.GoldCcyDesc, 
			NULL TrnAmount,
			trc.PayAmount TrnTotalAmount,
			trc.[Status], 
			ts.StatusName, 
			NULL ProcUserID, 
			NULL UserName,
			ISNULL(trc.Discount,0) DisCount,
			'0' colSelect, 
			CASE WHEN trc.SOHDTuNhap IS NULL OR trc.SOHDTuNhap = '' then trc.BillCode ELSE trc.SOHDTuNhap END BillCode, 
			0 PayCard, 
			trc.ShopID, 
			trc.CreatedBy, 
			te.EmpName, 
			'' AS [Description],
			Convert(varchar,Isnull(trc.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd,	
			'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,	'' TrnGDN,
			ISNULL(trc.SOHDTuNhap, '') SOHDTuNhap
	FROM TRN_RT_CHANGE trc
		 LEFT JOIN T_STATUS ts ON ts.[Status] = trc.[Status] AND ts.Type = 'CRT'
		 LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER ic ON ic.CustID = trc.CustID
		 LEFT JOIN AllGoldCcy agc ON agc.GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNCODE it2 ON it2.TrnCode = 'CRT'
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNTYPE it ON it.TrnType = 'RT'
		 LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE te on te.EmpID = trc.EmpID
	WHERE trc.[Status] = 'W'
	
	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- GIAO DỊCH MUA DẺ LƯU TẠM
	INSERT INTO #tam
	SELECT	'' TillTxnID,
			'' TillID, 
			trb.TrnID TrnRefID, 
			trb.TrnDate, 
			trb.TrnTime, 
			it.TrnType, 
			it.TrnTypeDesc, 
			it2.TrnCode, 
			it2.TrnCodeDesc, 
			ic.CustID,
			ic.CustName, 
			trb.GoldCode GoldCcy, 
			agc.GoldCcyDesc, 
			trb.GoldWeight TrnAmount,
			-(trb.TotalAmount) TrnTotalAmount,
			trb.[Status], 
			ts.StatusName, 
			NULL ProcUserID, 
			NULL UserName,
			0 DisCount,
			'0' colSelect, 
			case when @BillCode = '1' 
				THEN CASE WHEN trb.SOHDTuNhap IS NULL OR trb.SOHDTuNhap = '' then trb.BillCode ELSE trb.SOHDTuNhap END   
				ELSE @Emptyvarchar 
				END BillCode , 
			0 AS PayCard, 
			trb.ShopID, 
			trb.CreatedBy,
			ISNULL(te1.EmpName, te.EmpName) EmpName, 
			'' AS [Description],
			Convert(varchar,Isnull(trb.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd,
			Convert(varchar,Isnull(GDN.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,
			GDN.TrnID TrnGDN,
			ISNULL(trb.SOHDTuNhap, '') SOHDTuNhap
	FROM TRN_RT_BUYGOLD trb
		 LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER ic ON ic.CustID = trb.CustID
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNTYPE it ON it.TrnType = 'RT'
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNCODE it2 ON it2.TrnCode = 'BRT'
		 LEFT JOIN AllGoldCcy agc ON agc.GoldCcy = trb.GoldCode
		 LEFT JOIN T_STATUS ts ON ts.[Status] = trb.[Status] AND ts.Type = 'BRT'
		 LEFT JOIN SYS_USERS U ON trb.CreatedBy = U.UserID
		 LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE te ON te.EmpID = U.EmpID
		 LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE te1 ON te1.EmpID = TRB.EmpID
		 LEFT JOIN TRN_GIAODICHNHANH_DT DT ON DT.TTrnID = trb.TrnID
		 LEFT JOIN TRN_GIAODICHNHANH GDN ON DT.TrnID = GDN.TrnID
	WHERE trb.[Status] = 'W'
	
	-- GIAO DỊCH MUA XOÀN LƯU TẠM
	INSERT INTO #tam
	SELECT	'' TillTxnID,
			'' TillID, 
			trb.TrnID TrnRefID, 
			trb.TrnDate, 
			trb.TrnTime, 
			it.TrnType, 
			it.TrnTypeDesc, 
			it2.TrnCode, 
			it2.TrnCodeDesc, 
			ic.CustID,
			ic.CustName, 
			trb.MaDa GoldCcy, 
			dmd.TenDa GoldCcyDesc, 
			trb.SL TrnAmount,
			-(trb.ThanhTien) TrnTotalAmount,
			trb.[Status], 
			ts.StatusName, 
			NULL ProcUserID, 
			NULL UserName,
			0 DisCount,
			'0' colSelect, 
			@Emptyvarchar BillCode , 
			0 AS PayCard, 
			trb.ShopID, 
			trb.CreatedBy,
			ISNULL(te.EmpName, te.EmpName) EmpName, 
			'' AS [Description],
			CONVERT(varchar,CONVERT(DATETIME,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd,
			CONVERT(varchar,CONVERT(DATETIME,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,
			GDN.TrnID TrnGDN, '' SOHDTuNhap
	FROM TRN_RT_BUYDIAMOND trb
		 LEFT JOIN DanhMucDa dmd ON dmd.MaDa = trb.MaDa
		 LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER ic ON ic.CustID = trb.CustID
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNTYPE it ON it.TrnType = 'RT'
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNCODE it2 ON it2.TrnCode = 'DRT'		 
		 LEFT JOIN T_STATUS ts ON ts.[Status] = trb.[Status] AND ts.Type = 'BRT'
		 LEFT JOIN SYS_USERS U ON trb.CreatedBy = U.UserID
		 LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE te ON te.EmpID = U.EmpID
		 LEFT JOIN TRN_GIAODICHNHANH_DT DT ON DT.TTrnID = trb.TrnID
		 LEFT JOIN TRN_GIAODICHNHANH GDN ON DT.TrnID = GDN.TrnID
	WHERE trb.[Status] = 'W'

	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- GIAO DỊCH KẾT TOA LƯU TẠM/CHỜ THANH TOÁN
	INSERT INTO #tam
	SELECT	'' TillTxnID, 
			'' TillID, 
			tpm.POID TrnRefID, 
			tpm.PODate TrnDate, 
			tpm.POTime TrnTime, 
			'PO' TrnType, 
			it.TrnTypeDesc, 
			'PO' TrnCode, 
			it2.TrnCodeDesc, 
			tpm.CustID,
			ic.CustName, 
			@MaTienTeHeThong GoldCcy, 
			agc.GoldCcyDesc, 
			NULL TrnAmount,
			tpm.TotalAmount * 1000 TrnTotalAmount,
			tpm.[Status], 
			ts.StatusName, 
			NULL ProcUserID, 
			NULL UserName, 
			0 DisCount,
			'0' as colSelect, 
			case when @BillCode = '1' then tpm.BillCode else @Emptyvarchar end BillCode, 0 AS PayCard, 
			tpm.ShopID, 
			tpm.UserID CreatedBy, 
			te.EmpName, 
			'' AS [Description],
			'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd,	
			'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,	
			'' TrnGDN, '' SOHDTuNhap
	FROM TRN_PO_MASTER tpm
		 LEFT JOIN T_STATUS ts ON ts.[Status] = tpm.[Status] AND ts.Type = 'PO'
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNTYPE it ON it.TrnType = 'PO'
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNCODE it2 ON it2.TrnCode = 'PO'
		 LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER ic ON ic.CustID = tpm.CustID
		 LEFT JOIN AllGoldCcy agc ON agc.GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong
		 LEFT JOIN SYS_USERS U ON tpm.UserID = U.UserID
		 LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE te ON te.EmpID = U.EmpID
	WHERE tpm.[Status] IN ('P','U') --Đối với Kết Toa thì 'W' chỉ mới lưu tạm, chưa hoàn tất
	
	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- GIAO DỊCH THU CHI TẠI QUẦY LƯU TẠM
	INSERT INTO #tam
	SELECT	'' TillTxnID, 
			'' TillID, 
			tt.TrnID TrnRefID, 
			tt.TrnDate, 
			tt.TrnTime, 
			'TILL' AS TrnType, 
			it.TrnTypeDesc, 
			it2.TrnCode, 
			it2.TrnCodeDesc,	
			'' CustID,
			'' CustName, 
			tt.GoldCcy GoldCcy, 
			agc.GoldCcyDesc, 
			0 AS TrnAmount,
			CASE WHEN tt.GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong
			THEN 
				CASE WHEN tt.InOut = 'O' THEN -tt.Amount ELSE tt.Amount END
			ELSE
				CASE WHEN tt.InOut = 'O' THEN -tt.Amount ELSE tt.Amount END/(case when ig.WeightUnit = 'L' then @sHeSo else 1 end)
			END TrnTotalAmount,
			tt.[Status], 
			ts.StatusName, 
			NULL ProcUserID, 
			NULL UserName, 
			0 DisCount,
			'0' colSelect, 
			@Emptyvarchar BillCode,
			0 PayCard, 
			tt.ShopID, 
			tt.CreatedBy, 
			ISNULL(te.EmpName, '') EmpName, 
			'' AS [Description],'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd,	'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,	'' TrnGDN, '' SOHDTuNhap
	FROM TRN_TILL_INOUT tt
		 LEFT JOIN T_STATUS ts ON ts.[Status] = tt.[Status] AND ts.Type = 'TILLIO'
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNTYPE it ON it.TrnType = 'TILL'
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNCODE it2 ON it2.TrnCode = 'IO'
		 LEFT JOIN AllGoldCcy agc ON agc.GoldCcy = tt.GoldCcy
		 LEFT JOIN SYS_USERS U ON tt.CreatedBy = U.UserID
		 LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE te ON te.EmpID = U.EmpID
		 LEFT JOIN I_GOLD ig on tt.GoldCcy = ig.GoldCode
	WHERE tt.[Status] = 'W'

	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- GIAO DỊCH THỢ CƠ BẢN LƯU TẠM
	INSERT INTO #tam
	SELECT  '' TillTxnID, 
			'' TillID, 
			WTR.TrnID TrnRefID, 
			WTR.TrnDate, 
			WTR.TrnTime, 
			TYP.TrnType, 
			TYP.TrnTypeDesc, 
			TCD.TrnCode AS TrnCode, 
			TCD.TrnCodeDesc AS TrnCodeDesc,
			WKR.WorkerID AS CustID, 
			WKR.WorkerName AS CustName, 
			@MaTienTeHeThong GoldCcy, 
			AGC.GoldCcyDesc, 
			WTR.TotalAmount TrnAmount,
			WTR.PayAmount TrnTotalAmount,
			WTR.[STATUS], 
			STS.StatusName, 
			NULL ProcUserID, 
			NULL UserName, 
			0 DisCount,
			'0' colSelect, 
			@Emptyvarchar AS BillCode, 
			0 AS PayCard, 
			WTR.ShopID, 
			WTR.CreatedBy, 
			'' AS EmpName, 
			'' AS [Description],'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd,	'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,	'' TrnGDN, '' SOHDTuNhap
	FROM TRN_WORKER WTR
		 LEFT JOIN T_STATUS STS ON STS.[Status] = WTR.[STATUS] AND STS.Type = 'WORKER'
		 LEFT JOIN T_WORKER WKR ON WKR.WorkerID = WTR.WorkerID
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNTYPE TYP ON TYP.TrnType = 'WORKER'
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNCODE TCD ON TCD.TrnCode = 'WT'
		 LEFT JOIN AllGoldCcy AGC ON AGC.GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong
	WHERE WTR.[Status] = 'W'

	-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	-- GIAO DỊCH BÁN SỈ THỢ LƯU TẠM
	INSERT INTO #tam
	SELECT	'' AS TillTxnID, 
			'' AS TillID, 
			PMTW.WorkerPOID AS TrnRefID, 
			PMTW.PODate AS TrnDate, 
			PMTW.POTime AS TrnTime, 
			ITT.TrnType AS TrnType, 
			ITT.TrnTypeDesc, 
			ITC.TrnCode AS TrnCode, 
			ITC.TrnCodeDesc, 
			PMTW.WorkerID AS CustID,
			TWK.WorkerName AS CustName, 
			@MaTienTeHeThong AS GoldCcy, 
			AGC.GoldCcyDesc, 
			0 AS TrnAmount,
			PMTW.Total_Amount * 1000 AS TrnTotalAmount,
			PMTW.[Status], 
			TST.StatusName, 
			NULL AS ProcUserID, 
			NULL AS UserName, 
			0 AS DisCount,
			'0' AS colSelect, 
			CASE WHEN @BillCode = '1' THEN PMTW.BillCode ELSE @Emptyvarchar END BillCode, 
			0 AS PayCard, 
			PMTW.ShopID, 
			PMTW.UserID AS CreatedBy, 
			TEP.EmpName, 
			'' AS [Description],'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd,	'01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,	'' TrnGDN, '' SOHDTuNhap
	FROM TRN_PO_MASTER_WORKER PMTW
		 LEFT JOIN T_STATUS TST ON TST.[Status] = PMTW.[Status] AND TST.[Type] = 'PO'
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNTYPE ITT ON ITT.TrnType = 'PO'
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNCODE ITC ON ITC.TrnCode = 'POW'
		 LEFT JOIN T_WORKER TWK ON TWK.WorkerID = PMTW.WorkerID
		 LEFT JOIN AllGoldCcy AGC ON AGC.GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong
		 LEFT JOIN SYS_USERS SUS ON PMTW.UserID = SUS.UserID
		 LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE TEP ON TEP.EmpID = SUS.EmpID
	WHERE PMTW.[Status] IN ('P','U') --Đối với Kết Toa thì 'W' chỉ mới lưu tạm, chưa hoàn tất

	-- GIAO DỊCH Trả hàng lỗi LƯU TẠM
	INSERT INTO #tam
	SELECT  '' TillTxnID, 
			'' TillID, 
			trb.TraHangID TrnRefID, 
			convert(datetime,convert(varchar(10),trb.NgayTraHang,103),103) TrnDate, 
			convert(varchar(10),trb.NgayTraHang,108) TrnTime, 
			it.TrnType, 
			it.TrnTypeDesc, 
			it2.TrnCode, 
			it2.TrnCodeDesc,
			'' CustID, 
			'' CustName, 
			@MaTienTeHeThong GoldCcy, 
			agc.GoldCcyDesc, 
			NULL TrnAmount,
			0 TrnTotalAmount,
			trb.TinhTrang [STATUS], 
			ts.StatusName, 
			NULL ProcUserID, 
			NULL UserName, 
			0 DisCount,
			'0' colSelect, 
			trb.TraHangID BillCode, 
			0 AS PayCard, 
			trb.ShopID, 
			trb.UserID CreatedBy, 
			te.EmpName, 
			trb.GhiChu AS [Description],
			Convert(varchar,Isnull(trb.TrnDateTime_Upd,'01/01/1900'),25) TrnDateTime_Upd, '01/01/1900' TrnDateTime_Upd_GDN,	'' TrnGDN, '' SOHDTuNhap
	FROM TRN_TRAHANGLOI trb
		 LEFT JOIN T_STATUS ts ON ts.[Status] = trb.TinhTrang AND ts.Type = 'SRT'
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNTYPE it ON it.TrnType = 'THL'
		 LEFT JOIN I_TRNCODE it2 ON it2.TrnCode = 'THL'
		 LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE te on te.EmpID = trb.EmpID
		 LEFT JOIN AllGoldCcy agc ON agc.GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong
	WHERE trb.TinhTrang = 'W'
	
	--====================================================================================================================================
	EXEC("	SELECT ROW_NUMBER() over (order by trndate) STT, D.* 
			FROM #tam D
				LEFT JOIN SYS_USERS U ON U.UserID = D.ProcUserID
				LEFT JOIN T_MAINSECTION MSEC ON MSEC.MainSectionID = U.MainSectionID
		" + @sDK
	)

	DROP TABLE #dtBillCode
END

name: CARDPAY_Ins
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[CARDPAY_Ins]
			@p_TillID VARCHAR(30) = NULL,
			@p_TillTxnID varchar(30)=NULL,
			@p_TrnID VARCHAR(3000) = NULL,	
			@p_TypeTrade varchar(10) = NULL,
			@p_ProductIDs VARCHAR(3000) = NULL,	
			@p_CardAmounts VARCHAR(3000) = NULL,			
			@p_Amount numeric(18,3)=NULL,
			@p_AmountTra numeric(18,3)=NULL,
			@p_List XML	
AS

BEGIN TRANSACTION 	
	DECLARE @p_Message nvarchar(4000)
	SET @p_Message = ''
	DECLARE @sErrCode VARCHAR(100)
	DECLARE @sErr NVARCHAR(30)
	DECLARE @Card TABLE (
	NumberBank nvarchar(100),
	PayType varchar(10),
	Amount numeric(18,3))
	
	INSERT INTO @Card
	SELECT 
		Tbl.Col.value('(NumberBank/text())[1]', 'nvarchar(100)') as NumberBank,
		Tbl.Col.value('(PayType/text())[1]', 'varchar(100)') as PayType,
		Tbl.Col.value('(Amount/text())[1]', 'numeric(18,3)') as Amount
	FROM @p_List.nodes('/NewDataSet/Card') as Tbl(Col)

	declare @NumberBank nvarchar(100)
	declare @PayType varchar(100)
	declare @Amount numeric(18,3)

	DECLARE pCurP CURSOR FOR SELECT NumberBank, PayType, Amount FROM @Card 
	OPEN pCurP
	FETCH NEXT FROM pCurP INTO @NumberBank, @PayType, @Amount
	WHILE @@FETCH_STATUS = 0
	begin 
	If (@p_TypeTrade = 'SRT')
	begin
	INSERT INTO TRN_RT_BUYSELL_CardPay
	(
		TillID,
		TillTxnID,
		TrnID,
		PayDate,
		IDCard,
		Amount,
		PayType				
	) 
	SELECT
		@p_TillID,
		@p_TillTxnID,
		@p_TrnID,
		GETDATE(),
		NumberBank,
		Amount,
		Case when PayType='0' then '' else PayType end	
	FROM @Card
	WHERE NumberBank=@NumberBank and Amount = @Amount and PayType = @PayType
	end
	
	If (@p_TypeTrade = 'CRT')
	begin
	INSERT INTO TRN_RT_CHANGE_CardPay
	(
		TillID,
		TillTxnID,
		TrnID,
		PayDate,
		IDCard,
		Amount,
		PayType				
	) 
	SELECT
		@p_TillID,
		@p_TillTxnID,
		@p_TrnID,
		GETDATE(),
		NumberBank,
		Amount,
		Case when PayType='0' then '' else PayType end
	FROM @Card
	WHERE NumberBank=@NumberBank and Amount = @Amount and PayType = @PayType
	end

	If (@p_TypeTrade = 'FX')
	begin
		INSERT INTO TRN_FX_CardPay
		(
			TillID,	TillTxnID,TrnID,PayDate,IDCard,	Amount,	PayType				
		) 
		SELECT
			@p_TillID,@p_TillTxnID,	@p_TrnID,GETDATE(),	NumberBank,	Amount,	Case when PayType='0' then '' else PayType end
		FROM @Card
		WHERE NumberBank=@NumberBank and Amount = @Amount and PayType = @PayType
	end

	If (@p_TypeTrade = 'TDC')
	begin
		INSERT INTO TRN_DATCOC_CardPay
		(
			TillID,	TillTxnID,TrnID,PayDate,IDCard,	Amount,	PayType				
		) 
		SELECT
			@p_TillID,	@p_TillTxnID,@p_TrnID,	GETDATE(),NumberBank,Amount,Case when PayType='0' then '' else PayType end				
		FROM @Card
		WHERE NumberBank=@NumberBank and Amount = @Amount and PayType = @PayType
	end

	If (@p_TypeTrade = 'BRT')
	begin
		INSERT INTO TRN_RT_BUYGOLD_CardPay
		(
			TillID,TillTxnID,TrnID,PayDate,IDCard,Amount,PayType				
		) 
		SELECT
			@p_TillID,@p_TillTxnID,@p_TrnID,GETDATE(),NumberBank,Amount,
			Case when PayType='0' then '' else PayType end				
		FROM @Card
		WHERE NumberBank=@NumberBank and Amount = @Amount and PayType = @PayType
	end	
	FETCH NEXT FROM pCurP INTO @NumberBank, @PayType ,@Amount
	END		
	CLOSE pCurP
	DEALLOCATE pCurP
	IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT	
	
	DECLARE @sChar char(1)
	SET @sChar = '@'	

	DECLARE @sDSProductID varchar(6000)
	DECLARE @sProductID varchar(15)
	DECLARE @iPosProductID INT	
	DECLARE @sDSCardAmount varchar(6000)
	DECLARE @sCardAmount varchar(15)
	DECLARE @iPosCardAmount int
		
	SET @sDSProductID = @p_ProductIDs
	SET @sDSCardAmount = @p_CardAmounts
	IF(@p_ProductIDs IS NOT NULL)
	BEGIN
	WHILE len(@sDSProductID) > 0
	BEGIN
		SET @iPosProductID = CHARINDEX(@sChar,@sDSProductID)
		SET @iPosCardAmount = CHARINDEX(@sChar,@sDSCardAmount)
		IF @iPosProductID > 0
			BEGIN
				SET @sProductID 	= rtrim(ltrim(SUBSTRING(@sDSProductID,1,@iPosProductID-1)))
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
				SET @sDSProductID 	= SUBSTRING(@sDSProductID,@iPosProductID+1,LEN(@sDSProductID) - @iPosProductID)
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT

				SET @sCardAmount 	= rtrim(ltrim(SUBSTRING(@sDSCardAmount,1,@iPosCardAmount-1)))
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
				SET @sDSCardAmount 	= SUBSTRING(@sDSCardAmount,@iPosCardAmount+1,LEN(@sDSCardAmount) - @iPosCardAmount)
				IF @@Error <> 0 GOTO ABORT
			END
		ELSE
			BEGIN
				SET @sProductID = rtrim(ltrim(@sDSProductID))
				SET @sDSProductID = ''
				SET @sCardAmount = rtrim(ltrim(@sDSCardAmount))
				SET @sDSCardAmount = ''
			END 
			
			UPDATE TRN_RT_BUYSELL_SELL
			SET CardAmount = @sCardAmount
			WHERE TrnID = @p_TrnID AND ProductID = @sProductID 
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 GOTO ABORT
	END
		IF(@p_TypeTrade = 'SRT')
		BEGIN
			UPDATE TRN_RT_BUYSELL
			SET
				CashPay=@p_AmountTra,
				CardPay=@p_Amount
			WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID
		END		
		--Cap nhat tiền thanh toán trong T_TILL_TXN
		EXEC TRN_TILL_TXN_Upd	
			@p_TrnID = @p_TrnID,
			@p_TrnType = 'RT',
			@p_TrnCode = 'SRT',
			@p_ErrCOde = @sErrCode OUT
		SET @sErr = (SELECT se.ErrorDesc
		               FROM SYS_ERROR se WHERE se.ErrorCode = @sErrCode)
	IF @sErrCode <> '0' GOTO ABORT	
	END
	ELSE 
	BEGIN
		IF(@p_TypeTrade = 'CRT')
		BEGIN
			UPDATE TRN_RT_CHANGE
			SET
				PayCard=@p_Amount,
				CashPay=@p_AmountTra,
				CardPay=@p_Amount
			WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 GOTO ABORT

			EXEC TRN_TILL_TXN_Upd	
				@p_TrnID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnType = 'RT',
				@p_TrnCode = 'CRT',
				@p_ErrCOde = @sErrCode OUT

			SET @sErr = (SELECT se.ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR se WHERE se.ErrorCode = @sErrCode)
			IF @sErrCode <> '0' GOTO ABORT
		END
		ELSE IF(@p_TypeTrade = 'FX')
		BEGIN
			UPDATE TRN_FX SET
				PayCard=@p_Amount,
				PayCash=@p_AmountTra
			WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 GOTO ABORT

			EXEC TRN_TILL_TXN_Upd	
				@p_TrnID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnType = 'FX',
				@p_TrnCode = 'FX',
				@p_ErrCOde = @sErrCode OUT

			SET @sErr = (SELECT se.ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR se WHERE se.ErrorCode = @sErrCode)
			IF @sErrCode <> '0' GOTO ABORT
		END
	END
	IF(@p_TypeTrade = 'TDC')
		BEGIN
			UPDATE TRN_DATCOC
			SET
				CashPay=@p_AmountTra,
				CardPay=@p_Amount
			WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 GOTO ABORT

			EXEC TRN_TILL_TXN_Upd	
				@p_TrnID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnType = 'TDC',
				@p_TrnCode = 'TDC',
				@p_ErrCOde = @sErrCode OUT

			SET @sErr = (SELECT se.ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR se WHERE se.ErrorCode = @sErrCode)
			IF @sErrCode <> '0' GOTO ABORT
		END
	IF(@p_TypeTrade = 'BRT')
		BEGIN
			UPDATE TRN_RT_BUYGOLD SET	CardPay=@p_Amount,	CashPay=@p_AmountTra
			WHERE TrnID=@p_TrnID
			IF @@ERROR <> 0 GOTO ABORT

			EXEC TRN_TILL_TXN_Upd	
				@p_TrnID = @p_TrnID,
				@p_TrnType = 'RT',
				@p_TrnCode = 'BRT',
				@p_ErrCOde = @sErrCode OUT

			SET @sErr = (SELECT se.ErrorDesc FROM SYS_ERROR se WHERE se.ErrorCode = @sErrCode)
			IF @sErrCode <> '0' GOTO ABORT
		END
	COMMIT TRANSACTION	
	SELECT 0 AS Result, '' ErrorDesc,@sErrCode ErrorCode
	RETURN 0
ABORT:
BEGIN
	ROLLBACK TRANSACTION
	SELECT -1 AS Result,  @sErr AS ErrorDesc,@sErrCode ErrorCode
	RETURN -1
END

name: rptTDC_PrintBill
definition:
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rptTDC_PrintBill]
	@p_TrnID VARCHAR(15)
AS
	DECLARE @sHeso NUMERIC(19,8) 
	SET @sHeso=dbo.fun_GetHS()
    DECLARE @MaTienTeHeThong Varchar(10)    
    SELECT @MaTienTeHeThong = ParaValue From SYS_PARAMETERS WHERE ParaKey = 'MaTienTeHeThong'
 
	declare @BankName nvarchar(max)
	set @BankName = ''
	select @BankName = @BankName + Coalesce(isnull(BC.BankName,''),'/')
	from TRN_DATCOC_CardPay SCP
	inner join I_BankCard BC on SCP.IDCard = BC.NumberBank
	where TrnID = @p_TrnID
	
	--Main
	SELECT 	RT.TrnDate, RT.TrnTime, RT.BillCode, CustCode, CustName, C.Address CustAddress, C.Phone,
		RT.CreatedBy MaNguoiLap, SU.UserName TenNguoiLap, C.CMND,
		RT.[Description] GhiChuHD,RT.CashPay, RT.CardPay,RT.TienCoc, C.Masothue MaSoThue,
		c.Company_Address DiaChiCongTy, C.Company TenCongTy, isnull(CP.BankName, @BankName) BankName, emp.EmpName
	FROM TRN_DATCOC RT	
	LEFT JOIN T_EMPLOYEE emp ON RT.EmpID = emp.EmpID
	LEFT JOIN I_CUSTOMER C ON C.CustID = RT.CustID
	LEFT JOIN SYS_USERS SU ON SU.UserID = RT.CreatedBy
	left join T_TILL_TXN txn on RT.TrnID = txn.TrnRefID
	left join T_TILL_TXN_DETAIL txnd on txn.TillTxnID = txnd.TillTxnID and txnd.GoldCcy = @MaTienTeHeThong
	left join T_TILL_CARDPAY CP on CP.TillTxnID = txn.TillTxnID
	WHERE RT.TrnID = @p_TrnID

	DECLARE @NewGold TABLE (ProductDesc NVARCHAR(max), GoldDesc NVARCHAR(100),
		TotalWeight NUMERIC(19,8), DiamondWeight NUMERIC(19,8), DiamondWeightChar varchar(1000), DiamondWeightChar_Bill varchar(1000),
		GoldWeight NUMERIC(19,8),GoldWeightChar varchar(1000), GoldWeightChar_Bill varchar(1000), TaskPrice NUMERIC(18,3),
		SL INT, GhiChu NVARCHAR(MAX), GoldCode VARCHAR(10),
		GoldAge NUMERIC(18,2), TuoiPho NVARCHAR(100), WeightUnit VARCHAR(10),Size NUMERIC(10,2))

	-- 2_NewGold --
	INSERT INTO @NewGold
	SELECT 	SRT.ProductDesc, GoldDesc,
		CASE WHEN IG.WeightUnit='L' THEN SRT.TotalWeight/@sHeso ELSE SRT.TotalWeight END TotalWeight,
		CASE WHEN IG.WeightUnit='L' THEN ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)/@sHeso  ELSE ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0) END DiamondWeight,
		dbo.GoldWeightToChar(ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0),IG.WeightUnit) DiamondWeightChar,
		dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Report(ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0),IG.WeightUnit) DiamondWeightChar_Bill,
		CASE WHEN IG.WeightUnit='L' THEN (SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0))/@sHeso ELSE (SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)) END  GoldWeight,
		dbo.GoldWeightToChar((SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)),IG.WeightUnit) GoldWeightChar, 
		dbo.GoldWeightToChar_Report((SRT.TotalWeight - ISNULL(SRT.DiamondWeight,0)),IG.WeightUnit) GoldWeightChar_Bill, 
		SRT.TaskPrice, ISNULL(SRT.SL,1) SL, SRT.Notes GhiChu,SRT.GoldCode,IG.GoldAge, IG.TuoiPho,IG.WeightUnit, SRT.Size		
	FROM TRN_DATCOC RT	
	LEFT JOIN TRN_DATCOC_DT SRT ON SRT.TrnID = RT.TrnID
	LEFT JOIN I_GOLD IG ON IG.GoldCode = SRT.GoldCode
	WHERE SRT.TrnID = @p_TrnID
	order by SRT.TrnDTID

	SELECT 	* FROM @NewGold
		
	-- 3_NewGold --
	SELECT 	* FROM @NewGold

CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[T_TILL_TXN_Del_ThuHo]
	@p_TrnRefID varchar(15),
	@pType AS nvarchar(200)=NULL,
	@pCongNoBanLe bit,
